apps.name: Hushwell Demo
apps.short_description: The demo of an atmospheric 2D metroidvania that leads ever deeper. Leap, dash and cling to walls through the root-choked Rootways and the drowned Glowmire, push back creatures with pulses of echo, and face two bosses that each fight in their own way.

apps.name: Illusive Domain Demo
apps.short_description: Deflect, parry, and defeat your opponents through intense boss rush action. Fight for you and your allies’ freedom, lest you remain entombed forever more.

apps.name: Intend System Demo
apps.short_description: Unlock elite accuracy through biology. The Intend System activates a deep flow-state for aiming, transforming mechanical aiming into an automatic reflex.

apps.name: IntoTheLibrary Demo
apps.short_description: Explore an ever-changing library and seal away demons. Combine characters, skills, equipment, and artifacts to forge your own playstyle in this action roguelite.

apps.name: Iron Dice Demo
apps.short_description: Play a complete Iron Dice campaign for free. Learn the game through the full tutorial, then choose from 19 kingdoms on the 201-province Anvil map and lead your realm across the full 100-year campaign horizon.

apps.name: Island Shuffle Demo
apps.short_description: Build, combine, and unwind on colorful islands. Try several relaxed levels in one island theme in this demo.

apps.name: IT THINKS! Demo
apps.short_description: Play a focused, shorter version of IT THINKS! Complete 12 contracts, from your first logic gate to an early taste of parallel GPU design, and carry your progress into the full game.

apps.name: KESSLER: Orbital Incremental Demo
apps.short_description: 1983: a killer satellite is put into orbit, then forgotten. 2041: it wakes up, and everything circling the Earth becomes a target. One shot, a cloud of debris, a chain reaction. An incremental pixel-art game where you set off the Kessler syndrome.

apps.name: King of the Mob Demo
apps.short_description: KOTM is an action-packed, deckbuilding roguelike where a horde of troops is your weapon of choice. Craft an unbeatable deck, swarm and annihilate rival armies, and upgrade your measly militia into a warlord’s legion. Seize the empire and ascend to the throne!

apps.name: Kingdom of Poland: 1410 Demo
apps.short_description: Free demo of Kingdom of Poland: 1410, set in medieval Poland. Step into the shoes of Jan – an experienced hunter and tracker. Uncover the mystery of the missing people in the forests around the village of Nieszawa. Exploration, combat, tracking, and survival in the 15th century setting.

apps.name: Kitman Demo
apps.short_description: KITMAN is a 1-4 player job simulator set in the backrooms of a football stadium. Run the team by running the locker room. Clean the team’s boots, patch jerseys, mop floors, and when no-one is looking… sneak into the gaffer’s office and fix the game plan!

apps.name: La Bidouillerie Demo
apps.short_description: A real electronics simulator: build a machine from an electromechanical kit, snap solenoids and gears onto a perforated chassis, wire the circuit, switch on. It moves, sparks or burns. Twelve missions, a 1970s pinball table, a sandbox; the dart machine and transistors come in the full game.

apps.name: Legends of Castile Demo
apps.short_description: DEMO: Play as María de Salazar, a clumsy but brave village girl that has to investigate mythological legends of Castile in order to fulfill her dream, to become a nun. Discover a hand drawn point-and-click adventure inspired by the genre classics and set in Castile, Spain, during the 19th century.

apps.name: LEWD Fantasy: MIDNIGHT SEMESTER Demo
apps.short_description: You are a Firstborn, the first plain human in an academy where everyone else has ears, tails and wings. Move into the dorm, survive your roommate's one-man metal band, lose at darts, and decide who you let close. An adult visual novel where your answers change how they see you.

apps.name: Leyla In Veil Demo
apps.short_description: This is an HD-2D pixel-style side-scrolling action shooter survival horror game. Players will take on the role of Laila, a senior agent from a mysterious organization, partnering with her companion Flora to investigate a bizarre art gallery

apps.name: LIMINAL SHIFT Demo
apps.short_description: Liminal Shift is a unique atmospheric suspense game developed using the latest Unreal Engine 5 technologies such as Lumen and Nanite. With every step you take, Liminal Shift pushes you deeper into an eerie, unsettling experience like no other.

apps.name: Lost Bitcoin Demo
apps.short_description: Lost Bitcoin is a digging and automation game set in a gigantic junkyard. Collect scrap, burn it for coins, buy upgrades and build a factory that works for you. Crack crates and safes, and check every USB stick to find your lost Bitcoin wallet.

apps.name: MagicTower: Dreamweave Demo
apps.short_description:
The demo opens the first 20 floors, where you can try out the core combat and exploration mechanics.

Demo content does not represent the final game — more levels and mechanics will be added later.

⚠️ **Important**: Save data from the demo cannot be imported into the full version.

apps.name: Majogami Demo
apps.short_description: Majogami stars Shiroha, a young woman who has lost her memory, who travels alongside Shiori, her father who has been turned to paper. With her katana, "Kamikiri", in hand, she travels through a bizarre world and cuts through the horrors she finds there in this 2D character action platformer.

apps.name: Mictla Demo
apps.short_description: A challenging Puzzle Roguelike Deckbuilder inspired by Mesoamerican mythology where strategy is everything. Hard to master. Impossible to forget.

apps.name: Motive Power Demo
apps.short_description: Take charge of BR's diesel fleet from 1968 to 1976. Twelve classes, from the 08 shunters to the Deltics, and every locomotive an individual. Nine years of the real railway: the Westerns and Deltics in their prime, the Hymeks and Warships running down.

apps.name: Mountain Home Demo
apps.short_description: Mountain Номе is a 2D adventure game where the player along with monk and poet Saigyo will travel around medieval Japan, meet forest spirits, fight evil demons, help sad ghosts and write poetry.

apps.name: Moving Oasis Demo
apps.short_description: Free demo: one run on Tanker Dunes, about 30 minutes. A living black goo pours out of a beached oil tanker and all you have is a water tank. Wash the goo back, turn the sand green, wake the mushroom towns and see what comes for you at night.

apps.name: murmures Demo
apps.short_description: Discover the first chapter of **murmures**: roll your d20s, explore a place that feels strangely familiar, and follow Clara as the world around her starts revealing things she may not be ready to face.

apps.name: MuzzleFlash Demo
apps.short_description: MuzzleFlash is a top down local multiplayer shooter where gunfire is the primary light source. Set in a dark dystopian future players must embrace the cover of darkness of fight guns blazing to defeat their opponents.

apps.name: My Mom Says I’m Fine Demo
apps.short_description: A creepy toy-room survivors-like. Fight as a tiny toy while a giant Kid watches. Try the Grass and Snow Campaign worlds on tiers I–II, start as Reverant and earn demo coins to unlock Mordrax and Shard. Mom says he's fine.

apps.name: Mycelium Conquest Demo
apps.short_description: A deep biological network automation game where you grow a living mycelial network across an alien planet. Consume the local flora and creatures, build biological production chains, and evolve from a tiny spore into a cosmic entity that consumes worlds.

apps.name: Nebula Blink Demo
apps.short_description: Real-time space-fleet tactics where formation, facing and weapon arcs decide every engagement. Command 35 operations from both sides of a galactic war.

apps.name: Night Drive - Anomaly Demo
apps.short_description: Night Drive - Anomaly is a supernatural driving horror game where you must navigate a mysterious endless night, spot anomalies, choose the right road, and survive until morning to escape the loop.

apps.name: Nightwatch at The Museum Demo
apps.short_description: A routine night shift at an old Javanese museum. A fire from 1990 that nobody talks about. And something, or someone that refuses to let the truth stay buried.

apps.name: Nine Legion Demo
apps.short_description: Lead three heroes into random dungeons in this pixel-art action game. Switch heroes as AI allies fight beside you. Earn gold, upgrade skills and defeat bosses to recruit companions. Play three chapters in this demo, then build a nine-hero legion in the full game and face Endless Mode!

apps.name: NOSTRA Demo
apps.short_description: Play the opening hours of NOSTRA, a dark fantasy RPG with side-view party combat. Explore Grünthal and the woods beyond, parry on the frame, break guards with Boost and face what waits beneath the bandit camp. This alpha demo grows with every update until release.

apps.name: Nothing Unusual Demo
apps.short_description: Nothing Unusual is a light backpack-building arena survival roguelike. The city’s gone weird; monsters are crawling out of the cracks. Fight with sticks, thermoses, umbrellas and odder things: arrange, merge and mix elements in your backpack, and last until dark. After all, monsters need sleep too.

apps.name: Nova Squadron Demo
apps.short_description: Dive straight into Jupiter's atmosphere and take down vast flying fortresses from within in fast-paced, arcade flight combat. Losing your plane is just a setback - return with an upgraded replacement and take back lost territory in Nova Squadron's roguelite campaign.

apps.name: One More Plate Demo
apps.short_description: Feed your fellow Shape Buddies to a bizarre cast of Glutton Monsters before they put you on the menu. Catch, balance, and fling food with a collection of absurd, anything-but-proper plates. Everything obeys physics; nothing obeys you. A chaotic physics-based party game, solo or with a friend!

apps.name: Operation Crimson Demo
apps.short_description: A story-driven top-down action shooter. Venture into hazardous zones consumed by a biological catastrophe, battle mutated creatures of all shapes and sizes with firearms and melee weapons, and gradually uncover the truth behind the disaster as you advance through tense, tightly paced linear levels.

apps.name: ORBTRUDER Demo
apps.short_description:
ORBTRUDER is a tactical roguelite action platformer about a ricocheting killer robot ball.
Climb ever higher up a mysterious skyscraper. Slow down time, aim, ricochet and try again.

apps.name: OshiYa Demo
apps.short_description: Take your first shifts as a platform attendant in Hakomori. Push passengers aboard, keep crowded trains moving and experience five departures before the first promotion. Your demo save can carry into the full version of OshiYa.

apps.name: PAPERWORKS: Paper Shredder Inc. Demo
apps.short_description: Scan books, shred the originals, and burn humanity's knowledge for cash in this first-person incremental game. Upgrade machines and automate your work—but why is the office empty, and who's giving orders through the terminals? Uncover the conspiracy before humanity burns.

apps.name: Pimpin' Around Demo
apps.short_description: Play as a pimp in the funky 1970s. Run the joint, slap the troublemakers and buy the place before the Pimp Boss buys you.

apps.name: Pizza House Simulator🍕 Demo
apps.short_description: Cook authentic pizzas, manage your kitchen, serve impatient customers, and experience the first taste of Pizza House Simulator. The full game will expand into automation, customization, disasters, economy systems, and restaurant empire building.

apps.name: Plinkdown Demo
apps.short_description: It’s 1994 and Channel 9 is still on the air. Bounce orbs through peg boards, meet tonight’s quota, and spend what you earn at the Commissary between broadcasts. Every run goes deeper into a late-night show that should have stopped airing years ago.

apps.name: Poly's Destiny Chapter: 1 Demo
apps.short_description: Follow your father into a mysterious forest, uncover the truth behind missing girls, and discover that some things are far more terrifying than they appear.

apps.name: PowerCorp Demo
apps.short_description: A space sim survival where each decision costs power. Every system drains your dying reactor. Pilot a crippled spacecraft across a real-scale solar system using true orbital mechanics, manage critical systems, scavenge for resources, while you try to uncover why humanity seems to have disappeared.

apps.name: Price for Freedom: Gold and Sand Demo
apps.short_description: Gold and Sand is an erotic-CRPG with turn-based combat. Beautiful hand drawn art elevates this character driven game where you will explore the unique world and guide characters as they discover each other and themselves in fully animated erotic scenes.

apps.name: Professional Ship Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Take the helm in this realistic, large-scale maritime simulation. Command your fleet from agile rescue vessels to massive LNG tankers and perform precise maneuvers in challenging conditions. Navigate a living open world where weather, traffic, and every wave shape your career.

apps.name: Psych Demo
apps.short_description: Experience the story of Alexander Green and find out what happened on the day of the accident in this First Person horror Adventure. Follow the development of Alex, solve puzzles around the event and try not to fall into madness as you search for answers.

apps.name: Quiet Bloom Demo
apps.short_description: Quiet Bloom is a cozy idle game. Awaken the wind, dig wells, and call the rain to tend your land for you. Gather wood, stone, and water, raise wind vanes and solar panels, and watch a cracked desert slowly bloom into a luxuriant green oasis.

apps.name: Rag Doll Demo
apps.short_description: Fighting based on physics. Rag Doll is a 2D game with cartoon graphics, where you control the character's head, and the body moves according to the laws of physics!

apps.name: Request Stop Demo
apps.short_description: This is a separate story that ties in to the full game. A seaside town out of season: early shifts, the bus to work, a neighbour nobody has seen for a while. What you do here carries on into the full game.

apps.name: Rock From Home Demo
apps.short_description: Name your rock, interact, customize wildly, and battle emails! A comedy sim where you actively earn money through your day job to pay for your foolish spendings.

apps.name: ROOM 307 Demo
apps.short_description: Return to an abandoned psychiatric hospital where your mother vanished twenty years ago. Explore dark corridors, solve environmental puzzles, and survive terrifying encounters in this 25–30 minute first-person psychological horror demo. Room 307 is waiting.

apps.name: Room Movers Demo
apps.short_description: Grab one end, I'll take the other. A cozy game about unboxing and arranging tiny diorama rooms, with a friend or on your own. No grid, no score, no timer. Just you, your friend, and a room that slowly becomes a place.

apps.name: RuiNsGate Survivors Demo
apps.short_description: Free demo of RuiNsGate Survivors. Fight through Stage 1 all the way to its boss, and get a full taste of the treasure-hunt loop: weapon drops, rarity rolls, and enchantments. Your save data carries over to the full game.

apps.name: RZIR Free
apps.short_description: Browse animated WebP, GIF, and web videos inside ZIP/RAR archives, with HDR filters, Steam Workshop wallpaper mode, and multiple comic browsing features.

apps.name: Shack Animator 2D Indie Edition Demo
apps.short_description: Animate faster with Shack Animator 2D - responsive raster brushes, fast real-time timeline playback, 3D compatibility, powerful camera tools, GPU effects, and an integrated PBR painting workflow, plus much more.

apps.name: Sherpa's Caravan Demo
apps.short_description: 🏔 🚐 ⛺️ 📦 🍳 🛶 Explore a cozy open world as a sherpa driver in your van! Deliver cargo, cook food, craft gear, and explore mountains, lakes, and hidden trails. Sail in boats and kayaks, dive underwater. Meet old friends and upgrade your van! A camping atmosphere and next-gen graphics

apps.name: Shirt Happens! Demo
apps.short_description: Build a T-shirt brand with your friends online, or run the whole shop solo. Draw your own prints, then cut, sew, overlock and press every shirt by hand. Want a real factory? Bring up to 6. Do a bit of everything, or pick one station and master it. The demo covers your first five days.

apps.name: SHRED A BILLION Demo
apps.short_description: SHRED A BILLION is a first-person incremental game about a mountain of money! Grab bills by hand, scoop them up with a bucket, level up and feed a billion dollars to the shredder. Only 3,929,120,202 bills left to collect!

apps.name: Shrimpscape Demo
apps.short_description: Build detailed freshwater aquariums, manage water chemistry, and breed Caridina through a genetics system with 43 million possible genotypes. Discover 52 morphs and 200 phenotypes, then explore your creation as a shrimp.

apps.name: Sitter Demo
apps.short_description: Investigating his grandmother's mysterious death, a detective enters her home in search of the truth. But the house begins to toy with him. Space twists, fears take shape, and there's no way out. Every step, every room, every loop brings him closer to madness.

apps.name: Snack Invaders Demo
apps.short_description: Slipping into a junk food-induced coma during a late-night movie marathon, you wake up as an astronaut stranded in a galaxy overrun by living junk food! Play solo or co-op online with up to 3 friends (4 players max) to battle hordes of junk food and Souls-like bosses as you fight to escape alive!

apps.name: Sorcerous 2 City of Cults Demo
apps.short_description: Kick down doors, hunt sinister cults, and face bloodthirsty gods in a dark diesel-punk metropolis. Lead a group of magic-school students into turn-based battles with carefully chosen spells, talismans, and occult weapons.

apps.name: Spooky Tales Demo
apps.short_description: Spooky Tales is a horror anthology featuring four unique tales, blending 1920s pulp dread, Japanese body horror, found footage, and 80s VHS charm in one package.

apps.name: Stack Inspector Demo
apps.short_description: Try the free Stack Inspector demo! Stack awkward objects in first person, outsmart gravity and face MIRA’s watchful inspections. One bad move can bring everything down.

apps.name: Stack Island - Survival card game Demo
apps.short_description: Experience the redesigned Stack Island in this free demo. Explore a mysterious island, discover resources, combine cards, craft useful tools, and survive as you search for a way to escape.

apps.name: Star Chasers Demo
apps.short_description: Star Chasers Demo is a 2–4 player local multiplayer party game! Roll the dice, race across the board, collect stars, and challenge your friends in wild mini-games. Dodge lasers, survive lava, and outplay your rivals with skill, strategy, and a little luck. Who will claim the party crown?

apps.name: Star Vortex: Demo
apps.short_description: Star Vortex is an Action-RPG inspired by classics like Diablo 2. Design your ship, fight your way through hostile alien sectors, upgrade as you salvage rare weapons and experiment with different builds until nothing can stand against you.

apps.name: STARCULT Night Twisted Age Demo
apps.short_description: A dark fantasy VN with romance and horror. Kill all your enemies! Manipulate! Survive the investigation! Create or join a Cult. Enjoy power and peaceful moments... as a Villainess Artist with your palette, until bigger problems arise.

apps.name: SteelBlade Shop Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: SteelBlade Shop Simulator lets you run your own SteelBlade shop in the streets of Japan. Open SteelBlade boxes, collect parts with different tiers, build powerful SteelBlades, sell them for profit, or take them into the arena and compete to prove your skill.

apps.name: SteelFall Demo
apps.short_description: Play the opening of SteelFall: fight through Marren and defend the Gorge by night. Pilot a heavy mech, punch, parry and shoot through the kaiju horde, and unlock skins in the Workshop. Your progress carries over to the full game.

apps.name: Stellar Courier Demo
apps.short_description: Arcade space shooter. You are a courier with one package to deliver across a broken galaxy. Plane-like flight, fights with pirates in a story campaign. Pick your ship between missions. No grind, no filler.

apps.name: StickerScout Demo
apps.short_description: Try the start of StickerScout, a cozy wildlife-watching game. Photograph the animals at the Beaver Dam from dawn to long after dark, press your photos into stickers, decorate your album, and take a break with pie at Maggie’s. No timers, no combat: just you, your camera and the forest.

apps.name: Sublight Demo
apps.short_description: Sublight is a space bullet heaven roguelike, where you captain a powerful warship and carve through escalating waves of enemies. Upgrade your arsenal, unlock new ships, and experiment with countless builds to dominate the battlefield.

apps.name: Sudoku Mansion Demo
apps.short_description: Play the opening chapter of Sudoku Mansion for free. Solve handcrafted Sudoku variants, explore the mysterious mansion, and uncover its first secrets.

apps.name: Surviving Day! Demo
apps.short_description: Jump into an endless voxel world adventure. Mine for ores and cut down trees, marvel at your own creations that can be wired with computers and more! Enjoy the wild life and fend off bears that turn aggravated near by! Dragons and the rare velociraptor are also known to lurk in the world.

apps.name: Swarm Bunker: Lust Defense Demo
apps.short_description: Command firepower, shred the swarm! In this adult pixel TD, build and upgrade defenses to rain destruction. Your reward: hot "service" from three squadmates. Unlock dynamic H-scenes—let adrenaline and lust explode! This is a man's battle!

apps.name: Swarmdle Demo
apps.short_description: Swarmdle deals the same twelve minutes to every player on Earth. Same weapon, same map, same modifiers, same wave timeline. Survive the swarm, level up, and evolve your build. Share your results and find out whether your friends did better with the exact same draw.

apps.name: Switch Girl: Special Rescue Beauty Demo
apps.short_description: Creatures of the world are being corrupted by a dark nebula. Switch Girl, a living doll with the power of love and teleportation, devotes herself to protect the peace and bring love to everyone in a pacifist platformer game.

apps.name: Sword of the Last Second Demo
apps.short_description: You have been bestowed a special sword and the authority to sever the bonds of soul and flesh. Make haste for your appointed time has arrived. Defeat your foes, collect their souls, and manifest your authority, until the myriads fall before you in a single moment.

apps.name: Tales of Soravos: Ashen Company Demo
Telluria Demo
apps.short_description: Two girls are living at the same time but in two different realities separated by 1400 years. They can see each other through the power of an ancient talisman and hey ! They are here to save the world from doom.

apps.name: The Book of Prosperity Demo
apps.short_description: The Book of Prosperity is a 2D action RPG in a surreal pixel-art Hong Kong where ancient magic seeps through modern streets and skyscrapers. Student Cyrus must master rhythmic combat, rooftop parkour, and buried secrets to uncover prosperity's hidden cost.

apps.name: The Collective Demo
apps.short_description: The Collective is a horror comedy RPG set in an strange world. You are alone, confused, imprisoned, and your choices matter more than you think. This game fuses elements of Fear & Hunger, Resident Evil, and Disco Elysium together in a fascinating concoction of a J-RPG.

apps.name: The End of Magic Demo
apps.short_description: Explore Wickmoor in this demo of a top-down action adventure. Discover hidden spells, solve dungeon puzzles, and face the region's bosses. Fight with your staff, cast magic, and absorb power from fallen enemies as you search its woods and moors.

apps.name: The Fate of Onexora Demo
apps.short_description: The Fate of Onexora is a turn-based, story rich RPG with a wide array of skills and equipment, allowing you to play in the style that suits you best. Discover a world full of secrets hidden behind ancestral conflicts.

apps.name: The Last Mothership Demo
apps.short_description: A chill sci-fi incremental game where you play as the last surviving mothership, lost in an unknown solar system. Harvest planets, manage resources, grow your fleet, unlock permanent upgrades, and evolve your species. Become the devourer of worlds.

apps.name: The Mermaid Mask Demo
apps.short_description: Magnus Mortuga has been killed. The captain of the world's strangest submarine, he was found in a locked room with an ancient stone cauldron - unsealed and opened for the first time. How did he die? Was it a curse? Perhaps one of his eccentric crew? Or does the bizarre truth run even deeper...

apps.name: The Vaults Below Durn: A Field Study Demo
They Were Here First Demo
apps.short_description: Face a tide of creatures in this incremental horde survivor FPS. You are a robot sent to strip a planet. Power the Extractor, upgrade your chassis, and expand your arsenal.

apps.name: Tidy Arcana Demo
apps.short_description: This is the demo of Tidy Arcana, a cozy first person organizing game about restoring a magical library.

apps.name: Tidy Up: Street Market: Demo
apps.short_description: Try the first corner of the market for free. Tidy Up: Street Market is a cozy first-person organizing game. In this demo you sort nearly 600 items across 3 stalls, and if you finish it, you start the full game with extra money.

apps.name: Tiling Forest - Tiling Town Demo
apps.short_description: Open-world logic puzzle game about building a forest by laying tiles.

apps.name: Tiny Fortress Demo
apps.short_description: [Previously called "Tiny Towers"] A short incremental game about defending your tiny fortress from hordes of tiny mobs. Place towers, gain resources by defeating enemies, and unlock new upgrades in the skill tree to strengthen your goblin stronghold.

apps.name: Tiny Village Demo
apps.short_description: 《Tiny Village》 is an incremental game where you gather resources with your mouse, unlock new buildings with the resources you collect, and develop your village. Strengthen your gathering abilities, unlock a variety of buildings one by one, and turn your small village into a thriving home!

apps.name: Tokyo Outbreak: Zero Demo
apps.short_description:
An FPS survival horror set in Japan.
After surviving the Operation to Eliminate the Infected, the protagonist is ordered to secure the virus developer and heads to Tokyo.
Explore and fight using survivors’ requests and information.
Manage limited ammo and healing items to survive.

apps.name: Tree's Love Crossing Above: Origin
apps.short_description: This is a BL-themed FMV game where players will control the protagonist "Xiaoshu" make choices for him, and experience four completely different love stories. Will they lead to a sweet ending or end in regret? Every choice you make will determine the protagonist's ultimate romantic destination.

apps.name: Trophy Rex Demo
apps.short_description: A retro first-person dinosaur hunting game. Stalk 31 species across 9 hunting grounds, read the wind, choose your rifle and place the shot that reaches the heart. Wounded prey bleeds, runs or charges. Fly your trophies home to the lodge, or die out there and lose them all.

apps.name: Twinkleby Demo
apps.short_description: Twinkleby is a cozy decoration game where you map out an archipelago of floating islands and build dioramas for a society of spacefaring neighbours. Try out a little piece of the upcoming game in this demo!

apps.name: Twofold Tower Demo
apps.short_description: Shift between dimensions, and sidestep undead skeletons – then juggle both at once! Twofold Tower is a turn-based puzzler, and this prologue takes place before the events of the main game, and contains unique puzzles and content.

apps.name: Unboxing Demo
apps.short_description: UNBOXING Demo: Dive into this puzzle-platformer where death is your key to progress. In this free demo, solve 15+ challenging puzzles using your companion box to revive and navigate a strange, paradoxical world. Uncover the mystery of an endless cycle—can you break free?

apps.name: Unclaimed: Loot or Junk Demo
apps.short_description: Unbox. Sort. Collect. Become a master of discovery by exploring unclaimed packages. Complete every set, from vintage gadgets to "Golden Junk". Sell piles of everyday items to buy new shipments and hunt for truly rare treasures. What will you find in the next box?

apps.name: Unfinished Demo
apps.short_description: An abandoned commercial building. A forgotten incident. Something lurking in the ruins. Uncover the truth and escape in this first-person survival horror.

apps.name: USURPATIO Demo
apps.short_description: In a world where humankind has begun to create life on its own terms, the eighth sin emerges. USURPATIO.

apps.name: V-Monsters Forgotten Link Demo
apps.short_description: V-Monsters Forgotten Link Battle Demo: PvE Arcade plus a Battle Tower. Test turn-based monster-taming tactics, team formations and mid-battle evolutions. Earn points, buy items and unlock new evolutions.

apps.name: Vampire Clans Demo
apps.short_description: Create the most powerful Vampire Clan, to take over Paris streets and underground. Challenge other clans, beat them and enslave. Use spells, alchemy and human blood to grow up your power. Become the terror of all inhabitants or use quiet politics to achieve your goals.

apps.name: Vanguard Exiles Demo
apps.short_description: Blending deep board game strategy with auto-battling mastery, and designed by Richard Garfield (creator of Magic: The Gathering), lead your Squads over an ever-changing dieselpunk battlefield where no two games are ever the same. Think ahead, adapt fast, outwit your opponent and claim victory.

apps.name: Virtualord, the virtual conqueror Demo
apps.short_description: Set up your base, gather resources and build a defensive perimeter with walls and towers to protect your outpost from waves of enemies. Research new tech, gather your forces and send your units and mini-units to annihilate the enemy.

apps.name: Void Demolition Co. Demo
apps.short_description: Play the first contract for free: tear down all of Woodland Town with the Lumber Axe, level up your black hole, awaken axe transmutations and watch the final devour.

apps.name: Warrior's Memory The Hollow Strata Demo
Wave & Sort: The Magic Wand Shop Demo
apps.short_description: You're locked in the last wrecked room of a wand shop. Flick your wand to read each wand's patron and wood, shelve 150 wands, put the room back together and calm the earth spirits. Restore the room and the master's wand is yours to try.

apps.name: We Will Die For You Demo
apps.short_description: An incremental action game where you guide a white blood cell through the human body. Destroy debris, earn Protein, and buy permanent upgrades for the cells that follow. Unlock powerful abilities and confront disease bosses. EVERY CELL DIES. YOUR BODY REMEMBERS.

apps.name: Wheel Make It Demo
apps.short_description: One wheelchair. Two players. Infinite chaos. Solo or co-op physics-based game about teamwork, clumsiness, and the unstoppable power of friendship.

apps.name: Wild Island Demo
apps.short_description: You are stranded on a mysterious island, trying to escape. A sandbox where you stack items, craft synergies, and turn simple weapons into pure power. Experiment with runes, accessories, and pets. Discover the island’s mysteries and rebuild your sanctuary to uncover what the island truly wants.

apps.name: Willy Morgan Demo
apps.short_description: A letter from 10 years ago, an intricate web of lies to unravel and a mystery to solve. Explore an unconventional town of pirates, dive into the past, collect items and look for clues to help Willy find out what happened to his father...

apps.name: DCS: MiG-29 Flaming Cliffs
apps.short_description:
Note: the aircraft model is identical to the Flaming Cliffs 3 module. Owners of FC3 do not need to purchase.

The MiG-29 "Fulcrum" is a Russian-designed, twin-engine, supersonic fighter. First operational in the early 1980s, the Fulcrum is a "light weight" fighter, comparable to the American F/A-18 Hornet and F-16. Designed to work in conjunction with the larger Su-27 Flanker, the MiG-29 is armed with an internal 30mm cannon and both infrared and radar guided air-to-air missiles. For air-to-ground tasks, the MiG-29 can be armed with a large array of unguided bombs and rockets.

In addition to a sophisticated pulse doppler radar, the MiG-29 is also equipped with a passive Infrared Search and Track (IRST) sensor that allows the Fulcrum to detect and target enemy aircraft just based on target infrared emissions. This allows the MiG-29 to make stealthy attacks with no warning!

The Fulcrum is a highly-maneuverable fighter in a dogfight, and when paired with the helmet mounted sight and the AA-11 "Archer" air-to-air missile, it is a very lethal adversary.

The MiG-29 has also been widely exported and has served in many countries that include Germany, Iran, Ukraine, and Poland.

Key Features of the MiG-29 for DCS World:

A professional level flight model provides unmatched flight physics that allow you to truly feel what it's like to fly this amazing aircraft. Designed and tested by a former MiG-29 pilot!
A true model of the MiG-29 flight control system that allows you to perform "out of the envelope" maneuvers.
Highly detailed, six-degrees-of-freedom (6 DOF) cockpit.
Accurate MiG-29 Fulcrum model, squadron markings, and weapons.
Includes instant action, single missions, and a campaign.
Battle the Hornet in head-to-head combat.

apps.name: A Cup of Cat

Collect pixel cats of all coats and sizes, feed them, play with them, stir-fry them in the wok, and watch them squish into funny shapes. Want a challenge? Take them to BATTLE for a high score! Warning: those chubby bellies will wreck your focus.

apps.name: A Dream You Had Before the Dream You Had Before the Dream
apps.short_description: A Dream where you don't even remember yourself.

apps.name: A Game About Digging A Hole™ Together
apps.short_description: A minimalist game about digging a hole at the beach, now with friends. Dig together, collect resources, sell them, upgrade your equipment and search for a promised treasure buried deep beneath the sand.

apps.name: A Million Orcs
apps.short_description: A tower defense where you raise walls, dig traps and field archers, spearmen and cavalry between waves, then sound the horn and hold your keep as over a million orcs flood the valley. Strike back with the powers of a god while your dragon riders burn lanes through the horde.

apps.name: A Witch's Husband
apps.short_description: Scotland, the 1500s. You wake in your own blood. Your wife is gone, taken as a witch. Follow her over the Highland pass and face the men who took her, one sword duel at a time. Block and strike from three directions, parry at the last moment, and strike where their guard breaks open.

apps.name: A Wizard-Chess Tournament
apps.short_description: Chess, but with wizards. Every piece has HP and Attack and spell cards bend the rules. Outplay a friend in hotseat, over LAN, or online and climb the leaderboard.

apps.name: Abduct & Destroy
apps.short_description: Pilot a UFO in a chaotic VR arcade game. Abduct humans, blast buildings apart, and take on ridiculous missions with your ship’s destruction and abduction cannons. Earth is having a very bad day.

apps.name: Abilill: Persistent Fantasy Extraction MMO
apps.short_description: (This game was developed entirely using AI.) Abilill: persistent-world fantasy loot/extraction MMO. Leave a safe base on foot for wilds, caves and ruins. Find treasure, fight monsters and hostile players, extract loot. Die and your backpack loot drops for others. Push deeper or retreat?

apps.name: Abyss at Hand
apps.short_description: Form an adventuring party on your own or with friends, and set out to defeat this world’s Demon Lord! Abyss at Hand is a multiplayer action-adventure game for 1–4 players. Experience thrilling, adrenaline-pumping battles in a vast fantasy world!

apps.name: Abyss Drifter
apps.short_description: A first-person space courier sim. Haul cargo between planets and stations, fuel and repair your ship by hand, and navigate by instruments through a forgotten star system where nobody is coming to help.

apps.name: ACID DROP DOWNHILL: WITH UZI
apps.short_description:
Downhill as far as you can from a nuclear explosion an your skateboard snowboard or surf while shooting it with uzi to do tricks. Hope you are faster than the nuke.
ACID DROP DOWNHILL IS THE BEST YOU EVER FEEL

apps.name: Adaptive Wilds
apps.short_description: Learn the land. Make a life in it. Adaptive Wilds is a hardcore survival RPG with deep character progression, interacting physical and psychological states, and a wilderness you can reshape. Develop your skills, work with NPCs, experiment with nature, and explore dream realms.

apps.name: After Silence
apps.short_description: A third-person survival horror blending visceral tactical combat with a deeply personal narrative. Infiltrate Black Protocol's ruins, uncover the truth about Compound Z, and fight through a dying city. A mother's love becomes the most dangerous weapon in a world that forgot mercy.

apps.name: After the Wane
apps.short_description: Lena wants to step into the limelight, but the voice in her head has other plans. Between artistic ambitions, romance, family mysteries and the call of the occult, the ways toward your destiny are multiple and tortuous. Lena, Magdalena ou Madeleine… Who will you be when the curtain falls?

apps.name: Aftertaste
apps.short_description: Aftertaste is a 2.5D indie platformer game where you play as Tami, the tongue of a burned-out chef, Keh, and rediscover her lost passion. Let’s embark on a journey of regaining her taste through adventure and puzzles!

apps.name: Ahwa: Heart of the Azure Dragon
apps.short_description: An otome visual novel set among four guardian clans. After losing her mother, Ahwa inherits leadership of the Azure Dragon clan, and with it an old law: a leader must stand alone. Will she carry every burden herself, or share it? Your choices shape six bonds and the fate of the four clans.

apps.name: AimZen
apps.short_description: AimZen is a minimalist first-person aim trainer with stackable hotkey-activated modifiers, built to sharpen precision, reaction speed, and muscle memory.

apps.name: All In: Reckoning
apps.short_description: A story-driven strategy card game of hidden information and revenge. Read your opponent’s clues, conceal your own hand, and decide when to guess. Return as Silas to a city of old debts, where every card can reveal a truth or sell a lie.

apps.name: Altstadt
apps.short_description: A tiny old town that grows under your hands. Set down a house, then another, let a canal wander through, and stay for dusk, when the windows light up one by one. Nothing to manage. Just building.

apps.name: Am I Dreaming?
apps.short_description: Am I Dreaming? is a retro-style anomaly horror game with some light story elements. Figure out if you are awake or this is all a dream. Help Timmy make the right choice throughout the entire week or face the consequences...

apps.name: Am I Nima
apps.short_description: Am I Nima is a psychological-horror game where you must convince your mom that you really are her daughter. Combine words together in your brain and use them to talk. Get her to trust you.

apps.name: AMAKANO 3
apps.short_description: A lazy summer visual novel comedy from hit developer AZARASHI SOFTWARE! Take up a position as a dorm manager in a hot-spring town and nurture new connections with its colorful cast of residents!

apps.name: Amalgam
apps.short_description:
Amalgam is a Half-Life 2 singleplayer mod.

Somewhere near the City 17, the rebels have been trying to destroy the combine communication towers known as relays. You as Gordon Freeman, must help the rebels sabotage the relays and a mysterious structure called the beacon.

apps.name: Amezida
apps.short_description: Co-op survival horror for 1–5 players with card-driven actions and hidden objectives. Explore derelict ships, manage your hand, seal bulkheads and reach an escape pod. Play online, on one screen or solo with an AI crew. Trust is optional.

apps.name: Andy Blast Vs The Forces of Evil
apps.short_description: A 2D Platforming Shotgun Extravaganza! Andy Blast Vs The Forces of Evil is a spiritual successor to Dangerous Dave in the Haunted Mansion! Return to the mansion and explore further as you take down the Forces of Evil to rescue Jeanette from the clutches of a mad scientist and his Forces of Evil!

apps.name: Anima Reaver
apps.short_description: A 3D Sci-Fi space shooter game where you fight against big flagships and bases to unlock the secrets of the world.

apps.name: Anno Online
apps.short_description: Anno Online is a free-to-play city-builder game that lets you develop big magnificent metropolises in the medieval times.

apps.name: Anomalistic Revolution
apps.short_description: You stand before a pit at the city's heart, then your gaze drifts to a deeper void, one you fear even more. Wield your invention to unravel mysteries, reclaim lost memories, strengthen your skills, and battle nightmare-born horrors in this multi-ending RPG.

apps.name: Ant Colony: Wild Forest
apps.short_description: Build and automate your own ant colony – a nest that runs itself! Freely dig and shape your underground kingdom, produce different types of ants, and grow it block by block. Then it's time for conquest: scale up your swarm, crush enemy bases, and lead your colony to victory in the wild forest!

apps.name: AntiBacteria
apps.short_description: Blast swarms of bacteria, dodge bullet hell and defeat giant bosses. Grab perks, unlock new shots and fight deeper with every run. Be the cure.

apps.name: Apocalypse LootRunner
apps.short_description: Fight endless hordes, collect epic loot, and grow ridiculously powerful in this post-apocalyptic idle survival RPG. Upgrade your gear, build your skills, defeat brutal bosses, and push deeper into the wasteland. Death is temporary. The loot obsession is forever.

apps.name: Apocalypseed
apps.short_description: Apocalypseed is a 2D real-time strategy game where you are the invasion. Devour humans to harvest flesh, build and strengthen an army of alien plants, and evolve your creatures into new forms with unique abilities. Crush the human resistance as it deploys increasingly dangerous threats to stop you.

apps.name: ArcheAge Chronicles
apps.short_description: Explore Auroria, a vast and vibrant world brimming with rich lore and thrilling action. ArcheAge Chronicles delivers an immersive experience that will capture players' hearts, whether they are newcomers to the setting or seasoned adventurers.

apps.name: Archechord
apps.short_description: Step into the characters' mindscapes to face swarms of "Psychic Noise". Strike the beat, turning rhythm into firepower to break the siege; or enter "Flow" to freeze the horde, queuing moves to unleash in one breath—push through the clamor, and at the music's end, confront the self hidden away.

apps.name: Arctic Outpost
apps.short_description: You and your friends find yourselves stranded in a remote location, facing extreme weather conditions and limited resources. Your ability to work together and communicate effectively will determine your chances of survival.

apps.name: Arivel
apps.short_description: A sandbox about building in a vast fantasy world. Carve details inside a block, raise castles on real supports and grow factories with power and machines. Explore from deep underworlds to lands above the clouds, take village quests and challenge bosses. Play solo or with up to 3 friends.

apps.name: ArkSeed Terraformery
apps.short_description: You are the last chance for humanity, Terraform, Build, Save Humanity one pixel at a time. Arkseed Terraformery is a 2D factory and colony building and automation game with physics.

apps.name: Armed Prototype: Dual Blaze
apps.short_description: Armed Prototype: Dual Blaze is a pixel-art side-scrolling action shooter for solo or local co-op play! Run, jump and climb under fire. Smash special devices to switch between gun-wielding and sword-wielding heroines. Fight through enemy lines with bullets and blades—alone or with a friend!

apps.name: Art Fraud
apps.short_description: Four to eight pub animals share one canvas and one secret word — all except the Art Fraud, who has no idea what everyone is drawing. One stroke each, then 90 seconds of voice chat to find the liar. Point, vote, unmask. The loser gets tomatoes.

apps.name: Asteroid Bastion
apps.short_description: Free-form space defense in real time. Mine asteroids, route power from Helios and hold off pirate fleets. Lose one Conductor and a whole flank goes dark. Build without a grid, choose your weapons and take on 21 levels.

apps.name: Astro Riches
apps.short_description: A short incremental game about blasting asteroids for riches! Unlock and upgrade your fleet of spaceships. Become the riches in the galaxy.

apps.name: Astronominal
apps.short_description: A single-player space sandbox with a pixel-art soul. Mine asteroids, salvage wrecks, trade and build a fleet, then land on alien worlds. Hire wingmen, command drones and carve a path between the Alliance, pirates and the hostile Unknown.

apps.name: Athletics Live: Track & Field
apps.short_description: A skill-based athletics game where your hands decide who wins. Mash to sprint, clear the hurdles, hit the board and release at 45°. Every men's and women's event, relays, decathlon and heptathlon, and a World Tour from club meets to the Global Games. Race your friends online.

apps.name: Automyth: Maze Defense
apps.short_description: Automyth is an auto battler with roguelite and tower defense elements. Draft towers and buffs, deploy bronze automata, and place gates to funnel enemies into traps. Merge your towers and adapt to enemy resistances as the maze grows, with hand-drawn art inspired by Ancient Greek pottery.

apps.name: Aviator: Airline Empire
apps.short_description: Build a global airline empire from the dawn of the Jet Age into the future. Connect 120+ cities on an interactive world map, command iconic aircraft, and outsmart rivals in this turn-based strategy sim. Features solo campaigns, an Open Skies sandbox, and 2–4 player local hot-seat multiplayer.

apps.name: Axomorph Idle
apps.short_description: Axomorph Idle, an idle biogentics game about evolving an axolotl from a cell to an ultimate axolotl form. Journey through an idle adventure through growth, expansion, mutation, and transcendence stages. If you love numbers, or axolotls, this game might be it for you. Try it out today for free!

apps.name: Backframes: Escape Together
apps.short_description: Backframes: Escape Together is a cooperative horror game for 1–4 players. Explore dark levels, solve dangerous puzzles, and escape from sinister entities. Use your voice to interact with objects, uncovering unexpected paths to survival.

apps.name: Background RPG
apps.short_description: Turn your everyday PC activity into an RPG adventure! Every click and keystroke helps your knight fight the undead, gain XP and find powerful loot. Equip new gear, grow stronger and rise through the ranks.

apps.name: Backrooms: Shifted Reality
apps.short_description: You've noclipped out of reality. In this 1-4 player co-op exploration game, you must navigate the terrifying depths of the Backrooms. Outsmart entities, uncover secrets, and desperately search for an exit.

apps.name: BAD STUDENT LOVE
apps.short_description:
Labeled a “troublemaker,” you transfer to the worst high school.
There, you become entangled in dangerous relationships driven by desire, jealousy, and manipulation.
Will you get closer, be used, or get hurt—
your choices will determine how your story with them ends.

apps.name: Badass Brigade
apps.short_description: Throw a dude at another dude! Badass Brigade is a light-hearted 2D action game where you shoot, punch, grab, and throw your foes. Take on missions where you can explore the world and uncover a wide variety of weapons and gear for new ways to fight.

apps.name: Ball Survivor
apps.short_description: A 2D survivor action game. Players choose hidden heroes such as Little Mage and Wave Swordsman to survive and strengthen their skills in the constantly surging tide of enemies, challenge their limits - and fully enjoy the decompression and dopamine pleasure brought by bullet screen monster clearing.

apps.name: BALLRENA
apps.short_description: BALLRENA is a physics-driven build-crafting auto-battler roguelite. Choose a Core, buy, rotate, and merge oddly shaped parts, then fit them into a tight 5×5 grid. Send your custom ball into the arena and watch every collision, weapon trigger, and chain reaction put your decisions to the test.

apps.name: BALSA Model Flight Simulator
apps.short_description: Balsa is a detailed Model Flight Simulator with a powerful editor where you can design, build, fly and battle with model aircraft. Developed by the creator of Kerbal Space Program, Balsa is a virtual flight experience like no other.

apps.name: Bandit
apps.short_description: In "Bandit", play as the Sheriff, a Deputy, a Renegade, or a Bandit. Bandits must eliminate the Sheriff, while he relies on allies to uncover traitors. Trust, traps, betrayal… stay sharp.

apps.name: Bannertide
apps.short_description: A little strategy game about growing armies and conquering a fantasy island.

apps.name: Battlecar Survivors
apps.short_description: Drive a modular battlecar through zombie hordes in this top-down action roguelite. Combine mounted weapons, choose upgrades and evolve your firepower. Take on bosses, collect equipment and return to base to prepare your next build.

apps.name: Beam Them All
apps.short_description: An incremental strategy about cosmic hunting: pilot your flying saucer, abduct animals with a tractor beam, and gather biomass to unlock new technologies. Upgrade your ship, expand the field, and evacuate in time before turrets and mines cut your expedition short.

apps.name: BEAST
apps.short_description: BEAST is a wildlife-themed strategy card game that authentically captures the law of the jungle — survival of the fittest. Players will collect over a hundred species of wild animals that have truly existed on Earth, lead their beast army, and compete against players from around the world.

apps.name: Beast Bounty: Barricade!
apps.short_description: Build a solid defense line to protect a prize car in this physics-based building and defense game. Use a crane to stack containers, walls, and vehicles. You have two minutes and a limited budget before turrets and riflemen put your barricade to the test.

apps.name: Before the Pyre
apps.short_description: Lead a secret coven through plague and witch hunts in this dark fantasy card-based strategy game. Uncover forbidden magic, bargain with nobles and ancient spirits, and protect your witches. A spell can save a life—and leave the evidence that condemns your coven.

apps.name: Bendy: The Cage
apps.short_description: Escape a twisted prison filled with the darkest experiments gone wrong, now set loose in the shadows to hunt you down. Unleash your deadly axe  in this action psychological horror taking place during the events of Bendy and the Dark Revival®. Fight the madness.

apps.name: Beneath the Grinning Dungeon
apps.short_description: Every step is a curse; every strike, an erosion! Beneath the Grinning Dungeon is a hardcore turn-based Roguelike RPG. Skills stem from gear, and durability is your armor—every attack chips away your defenses. Reclaim the truth of your past before crumbling beneath the endless grins!

apps.name: Betofor: The Split
apps.short_description: Cuba, 1961. At the boiling point. Control both your hands and your mouth in a third-person survival thriller. No rules: drag their bodies, break your leg, cut off your arm, kiss and die. But can you find your Fiancé?

apps.name: Between Floors
apps.short_description: A first-person anomaly-spotting horror game set inside a single elevator. Spot the differences between two contrasting corridors and choose: up or down? A tall figure is hunting you. Every stop could be your last correct call.

apps.name: Beyond the First Star
apps.short_description: Beyond the First Star is a fast-paced 2D side-scrolling shoot 'em up. Choose your pilot, shoot down supply carriers for weapon cards, stack up to four support weapons that fire all at once, and take on handcrafted stages and bosses with unique attack patterns.

apps.name: Beyond The Gate
apps.short_description: Explore a dangerous medieval world inspired by Welsh folklore. Hunt, loot and gather what you can — but return to the safety of the castle before nightfall, or risk losing everything you carried.

apps.name: Bio Inc. Total Defense
apps.short_description: Bio Inc. Total Defense is an incremental tower defense game set inside your body. Command your immune system against massive hordes of viruses, bacteria, and other pathogens. Upgrade your defenses, place them wisely, and fight for every inch of your body.

apps.name: Birdweb
apps.short_description: Birdweb is a multiplayer chatbox game. Do whatever you feel like, hangout with other players, and enjoy the birdweb world.

apps.name: Black Pyramid
apps.short_description: Black Pyramid is an interactive cinematic game largely brought to life by AI‑generated visuals. Cursed by an ancient force, Ethan must venture to the fabled forbidden Black Pyramid in search of his only chance for survival.

apps.name: Blazing Fighter King
apps.short_description: Blazing Fighter King is a chaotic stick-figure brawler for 2–4 players! Grab guns, swing swords, and battle across shaky platforms and tumbling crates. Dodge, snatch weapons, and use the terrain and surprise attacks to defeat your rivals and claim the title of Fighter King!

apps.name: Blazing Strike: R.Evolution
apps.short_description: The fight continues in Blazing Strike: R.Evolution. This handcrafted HD beat 'em up brings Jake and his gang back to the streets to face a new, darker threat. Featuring fluid sprite-based combat, a deep Story Mode, and classic arcade action—handcrafted for the ultimate brawl.

apps.name: Bleeding Nightmare | 血に染まる悪夢
apps.short_description: Descend into the fever dreams of a traumatized young man in a first-person psychological horror game about grief, trauma, and fractured memories. Confront the horrors of your past and find a way back home from Hell. KNOCK, AND THEY WILL ANSWER.

apps.name: Blind Route
apps.short_description: Blind cannot see the route; their teammates must describe it by voice. Communicate as Blind and Guide, survive dangerous 3D obstacle courses, and reach the finish before the rival team in solo, co-op, and competitive online modes.

apps.name: Blobby and the Milkshake
apps.short_description: An octopus stole your milkshake. Why? Who knows! Ride robot crabs, fly fire hydrants, sled in bathtubs, and fight power-hungry pirate clams in this goofy, open-ended 2D platformer. Explore dozens of levels, branch your path, and do whatever it takes to get your drink back.

apps.name: Bloodrune
apps.short_description: Bloodrune is an adventure game where you walk and talk your way in and out of various terrible scenarios. Plunge into Marina's depressing life and do your best to save her from what lurks in the shadows.

apps.name: Bloody Handy
apps.short_description: Get BLOODY HANDY with friends in this comedy-horror co-op for up to 6 players. Search for a list of objects, but each one is dangerous to hold for too long. Pass the parcel along to the exit before they poison, zap or explode you. Don't drop any items, as monsters are also on the hunt!

apps.name: BLOWHOLE
apps.short_description: You're a dolphin. Your job: make everything sparkle by spitting high-pressure water. 1–6 players, seagulls with a grudge, crazy modifiers and absolutely zero professionalism.

apps.name: Bolt
apps.short_description: In Disney's Bolt, players take on the heroic personas of the TV star dog, Bolt, and his owner, Penny, from the high-action television series featured within the film.

apps.name: Boss After Boss
apps.short_description: Boss After Boss is a short incremental game about breaking chests, collecting powerful skills, and taking down increasingly dangerous bosses. Upgrade your stats, unlock higher-tier chests, build stronger skill combinations, and exploit each boss's weaknesses.

apps.name: Boss in Diapers
apps.short_description: Boss in Diapers is a party game set in a chaotic daycare! Defeat your rivals to sit on the Boss Chair. Create your little troublemaker and battle with 2–4 players to rule the daycare.

apps.name: Boss, I Crashed! - Depot Tycoon
apps.short_description: You run a depot. Your drivers run into everything else. Ship pallets across a 3D tabletop map, manage drivers with too many excuses, outplay a rival depot and watch your own disasters on the evening news. Then read the Z report and cry.

apps.name: Bottom Farm
apps.short_description: A cozy idle village that lives at the bottom of your screen. Villagers farm, fish, chop wood and build on their own while you watch videos or work. At night, everyone comes together to protect the fields. Just peek down now and then and watch your little village grow.

apps.name: Bravola: Card Football
apps.short_description: Pick your cards, read your rival, score the goal! Bravola turns football into a tactical card duel: every round you attack or defend with up to five player cards. Manage your club, collect legends and play real opponents live.

apps.name: Breaking Protocol
apps.short_description: Breaking Protocol is a chaotic bullet hell heavily focused on creative boss battles. You will play through different challenges to unlock and customize your build then fight parodies of AI Models in crazy boss fights until you break them! Die. Break. Repeat.

apps.name: BrokenLore: DON'T PLAY
apps.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game where a mysterious experimental video game invades reality. Face five increasingly disturbing levels and survive their consequences as Hideo slips toward identity loss.

apps.name: Buddha's Lotus
apps.short_description: Match lotus flowers through 500 puzzle stages and 96 gardens. Plan each move, unlock artwork inspired by the Lotus Sutra, and save your favorite images. A single-player journey with unlimited retries, 10 interface languages, and no ads or in-game purchases.

apps.name: Build More Tanks!
apps.short_description: Design tanks and defenses piece by piece, collect scrap, and deploy your creations to a multiplayer battlefield where Green and Blue fight for control. Destroy the enemy base, test new designs in Sandbox, or battle in Tank Arena.

apps.name: Bukchon Anomaly
apps.short_description: A first-person anomaly horror game on a looping street inspired by Seoul's Bukchon Hanok Village. You get one photo per passage. At the gate, report whether anything changed. Three wrong reports end your run, and some anomalies come for you before you get there.

apps.name: BUNNY-HOP
apps.short_description:
Unleash speed and skill in BUNNY-HOP. 
Dash through diverse levels, tackle dynamic obstacles, and top the leaderboards. Master bunny hopping and experience high-speed gameplay in this pulse-pounding adventure by Harpoon Studios.

apps.name: Buried Whispers
apps.short_description: A chaotic Social Deduction game where you must collaborate to complete a demonic ritual while secret moles among you work to sabotage it. Wield ridiculous weapons, sacrifice your health to cast votes, and explore fully destructible, randomly generated caves where no two rounds are ever the same

apps.name: Butt Out!
apps.short_description: The neighbors are coming to drag you off the toilet. Feed the hero, combine foods, and aim a flexible pipe in this arcade wave defense game. Unlock new projectiles, stock up on food, build obstacles, and choose your upgrade path.

apps.name: Camera 5
apps.short_description:
Five cameras. Five nights. One caretaker who's starting to notice too
much. A slow-burn surveillance horror where the building lies to you —
and the system does too.

apps.name: Capital City
apps.short_description: Capital City combines city, resource, and transport management within an infinite steampunk fantasy world. Mine resources, build factories and logistics networks. Transport raw and processed materials and goods to your city to ensure it keeps growing and expanding.

apps.name: Caravan Carnage: Fruity Road
apps.short_description:
Bad Fruits have taken over the Roads! Fight off waves of Fruits in this comedic chaotic side-scrolling shooter!
Deliver Cargo, Upgrade your Ride, Hire Defenders, and choose the right Gear to protect your Caravan and survive the Road ahead!

apps.name: Cart Karma
apps.short_description: A co-op brawler for 1-8 players about the people who never put their carts back. Work the store car park, catch shoppers ditching their carts, and knock them out before they drive off. Land it on the chin for a one-punch KO, then work your way up from a corner shop to the biggest lot in town.

apps.name: CarveOut 2160
apps.short_description: Carveout 2160 is a snowboarding game centered around the most dangerous competition in the universe! Because this tournament is not on Earth! Land risky stunts to earn boost, use it to burst into shortcuts or wipeout the competition and rocket yourself around the planets and onto the podium!

apps.name: Castello
apps.short_description: Castello is a third person shooter game centered around a crime story. While progressing through the main story missions, you are also free to explore the open-world city at your own pace. Gunfights, driving, and a variety of unique missions are among the game's core experiences.

apps.name: CastleBonk
apps.short_description: Charge your jump, miss the ledge and fall hard. CastleBonk combines merciless Jump King climbing with Souls-like combat: parry, roll, defeat giant bosses and find out who you were before you woke up at the foot of the castle.

apps.name: CATARACT - Autobattler Roguelite Deckbuilder
apps.short_description: Experience JRPG-inspired autobattles featuring unique combat mechanics. Recruit characters, level them up, choose their skills, loot monsters, and achieve perfect synergy to finally free the realm from the Allseeing's gaze.

apps.name: Catch A Pack: Incremental Card Game
apps.short_description: Open large packs of cards in this 90s nostalgia-steeped incremental game. Build your dream board with super duper rare cards, click frenetically and chain massive combos. Can you catch them all?

apps.name: Chalk Door
apps.short_description: A 1999 museum under renovation has become a shifting nightmare. Team up with up to 4 players, draw passageways with chalk, recover lost research files, and extract before the quota expires in this co-op survival horror.

apps.name: Changeling & The Fae
apps.short_description: Branded a changeling and ordered to hunt a fae, Oisín finds unexpected companionship with a soldier, a quiet boy and a charming troublemaker. An immersive fantasy novel about grief, found family and slow-burning romance, with illustrated environments, character portraits and atmospheric music.

apps.name: Charming Hill
apps.short_description: Charming Hill is a small experimental game where creating beautiful paintings feels easy and natural. No artistic skills are needed; it’s a space to relax, paint, and discover a heartwarming story, or better yet, paint your own.

apps.name: ChemHex
apps.short_description: Crash-landed on a barren planet, you have one way home: chemistry. Fit real molecules onto hex grids in clever placement puzzles, meet the colony's oddball crew, and turn a barren rock into a living world, one reaction at a time.

apps.name: CHICKEN MINE
apps.short_description: Chicken Mine is a 1-4 players co-op horror mining game where you are chickens trying to get rich with your friends.

apps.name: ChobiDevi
apps.short_description: In a forest of endless night live the Chobi, tiny terrified creatures, and the big, scary Devi who carry them away. Rescue the Chobi, lead them home in a parade, and grow your underground burrow from a den into a kingdom, until their courage hatches the giant egg that will bring back the morning.

apps.name: Chopex
apps.short_description: Combine ingredient cards, use kitchen tools, and serve orders before time runs out! Chopex is a pixel art card game where you chop, grill, and plate your way through increasingly hectic kitchens.

apps.name: Christmas Market: Tidy Up Together
apps.short_description: The Christmas feast is over and the harbour market is buried in mess of 3486 objects. Join up to 8 friends as the Night Crew of cozy elves, carry armfuls of plates, baubles and gingerbread back where they belong, and have the snowy market sparkling before sunrise.

apps.name: Christmas Workshop: Tidy Up Together
apps.short_description: The elves pulled an all nighter and the workshop is buried under a mountain of toys! Grab up to 7 friends, climb the pile and put thousands of teddies, trains and presents back where they belong before Santa's inspection. Cozy, chaotic, satisfying co-op.

apps.name: Chromatic Boom
apps.short_description: A challenging, short, colorful, and high-energy arcade game. Move your character, shoot and teleport. You will pass between lasers, cross portals and color the levels as you succeed. A difficult challenge in an experience of just under an hour.

apps.name: Chronime Puzzle: Horses
apps.short_description: Chronime Puzzle: Horses is a relaxing horse tile puzzle game with beautiful steampunk anime artwork. Rotate and arrange tiles in 50 colorful puzzles. Relax with soothing music and cozy, stress-free single-player gameplay. Unlock Steam achievements.

apps.name: City Cab Manager
apps.short_description: Build your cab company base. Take customer calls, gather ride details, negotiate fares, and dispatch drivers. Hire employees, plan shifts, and buy and maintain vehicles. Provide housing, meals, and recreation while balancing customer satisfaction, employee wellbeing, and company profits.

apps.name: Civlands
apps.short_description: Civlands combines elements from legendary RTS titles with epic turn-based strategy to provide a unique hybrid of tactical, real time strategy, with the minutia and depth of turn-based gameplay. Will you be the number one Civ?

apps.name: Cleanup Wizard
apps.short_description: You, a wizard with a mop, fight against computer viruses to save the world! An incremental about cleaning up and collecting viruses to upgrade your mystic abilities to purge the world of this virus once and for all.

apps.name: Click to Medieval Roguelite
apps.short_description: Don't want to play a massive complex campaign? Grow your medieval province with just a few clicks, sell your meager hamlet/kingdom then unlock auto hire workers with incremental upgrades for a more idle playstyle, watch your kingdom grow wealthy and powerful with ease.

apps.name: Climbing Gym Manager
apps.short_description: Build, set and run the climbing gym of your dreams. Shape every wall, reset routes zone by zone, and watch a cosy community grow, where every climber queues, projects, falls, cheers their friends on and tries again.

apps.name: Clipmatrix
apps.short_description: Clipmatrix is a momentum platformer built on classic bhop physics. Slip past the fences of surreal industrial facilities to film illicit, high-speed runs. Just don't forget to press record.

apps.name: Cloudpaws
apps.short_description: CloudPaws is a cozy sky trading adventure where you sail an airship, trade goods, farm, fish, and explore floating islands while helping locals and uncovering their mystery✨

apps.name: Coastline Courier
apps.short_description:
Welcome to Anssoloin's new postman!
After years of hard work, you've finally been able to buy your own post office by the sea.
Learn more about the village and its residents through your work.
Will you be able to fit in your new community?
Sort the mail, discover new things, chat, and relax.

apps.name: Codex Arcana: Grimoire of Monsters
apps.short_description: Summon an army of Monster Girls to face your enemies in strategic battles! Defeat the Dark Lord's minions and expand your collection with cool, fierce and cute Monster Girls of all variety in this "Capsule Monsters" inspired game!

apps.name: CoFishing
apps.short_description: CoFishing is a hardcore fishing simulator built around co-angling. Share your experience, your tackle and your sense of humor. Fight fish that fight back, master real fishing technique, and make the angler yours. Free to play.

apps.name: Colony on the Run
apps.short_description: Start as a single bacterium, multiply into a colony, and race through the human body! Escape white blood cells, evolve, adapt to each organ, and survive the massive antibiotic wave after three minutes in this roguelite action-strategy game.

apps.name: Color Parade
apps.short_description: Color Parade is a cheerful two-player co-op painting adventure! Play as a young painter and an adorable pup: spray paint, leave colorful pawprints, and bring a colorless world back to life. Explore vibrant themed maps, tackle painting challenges together, or face off in playful contests!

apps.name: Columbine
apps.short_description: "One ending leads to the next wish." A story-driven top-down 2D action game with four branching endings shaped by your choices.

apps.name: Companion: Legends
apps.short_description: A strategy auto-battler for 8 players where every creature has 3 evolution stages. Play at your own pace: start a match on PC, continue on your phone or come back later. Pick a trainer, craft items and climb the ranked ladder.

apps.name: Company of Heroes: Blitzkrieg Mod
apps.short_description: Blitzkrieg Mod is Company of Heroes community made modification, which focuses on making the gameplay experience more realistic. Its aimed towards PvP players, but is popular also as a co-op against computer AI.

apps.name: Company of Heroes: Eastern Front
apps.short_description: Eastern Front is a free mod for Company of Heroes which has successfully added a full Soviet faction packed with unique and exciting units as well as the rugged Ostheer, a unique new Axis faction which was designed to counter the Soviets, a feat never before achieved in the Company of Heroes world.

apps.name: Confidence Man
apps.short_description: Run a Ponzi scheme in this turn-based card roguelite. Promise bigger returns, recruit investors, and use new deposits to pay old debts. Take the money or risk one more month. Starting your getaway won't stop the next payout.

apps.name: Corner Pocket: World Billiards
apps.short_description: Play eight billiards games online for free, including snooker and Taiwan 235. Enter Corner Pocket: World Billiards, aim freely, hold to build power and feel every shot. Challenge opponents or invite friends in seven distinct halls, using potting and cue-ball positioning to win.

apps.name: Cosmic Crumbs: Bakery Simulator - First Bite
apps.short_description: Get your first taste of running a bakery in space in this free introduction to Cosmic Crumbs: Bakery Simulator. Bake sweet treats, serve coffee, put your robot helper to work, and adopt a cat — solo or with friends in online co-op for up to 4 players.

apps.name: Crimson Ocean
apps.short_description: Pilot an upgradeable combat boat against swarms of alien harvesting machines in this top-down naval action game. Dodge ramming hulls, unleash guns, missiles, and torpedoes, and turn wreckage into firepower. To them, you’re raw material.

apps.name: Critter Loop
apps.short_description: Critter Loop is a cozy creature-catcher where the catching is all skill and the growing runs itself! Draw loops to nab critters that dodge and charge, then let them build an island economy that earns gold even while you're away.

apps.name: Crown of Sand
apps.short_description: Join the Crusades and forge your destiny in this historical narrative RPG. Become a knight, a man of faith or a powerful merchant. Choose between Saladin and Richard the Lionheart, face moral dilemmas, fight in battles and manage your own domain.

apps.name: Crown's Trial
apps.short_description: Crown's Trial is a Souls-Lite Boss Rush where each battle takes place in a different realm. Master tight combat mechanics to defeat legendary heroes inspired from various historical eras like Ancient Rome, Feudal Japan, the Crusades, and many more.

apps.name: Crusader: No Remorse™
apps.short_description: If you don't have a bad attitude... you don't have a chance. No pity... No mercy... No Remorse.

apps.name: Crush Zone: Demolition Derby
apps.short_description: Enter the arena and experience fast-paced, arcade-style vehicular combat. Wield powerful weapons, use the environment to your advantage, or simply smash your way to victory in Crush Zone—where only the strongest survive.

apps.name: Cubilete
apps.short_description: A dice roguelike where skill beats the roll. In Cubilete your deck is made of die faces: collect new ones, bend each roll your way, and stack poker combos that turn a rough start into a winning hand. Built on a traditional Spanish dice game.

apps.name: Cursor.exe
apps.short_description: An unknown virus has infiltrated your ship. You are CURSOR, the first ECHO intelligence, tasked with containing the infection. Protect critical systems, evade hostile programs, and overcome escalating corruption in this mouse-controlled action-puzzle game.

apps.name: Cutter: Nightshift
apps.short_description: Trapped on the night shift, June investigates the mysterious disappearance of a coworker in a dark, silent office building. Explore, solve puzzles, and face fear as something watches from the shadows. Cutter is an intense, atmospheric first-person psychological horror game.

apps.name: Cyber Survivors
apps.short_description: Co-op survivors-like set in a faceted digital world. Blast geometric swarms with 1–4 players, vote as a squad on the objectives that interrupt every run, and stack weapons, abilities and personal artifacts into a build that melts the screen.

apps.name: D*ckD*cks
apps.short_description: A fun, casual game where you can collect the coolest ducks in the world — for free! Discover unique ducks, try to find your favorite, and play alongside them. How rare can you go?

apps.name: Dark Memories: Investigation
apps.short_description: Dark Memories is an episodic psychological horror game based on road thriller, slasher, and survival thriller genres. You are currently viewing the second episode of the Dark Memories anthology.

apps.name: Dark Type On Tumour Humour
apps.short_description: ?Funny? Typing Game where you run through letters to type out jokes. Errors, Time, HIGH SCORE!

apps.name: Dash To Light
apps.short_description: All you have to do to reach the light is keep moving forward. Along the way you will climb, crash, fall and tumble. Just keep going.

apps.name: Data Center Tycoon
apps.short_description: Build your own Data Center, from a single rack in a garage to a hall full of the latest Hardware. Wire power, cooling and network by hand, keep the machines running, vibe code Products and launch your own AI platform to finance the whole thing. Solo or in online co-op with up to three friends.

apps.name: Date For Dead
apps.short_description: 💘 Match, chat, and date monsters in a dark romantic comedy visual novel where your choices shape your relationships. 🖤 Every match brings you closer to love… or something far more dangerous. You’re not looking for love. You’re trying to bring love back. 🧪💀

apps.name: Dawn Of The Realm
apps.short_description: Dawn Of The Realm is a medieval real-time strategy game. Build cities, manage resources and raise armies.  Zoom straight out to a strategy map of the whole continent and back down to the battlefield, with no loading and no separate mode. Up to 10 players.

apps.name: Daybreak Slam
apps.short_description: Colorful characters clash in this beginner friendly 2D Fighter. Family friendly themes and aesthetics with simple combat mechanics make Daybreak Slam a welcoming experience for new players to the genre, and allow each character to stand out in their own unique ways that veterans will appreciate.

apps.name: Daydream: Prologue
apps.short_description: Little Griffin is trapped in an ominous new world with his only friend, Birly the teddy bear. Solve clever puzzles and encounter terrifying creatures as the pair embark on a journey to discover what lurks beyond their nightmares.

apps.name: Dead Age: Survivors
apps.short_description: Surrounded on a Prison Island! Indie Survival Action RPG inspired by Gothic & Fallout. Complex quests, romances, and tactical combat with a pause mode (like Dragon Age / Final Fantasy 7). Loot, build camps, and conquer territories against 7 greedy factions & zombies! Who can you trust?

apps.name: DEADBOOT
apps.short_description: DEADBOOT is a fast-paced retro roguelike FPS. Blast through randomized levels, scavenge weapons and upgrades along the way, and see how far you can make it in this neon death zone.

apps.name: Dear Reader
apps.short_description: Lumen who discovers that his own words are betraying him. As his writing grows increasingly unfamiliar, his mental state begins to unravel. That is, until he realizes his editor has been slowly twisting his work into an uncanny counterfeit, all under the guise of optimization...

apps.name: Death Blonde
apps.short_description: Steamroll thousands of bio-mechanical creatures, die loud, and repeat. Death Blonde is a neon-soaked vehicular roguelite. Craft insane builds and survive a glowing wasteland that changes every run.

apps.name: Debug Your Heart
apps.short_description: A bite-sized visual novel set in Taiwan's game industry. A love story about making games.

apps.name: Deepfield
apps.short_description: Deepfield is a space RTS where capital ships are your base. Survey a vast asteroid belt, build an industrial fleet, move physical cargo through vulnerable supply lines, and wage wars where every ship, shell and crew member must be replaced.

apps.name: Deepstrata
apps.short_description: Fly a small mining pod down through the rock. Fill the hold with ore, get back up before the fuel runs out, sell it, and buy a bigger drill. Build a base on the surface and hold it when the critters come at night. Luna, Mars, Io and Callisto, with a guardian machine asleep under each.

apps.name: Deluge: Raintime
apps.short_description: Certain things are better left alone, they don't willingly submit to the games of man, but develop a grudge, that sleeps under the soil for decades— An interactive visual novel with psychological and lovecraftian undertones.

apps.name: Delveport
apps.short_description: Build a thriving fantasy harbor, recruit and equip a growing roster of heroes, and push through increasingly dangerous dungeon expeditions in this progression-focused incremental RPG.

apps.name: Demolitors
