apps.short_description: Command powerful Demolitors, battle enemy machines with unique Insignias, upgrade each machine through its skill tree, unlock even stronger Insignias, and defeat formidable bosses.

apps.name: Demoman
apps.short_description: A 3D top-down arena survival roguelite where you blow up environments full of aliens to get your cat back. Your weapons orbit you and fire on their own, so your job is to move, survive and decide what your build becomes.

apps.name: Demra: Rifts of War
apps.short_description: Real-time strategy in the spirit of the 90s classics, with a twist of its own. Build your base, seize mines and lead your army with a spell-casting hero against a demon invasion – or command the demons yourself. 15-mission campaign, skirmish and online multiplayer.

apps.name: desert island time
apps.short_description: On this island, you can grow crops, fish, capture island creatures, mine, chop wood, and craft tools and items. Come explore the island world and experience its peaceful life.

apps.name: Desert Survivors
apps.short_description: Destroy the endless monsters of the desert and break this curse! Choose your character, combine your abilities, and build your own devastating synergies. Can you withstand the ruthlessness of the desert?

apps.name: DeskHugs: Desktop Friends
apps.short_description: Create a human or animal avatar that lives on your desktop. Dress them up, let them keep you company while you work or listen to music, use them as a VTube Avatar or send them to a friend’s screen with a wave, a hug or a little gift. Free to play forever to spread the warmth.

apps.name: Desktop Claw Master
apps.short_description:
Graboo is the shyest claw machine in the world.

Graboo quietly picks up doll friends from the corner of the screen while you're working or enjoying games.

Give warm friends to Graboo, a loner!

apps.name: Desktop Plinko
apps.short_description: An idle incremental plinko game that sits in the corner of your screen while you do other things.

apps.name: Devils Flesh
apps.short_description: Devils Flesh is a survival horror, dungeon RPG where four characters are trapped deep below in the catacombs of a hopeless city. Old cults work in the dark and evil devils’ dwell, whether your character can escape this city alive without losing all of themselves depends on you.

apps.name: Devolution Duel
apps.short_description:
The game of ultimate revenge for 2-4 players. Devolution Duel is a top-down arena shooter where there are no power-ups, only a bunch of unfair power-downs!

Play with friends on the couch or online.

apps.name: Dice Breakers
apps.short_description: Dice Breakers is an incremental game where you break dice, earn rewards, unlock upgrades and automate your destruction empire in this addictive clicker with prestige progression.

apps.name: Dice Dice Battles
apps.short_description: A roguelike dice battler. Shop for strange dice, line them up, and unleash them on a cursed dungeon. Or pit them against other players in async PvP.

apps.name: Dice of Soul：刹那の裁定
apps.short_description: 『Dice of Soul』はチンチロ×ターン制バトルの新感覚ストラテジーゲーム！個性豊かなキャラクターのスキルを駆使し、チンチロの役によって変化する攻撃力を味方につけて勝利を目指そう。知略と豪運が交差するバトルを楽しもう！

apps.name: Dice'n'Go
apps.short_description: Dice’n’Go is a chaotic multiplayer board game where luck starts the turn - but players decide how it ends. Sabotage your opponents, pull off clever ability combos, and turn terrible rolls into game-winning plays. Expect backstabs, dramatic comebacks, and last-turn twists.

apps.name: Dicellion
apps.short_description: Dicellion is the kind of strategy tabletop game you can learn in a minute, take a weekend to master and are still chasing one more chain long after you meant to stop. Six themed stages, endless unlimited and head-to-head battles. How far can you roll?

apps.name: Did You See That?
apps.short_description: A 2 Player Anomaly Horror game where not every player sees the same reality. Explore a carnival trapped in an endless transformation, detect anomalies, verify with your friend if they see the same thing and make the right decisions before the clown Bobby loses his temper...

apps.name: Didgeridoo Man
apps.short_description: An absurd rhythm-arcade shooter: on a green hill, a man performs every note of the soundtrack live on his didgeridoo. Hit your targets, build combos, and whatever you do, don't miss, or he'll literally blow his top.

apps.name: Dimension Jump
apps.short_description: Dimension Jump is a precision puzzle platformer, where you don’t just jump between platforms, you jump between dimensions!

apps.name: Dino Age: Survive the Era's
apps.short_description: Explore one island across three prehistoric eras in a single-player 2D survival RPG. Build your camp, craft better gear and hatch prehistoric companions. Face dangerous creatures and heal fractures in time to open the way forward.

apps.name: Dino Last Survival
apps.short_description: Defend your camp against waves of real dinosaurs, from the Triassic to the Cretaceous. Draw ramparts, build turrets, recruit heroes and hold out until the extraction helicopter arrives — solo or in co-op with up to 8 players.

apps.name: Distance Travellers
apps.short_description: Fly, trade, mine and hunt bounties across a vast open galaxy. Haul cargo between stations for profit, take on bounty contracts, upgrade your gear and buy new ships in a single-player space sim where every long journey counts.

apps.name: DJ till Dawn
apps.short_description: Be a cool DJ and battle crowds in a rhythm roguelite where every beat is a weapon. Build your DJ loadout, unlock new tracks and keep the party alive till dawn to win!

apps.name: Do I Feel?
apps.short_description: Do I Feel is a single-player space action adventure. Fight in third-person dogfights, escort freighters, and upgrade your ship. An old distress signal draws you off the official routes, where a pilot who takes jobs to pay his debts finds a reason to keep flying.

apps.name: Do Not Buy This Game
apps.short_description:
Are you really reading this to find out more? ...FINE!
If you DO buy this game, expect me to narrate in your ear for around 2 hours about your poor life choices,
all while I'll try to create something resembling a game for you to walk around in.

apps.name: DOODLE ISLES
apps.short_description: Everything you draw comes to life. Draw soldiers, walls, cannons and ships, build your castle on your island, then set sail and raid your rivals with up to 4 players. Can't draw? Your wobbly army will still fight. Probably.

apps.name: DOPA-MATCH3: Cosmic Journey
apps.short_description: The best-feeling match-3 game in the universe. Line up three gems and let them vanish with a twinkle. Fill the HEAT gauge and the ultimate combo time begins. Clear the LEVEL, pick an upgrade card, and grow permanently stronger for the long journey ahead.

apps.name: Doujin Shop Simulator
apps.short_description: Manage aadult manga and doujin shop in a Tokyo back alley. Order stock, carry in the boxes, shelve and price every book by hand, serve customers, and grow the shop from one cramped floor into a three-storey otaku store.

apps.name: Draemony
apps.short_description: A dark fantasy action RPG. Choose one of 8 classes, carve through a four-act campaign and an endless endgame of tiered Maps, chase loot, runes and uniques, and face the Xinoqs. Play solo or with up to 6 friends in online co-op.

apps.name: Drako: Blood Heist
apps.short_description: Drako: Blood Heist is an action roguelite set in a world of vampire cats. Hack, mod, farm and fight in a fur-raising attempt to empty the city’s blood banks!

apps.name: DRAVENHORT
apps.short_description: Lead your clan's survivors through a hostile, post-apocalyptic open world. Their lives depend on your decisions. Fight tactical battles, hunt, craft and build a settlement in a sandbox survival strategy RPG. Forge a House, face rival clans, form alliances and shoulder the burdens of regional power.

apps.name: Drone Horizon: Force & Effect
apps.short_description: Design, build and configure your own drones. Brace yourself for challenging environments, discover capabilities and limitations of your vehicle, learn how to overcome them. Experiment with different configurations, flight modes, and control techniques to find the right approach for every mission.

apps.name: Dry Jerky
apps.short_description:
You owe $100 in rent. You have $10. You have 5 days.

Dry Jerky is a survival RPG set in Oasis, a desert city with a rat problem, a shady snack industry, and a cast of characters you probably shouldn't trust. Find work, make questionable decisions, and try not to starve before the landlord shows up.

apps.name: Dub Party
apps.short_description: A dubbing party game where you and your friends turn any video clip into your own dub. Claim the roles, record every line in the booth, then watch the premiere together and save it. Play solo, pass one mic around on the couch, or go online with up to 8 players and five party games.

apps.name: Dude, Trust Me
apps.short_description: Get hopelessly misunderstood by your two best friends. One of you goes blind, one goes deaf, one loses their voice, and no puzzle here can be solved by one person. Can the three of you work out how to understand each other?

apps.name: Dumb Sherlock: The Hot Dogs of the Bakerville
apps.short_description: Cracking cases isn’t elementary when you're Dumb Sherlock, the world’s dumbest detective and last living descendant of the brilliant original Sherlock. Inspect, interrogate, beat puzzles and mini-games and solve a hilarious whodunit mystery in this charmingly hand-drawn 2D point-and-click adventure!

apps.name: Dust to Dust
apps.short_description: Fight for your afterlife in this colorful, action-packed 3D top-down Metroidvania-style game! As a ghost on the run in a specter research facility, sneak around interconnected levels, unlock new powers and team up with the local psychic to turn gigantic foes into dust.

apps.name: Dwarven Village
apps.short_description: Place your dwarves directly on the enemy paths. Keep them alive, level them up, equip them with powerful items, and build towers around them to create your perfect defense.

apps.name: E.G.O. Software Suite
apps.short_description: Superego Inc. presents E.G.O. Software Suite: personal applications built on state-of-the-art inter-universal technology powered by the SUPERᵁ™ Framework. Browse the Universe Wide Web with our flagship Tempest browser or communicate with people across worlds.

apps.name: Earn Your Stripes
apps.short_description: A single-player WWII shooter where you start as a Private and earn command. Fight in battles of hundreds of soldiers on ground generated fresh every time, from the Normandy beaches to the Rhine. Lead a squad, plan platoon attacks on the map, crew tanks and call in bombers.

apps.name: Eat Your Moons
apps.short_description: A baby planet with a face wants to eat your moons. Feed it with a toy tractor beam, raise a colony of tiny critters and build silly machines until the whole world works for its mouth. A 90-minute incremental about looking after someone until they grow old.

apps.name: Echoes on Paper
apps.short_description: In the summer of 2032, fourteen-year-old Lin Haoyang receives a box of old photographs sent by his father from Xi'an. Sorting albums, identifying faces, and completing the family tree, he slowly pieces together a century of memories of an ordinary Chinese family over six summer days.

apps.name: Echoes: A Transmissions Story
apps.short_description: Follow the transmissions of The Creator to guide a curious little robot across a vibrant and whimsical world. Explore, scrap, and craft your way through an emotional story of determination, self-discovery, and finding your place among the stars.

apps.name: EGO DESCENT
apps.short_description: A 3D action RPG about a machine built to fight, descending a hundred floors underground. Take the weapons and parts your enemies wore, rebuild your head, body, arms and legs, and get past the GUARDIAN of each sector to see what lies behind your orders. Online co-op. 10 languages.

apps.name: Elemental Shifter
apps.short_description: Elemental Shifter is a top-down 2D roguelite where you harness the power of 'Elemental Shifting' adapting your abilities based on the last damage you took. Choose your path, battle mages, grow stronger, discover new weapons and defeat powerful bosses on your way to the Mage King.

apps.name: Elevator To Hell
apps.short_description: A co-op survival game where you and your friends (1 - 4) descend through a mysterious facility, facing deadly puzzles and terrors. One elevator ride at a time.

apps.name: Employees Only
apps.short_description: Clean and restock the aisles, unload new deliveries, manage inventory in the backrooms, work harder to grow Fluky profits. Never stop working from sunset to sunrise at Fluky!

apps.name: END US
apps.short_description: In this ruined world, nothing good happens at midnight. We fight, we hunt, we build. We tear from the earth whatever is left, just to buy a few more moments of life. You arrived here believing you were the only one. Maybe you were wrong. Would this be the last night?

apps.name: Endless Summer Syndrome
apps.short_description: You ended the world. She, the one who holds every card, gave you an endless summer as your reward. Now your only way out is through sugar, jellyfish, sunlight, and blood — into the deepest reaches of her mind, or be dissolved along the way. Choose your path in this psycho-thriller visual novel.

apps.name: Epoch Vault
apps.short_description: Restore the lost history of the Mesozoic in an atmospheric idle game. Grow a branching discovery tree, uncover dinosaurs and vanished ecosystems, complete an illustrated scientific Codex, and rebuild the Triassic, Jurassic, and Cretaceous.

apps.name: Eternal Spectre
apps.short_description: In a world where Time is Fractured. Jared Miles navigates a broken reality where every choice reshapes the world, uncovering the truth behind the fracture and deciding what the world ultimately becomes.

apps.name: EternalCircuitBoard
apps.short_description: Place chips on a 6×6 board and build circuits that generate energy. Completed circuits stay on the board, generate energy every turn, and can be reused in the next circuit. Connect circuits within a limited number of turns and reach the target score.

apps.name: Euphausia superba: The Antarctic Krill
apps.short_description:
Swim, let yourself carried with ocean currents, and search for phytoplankton alongside krill, a small crustacean.

Guide a krill on a fascinating journey to reach the ice floe in this relaxing, interactive wildlife documentary.

apps.name: Everbrink
apps.short_description: Everbrink is the turn-based 4X roguelike deckbuilder where you shatter enemy strongholds to join floating islands, and survive. Every turn, the ground behind you collapses. Cards summon units and build structures that gather resources. Grow your deck at Events on the board and storm enemy lines.

apps.name: Evercoil
apps.short_description: Eat, grow and trap rival snakes with your own body in an endless Snake survival game. Open bigger arenas, dodge lava and fireballs, and save your powers for the worst moment. Then race up to three friends online to length 50.

apps.name: Evergain Adventure
apps.short_description: A fast paced 2D roguelite shooter where every weapon has its own passive and active ability. Fight through 3 distinct biomes, defeat bosses, and spend Emeralds on your ship to unlock new weapons, items and skills that make every run stronger.

apps.name: Evervolt Idle
apps.short_description: Start with a small plot in the middle of a forest and a few wind turbines. Sell power to the city, buy the land next door, and work your way from solar to nuclear and on to fusion. Your plants keep running even when the game is closed.

apps.name: Every Pixel Must Go
apps.short_description: Every Pixel Must Go is an incremental destruction game where the goal is to clear every pixel from a dimension through upgrdes and automation. Break apart terrain made up of hundreds of thousands of pixels, pull them into your vortex.

apps.name: Fable of: Hero's Army
apps.short_description: Fable of: Hero's Army is a dark fantasy auto battler card game with roguelite runs and over 200,000 possible card combinations. Choose one of six heroes, gather allies and gear in the tavern, and travel through seven lands. Every run writes a new page.

apps.name: Fallen Gods
apps.short_description: Shape your own saga in a harsh world that changes every game, offering thousands of paths through hundreds of events. You are a fallen god fighting to win your way back home. Whether you prevail will depend on your might, wits, powers, followers, and artifacts—and, above all, on your decisions.

apps.name: Fantasy Cartographer
apps.short_description: Fantasy Cartographer is a relaxing game about creating maps with hand‑drawn graphics. Build lands filled with seas, mountains, and forests, gather resources, develop cities and kingdoms, discover new drawings, complete quests, gain experience, and become a master of cartography.

apps.name: Faultfinder
apps.short_description: She kept the machine that holds the city up for eleven years, and last night it killed her. You have her program and a recording of everything it did. Work back through it until you can point at the line that did it, then prove it. You never write any code, you only read hers.

apps.name: Fear Hour
apps.short_description: Insane mistakes brought you to a life-or-death judgment. Fight off a terrifying Killer, or kill those who trespass on your territory in this tense (1v5) online experience. Where following your instincts might help you escape, or kill them all.

apps.name: Feathered Fortune: Medieval Post Simulator - Prologue
apps.short_description: Run a medieval pigeon post, raise your flock, and take your first steps toward rebuilding the war-torn Kingdom of Melthoria.

apps.name: Felicity
apps.short_description: Felicity is a "live your life" deckbuilder. Choose your aspirations and achieve them to shape your life in unique ways while facing random events! Build your deck and roll dice to manage resources. How much will you be able to achieve in just one lifetime?

apps.name: Feranidus
apps.short_description: A top-down sandbox RPG where the creatures you raise change as you feed them. Hatch eggs, level your team, then chain elemental reactions in real-time fights. Explore, mine, loot, and theorycraft your party. Solo or online co-op.

apps.name: FFS: Football Freekick Simulator
apps.short_description: This is a simple free-kick game in which you kick the ball by literally choosing the contact point, power, and direction between the foot and the ball. There are no hidden stats that magically assist the trajectory for you, so it's actually your skill that matters!

apps.name: Field of Battle 1943
apps.short_description: Fight across land, sea, and air in a World War II first-person shooter set in the Pacific. Capture objectives as U.S. or Japanese forces with infantry, tanks, aircraft, and landing craft. Play online, on LAN, or solo with optional bots.

apps.name: First Fantasy Hentai Studio
apps.short_description: Well, your team of adventurers has suffered an epic fiasco, and now you're left with neither glory nor money. You need to figure out how to get out of this situation. Onlifans haven't been invented in your world yet, but someone has to be the first. And you happen to have hot companions. 🔥

apps.name: Fish on Sale
apps.short_description: Hunt ridiculous sea monsters across uncharted waters in fast, hands-on fishing battles. Master your gear, manage your stamina, and outplay every catch before it escapes. Back in town, read your customers, play the market, cash in on your haul, and gear up for whatever you choose to hunt next.

apps.name: Fishcremental
apps.short_description: Fishcremental is a ridiculously cozy underwater adventure where you catch super cute fish, discover game-changing upgrades, and fill the whole sea with satisfying firework glory.

apps.name: Fishing Nooks: Beaver's Pond
apps.short_description: A painterly fishing game for people who just want to fish. Read the water, pick your lure and fight bass that fight back. No crops, no mines, no energy meter. Chill on the water. Hard on the hook.

apps.name: Fission Mirror Grid
apps.short_description: Drag film cards on a 14×6 grid—facing and dyeing shape every hit. Face-up draws; chain Start, Instant, and End timings each turn. A 54-floor roguelike with four camera travelers, ~100 cards, and 119 relics.

apps.name: Fjordal
apps.short_description: Establish a Norse village and refine the land's resources. Pay tribute to the King, or grow strong enough to fight back. A Viking colony sim with production chains and resource management.

apps.name: Flarefall
apps.short_description: Flarefall is a co-op horde RTS for 1–4 players. Land on the Florida coast, build one shared base by day and hold it by night against the horde, with present-day infantry, armour, boats, helicopters, air strikes and a destroyer's guns.

apps.name: Flirt Simulator
apps.short_description: Forget pre-written options; let your words drive the game! In this first-person dating sim, say whatever you want to AI characters with real memories and get natural responses, and experience a completely unique story every time.

apps.name: Flock Hunt
apps.short_description: A first-person stealth game about taking down mass surveillance cameras and fighting a dystopian future. Every camera you break brings The Flock a little closer. Sneak out at night and destroy cameras with a growing arsenal of tools, sell camera scrap for upgrades, and hire a crew.

apps.name: Flood Descendance
apps.short_description: A unique spin on the delverlike genre. Work with up to 5 other players to solve puzzles, press buttons, and parkour through an abandoned, flooding facility.

apps.name: Foilage TCG : Collectors Edition
apps.short_description: Foilage TCG: Collectors Edition is a single player fantasy trading card game. Build your ultimate deck, open booster packs, trade on the market, and hunt for rare Foil Refractors to take on your opponents. Collect and build your ultimate collection to load your binder and hard cases.

apps.name: Foldvalley
apps.short_description: A cozy pop-up storybook village builder. Lay paper tiles that pop up off the page, welcome villagers home and make their wishes come true. Read your village's story in its own storybook, then build without end on a map that keeps unfolding.

apps.name: Followers of Krow
apps.short_description: Medieval Fantasy RPG Autobattler in a 3D Pixel Art style, where you buy and upgrade abilities to fight monsters and explore to uncover secrets about the world.

apps.name: Follyvale
apps.short_description: A wordless hidden-object puzzle game set inside living medieval paintings. Find what the villagers need, carry it across the scene and set their troubles right, and each one you mend brings the picture into full colour. No timers, no way to fail, and the Fool to help or sometimes get in your way.

apps.name: Foundation: Galactic Frontier
apps.short_description: Command Asimov's OFFICIAL Foundation universe! Live the life as an interstellar trader to exploit your trade routes! Build your starship home, crush enemies in explosive shootouts & outsmart rivals with fleet strategies in epic space wars - with new content expanding your saga!

apps.name: FPS ABILITY TEST
apps.short_description: Shoot, throw, type, hide, close pop-ups. A ten-question exam where “FPS” means something new every time: sniping, grenade lineups, unarmed battle royale, forced-perspective puzzles. Your score decides what comes after. Finish the exam to unlock the Retake, a one-life roguelike 30 floors deep.

apps.name: Fraga
apps.short_description: You are a pilgrim lost in a mysterious forest. Survive in this procedurally generated, turn-based tactical roguelite inspired by Galician mythology. Upgrade your gear, adapt your strategy and remember: something is always lurking in the shadows.

apps.name: Fraggers
apps.short_description: Fraggers is a fast-paced, chaotic first-person arena "bomber" where grenades are your only weapons! Grab your powerups and blast your way to the top of the scoreboard! Bring your friends for explosive split-screen and LAN multiplayer mayhem!

apps.name: Free Lances: Blood for Profit
apps.short_description: A grim medieval mercenary autobattler. Take contracts from either side of a war for the crown, plan each assault and watch it play out in blood, round after round. Pay your men, keep them fed, and stand with the winner when the war ends, or hang.

apps.name: FREESTYLE FPV
apps.short_description: Freestyle FPV is a realistic FPV drone simulator built in Unreal Engine 5. Fly multiple drones across varied maps, customize gravity, weight, thrust, PIDs and more, and choose from beginner-friendly modes or full Acro control for a true FPV experience.

apps.name: Friendly Pharmacy
apps.short_description:
Your next shift is probably fine.
A slapstick co-op pharmacy game for 1–4 players. Decode dreadful prescriptions, operate absurd machines, and get the right medicine to the right patient. When the equipment jams and the paperwork floods in, teamwork is your best treatment.

apps.name: Frontier
apps.short_description: Reclaim an abandoned homestead on an alien world. Build and automate a thriving farm with agricultural robots, then venture into dangerous wilderness to fight hostile creatures, discover new lifeforms, and recover resources that fuel your growing frontier settlement.

apps.name: Frontier Miner
apps.short_description: Frontier Miner is a competitive sci-fi battle royale. Mine asteroids for ore, forge upgrades for your weapons and gear, then race rival players to destroy the pirate space station first. Outmine, outbuild, and outgun everyone to claim the frontier.

apps.name: Fuck Everything 👉👌💦
apps.short_description: Your furniture is hot. Your AI sex doll is confused. And apparently, you have no idea what you're into. Explore your home, meet bizarre women, complete absurd quests, and discover your hidden desires in this wild adult adventure!

apps.name: Fugue's End
apps.short_description: A 2D fantasy turn-based strategy game centered on themes of freedom, and the exploitation of man. Gather those who have been cast aside, and lead them towards a new tomorrow. Now will you have what it takes to break your chains, and defy the divine? Perservere, and find out.

apps.name: FULL YET?
apps.short_description: Start with a tiny cup and bring a dry lake back to life! Carry water, unlock bigger containers and drive water-filled vehicles solo or with up to 3 friends. Work together—or knock your buddy over and spill their water. Every drop counts. Is it FULL YET?

apps.name: Furry Came-a-Lot
apps.short_description: Once upon a time, a horny knight tapped to the beat and came a lot. Conquer rhythm challenges to unlock 70+ uncensored furry videos and recruit sexy dancer bonuses in this lewd fairytale parody.

apps.name: Futanari Hell
apps.short_description: You're finally dead! 🥳 That would be bad news, but in Heaven women have penises 😇🍆 And so do they in Hell! 😈🔥 Fuck angels and demons and decide whether to go to Heaven or Hell 😇😈🍑☁️🔥

apps.name: Galaxy Scavengers
apps.short_description: Mine, build, upgrade, and extract. Scavenge planets in a base-building resource management sim. Gather materials, construct facilities, and order units to survive in a hostile galaxy. Launch your base to the next zone before planetary threats overwhelm you.

apps.name: Gang Birds
apps.short_description: Gang Birds is a turn-based game of bluffing and social deduction for 4–16 players. Uncover secret teams, play unexpected cards and aim at the right bird. Customize your character, question every alibi and decide who you can still trust around the table.

apps.name: Gem Beasts
apps.short_description: Gem beasts is a creature collector, roguelike. Fight and collect other creatures to play as, manage your inventory and explore different build combinations.

apps.name: Genesis Core
apps.short_description: Genesis Core is an idle RPG built around crafting and automation. Send squads farming across hostile planets, process their loot into powerful gear and circuits, and expand your base. Refine your builds, assimilate enemy technology and keep developing your squad through successive campaigns.

apps.name: Ghost Trap: Underworld
apps.short_description: John Ghost is back with a vengeance in this retro-metroidvania. But this time, he's going to hell. Explore the underworld, face its horrors, and fight to bring peace to the tortured souls of your loved ones.

apps.name: GidoGido
apps.short_description: Fuse with your friends into one giant kaiju you all control at once. Together, you're unstoppable! Pick a monster with its own special attack, then stomp through a fully destructible city and clash with rival kaiju in 4v4 party battles. Game nights are back!

apps.name: Glyphforge
apps.short_description: Glyphforge is an magic roguelike with "anime style" spell-crafting. You write and compile nested spell formulas while kiting hostiles across an endless grid. In the most "I cant believe its another survivor-like game" manner possible.

apps.name: Goat's Odyssey
apps.short_description: Just a goat. A boring peg. And a postcard that changed everything. Embark on a surreal journey in a shadow theatre style: from a village garden to lunar craters. Solve absurd puzzles, troll a rooster, and find out if the grass is truly greener on the other side of the universe.

apps.name: GoGeez
apps.short_description: GoGeez is an idle card game about collecting cute little chibi creatures, building your deck, and leveling up your cards. Discover powerful synergies, stack combos, and watch your numbers grow exponentially

apps.name: Goodly Trials
apps.short_description: Hire a storied leader, build a crew around them, bargain for gear, and grow your company to survive your journey home in this tactical auto-battler. Play solo, face a tournament of trials in multiplayer, or team up in co-op.

apps.name: Gooning for Gold
apps.short_description: Your squat squad of 4 top tier ASSthletes are doing their best to achieve new personal records in all categories. Your role, as a hired hand, is to give these perfect figured beauties the competitive advantage they need.

apps.name: Goth Girls vs The Goo
apps.short_description: Run a cozy cybergoth colony where a small crew of goth girls builds, brews, DJs and hosts visitors from other worlds, while a slow, hungry slime ecosystem creeps in from the edges. Open portals, keep the Flux flowing, and find out what the Goo wants.

apps.name: Greenhouse: Dead Sun
apps.short_description: Greenhouse: Dead Sun is a action platformer metroidvania that takes you on a Journey through the worlds Northern Spire. After your 'friend' Calli was called to Northern Sprite you find yourself mysteriously right there with them- What does the Sun have in store for you?

apps.name: Gridiron Foundry Pro Football Manager
apps.short_description: Build your roster, shape your schemes, and call the plays in an original football simulation. Lead one of 32 clubs through drafts, contracts, rivalries, and championships. Run a solo dynasty or compete with friends in a shared online league.

apps.name: GrindFall
apps.short_description: A thrilling Co-op Action Roguelite for 1-4 players! Play as mischievous ghosts, create insane weapon synergies, catch humans, and turn them into pumpkins. Deliver your harvest to the crypt, expand the map, and unleash vibrant chaos in this Bullet Heaven!

apps.name: Grow a Girlfriend
apps.short_description: You accidentally grew a mushroom girl! Overcome your social anxiety to help her live her brief life to the fullest! Or don't.

apps.name: Guild Adventures
apps.short_description: You manage the guild.  The heroes fight.  Recruit new adventurers, send them into monster-filled lands for gold and loot, then improve your guild to push into more dangerous and rewarding challenges.

apps.name: Gymnostia
apps.short_description: Gymnostia is a short story about a basketball player who decides to practice for a crucial game after the school has closed for the night—only to encounter something that defies reality.

apps.name: GymShot
apps.short_description: Four fighters, one free bench. Loot crates, train on gym machines, shop for silly gear and shoot it out in a colorful party shooter that gets wilder every round. For 1-4 players, on one couch or online with friends.

apps.name: Hacker
apps.short_description: Become a young programmer diving into the dangerous world of cybercrime. When the elite hacking collective Dark Shadows challenges you with a series of ruthless trials, you must push your genius to the limit. Will you prove your worth or become another digital casualty?

apps.name: HACKERGAME
apps.short_description: HACKERGAME is a 2D terminal-based arcade hacking game and is currently in the early days of development.

apps.name: Hakoniwa Electric
apps.short_description: "Hakoniwa Electric" is a cute relaxing puzzle game. Explore adorable isometric stages, solve puzzles, and light them up. Why not spend a leisurely year as Akari, who's taken over grandpa's electronics shop, helping with the monthly troubles from the townsfolk?

apps.name: Hamster Special Agent
apps.short_description: Hamster Special Agent is a 2-player co-op platformer! Become two chubby hamsters and work together to deliver cargo through seesaws, lifts, and spinning obstacles. Keep the crate from falling, reach the finish line together, and aim for a three-star clear!

apps.name: Handwriting Fantasy
apps.short_description: A Roguelike card game based on Chinese character rules! Cards are designed according to the meaning of the characters. You can composite stronger character cards, and composite words to enhance their skills. Emergence of unconstrained builds, experience endless fun!

apps.name: HARUKA: Beyond the Stars
apps.short_description:
HARUKA: Beyond the Stars  is a juvenile sci-fi RPG about the intergalactic adventures of the protagonist, Yuuki, and a mysterious girl named Miiya.
Set out on a spaceship and explore unique planets. Enjoy a thrilling adventure in the latest 3D anime art style.

apps.name: Haunted Attractions Inc.
apps.short_description: As the newest ghost manager of Haunted Attractions Inc., you'll build spooky theme parks, hire ghosts, and turn fright into fun in this cozy afterlife sim. One thing's for sure: you won't be bored to death here!

apps.name: Haunted Files
apps.short_description: “The Haunted Files” is a horror game in which you use a computer program to examine a decades-old collection of files containing family photos and find out whether the families in the files are haunted. But the job isn't without danger—the ghosts might turn against you.

apps.name: Heart of Mycelium
apps.short_description: Embark on a perilous journey to fulfill your role as a fungal undertaker! Explore a vibrant pixel art world filled with unique creatures and tight platforming. Let the mycelium guide you as you uncover mysteries deep below the undergrowth.

apps.name: Heartlands
apps.short_description:
A multiplayer sandbox where players create EVERYTHING. 
Design blocks, skins, sound effects, NPCs, and more! Place your creations in a live online world where every creation is player-made.

apps.name: Heat Division: Rescue Team
apps.short_description: Rescue civilians from natural and man-made disasters in this Speedrunning 2D Platformer. Featuring 4 playable characters: Jack Red, John Blue, Jane Orange & Chief Green

apps.name: Hegemony
apps.short_description: 214 states, thousands of regions, and limitless strategic possibilities! Manage your economy, shape politics, forge diplomatic ties, strengthen your military, and shift the global balance of power. Establish your own world order and leave your mark on history!

apps.name: Hell Control
apps.short_description: Customize your demon hunter and fight solo or with up to 3 friends in this third-person roguelite shooter. Choose upgrades as you level up, build your firepower, and destroy the Demon Cores fueling the invasion. Hell won't clear itself.

apps.name: HellDay
apps.short_description: An open-world survival horror game where you explore a mysterious island, build a base, hunt, craft, fight terrifying creatures, and repair a boat to escape.

apps.name: HellRaiders
apps.short_description: A real-time auto-battler roguelite where you build a demon warband, combine role and elemental synergies, and position your team to outthink every battle as you descend through Hell.

apps.name: Heroine's Battle Arena: The Colosseum of Humiliation
apps.short_description: Introducing Heroine's Battle Arena! An undefeated woman who protects her city with her magical powers is about to fall into the cunning trap of an evil organization! Drain her magic through sexual stimulation and weaken her with lewd modifications! Then force her to fight monsters in a secret arena!

apps.name: Hexfall
apps.short_description: Survive endless waves of a dark fantasy horde. Pick one of 8 heroes, stack 23 weapons into an unrecognizable build, and see how deep the night goes before it takes you.

apps.name: Hidden Cats in Beijing
apps.short_description: Explore Beijing and find over 840 hidden objects, including cats and characters. Find Special Cats, unlock 7 bonus stages with two coloring modes, and collect cards featuring Beijing landmarks and real cats from our community.

apps.name: High Yield Warfare
apps.short_description: High Yield Warfare is a modern-era RTS with economy, base building and large battles with a focus on both macro decisions and micro plays, diverse units and hard counters. A full single-player campaign of all 3 factions tells a compelling story.

apps.name: Hillside: Part One - Fractured Lives
apps.short_description: A character-driven adult visual novel centred on deep relationships and emotional storytelling. Experience a grounded, dramatic narrative that builds attachment through character development, intimacy, and evolving personal bonds.

apps.name: HIT: Hold It Together
apps.short_description: Break your rivals apart and hold yourself together in this voxel arena fighter. Battle in 4v4 matches with swords, bows and guns, where every lost block matters. Finish with more voxels than the other team, capture the central cube, or practise against bots.

apps.name: Hitchhiking to Hell
apps.short_description: A hitchhiking journey through empty roads where every car could be your salvation… or your end. Walk through desolate places and encounter bizarre strangers along the way. Talk, decide, and survive unpredictable encounters as rumors of a roadside killer spread. While travelling towards the unknown.

apps.name: Hivetide
apps.short_description: Hold a mining outpost on an alien world while thousands of insects pour through the rock tunnels like a flood. Place towers on the high ground, aim their firing arcs, and spend the biomass from every run, won or lost, on upgrades that let you hold a little longer next time.

apps.name: HOMEPAGE
apps.short_description: A horror anomaly finder where you are contracted to observe websites and report errors and changes. But there is more to your clients than meets the eye.

apps.name: Hoof Trimmer Simulator
apps.short_description: Clean, pare and treat sore cow hooves in a cozy barn. Scrape off the crust, carve satisfying horn curls, find the abscess with hoof testers and release the pressure — then watch your patient walk away sound. Nine breeds, endless cases, oddly satisfying.

apps.name: Hook Her Up
apps.short_description: Weave a heart-shaped hook past divers, mermaids and monster girls, snag them all on the way up and send them flying into your boat. Sail from a sunny lagoon down to the abyss, beat every zone's queen on the line, and unlock each girl's uncensored animated scenes.

apps.name: Hopworth the Wizard
apps.short_description: Hopworth the Wizard is a challenging, colourful 2.5D platformer. A Gargoyle King has taken over Hopworth's Wizard tower while he was off questing. Journey home through forests, hills and mountain passes, leap the King's enchanted boulders and climb the tower to serve its eviction notice.

apps.name: Hotel 13
apps.short_description: The corridor looks the same every time. But does it really? Maybe something has changed. Observe your surroundings carefully.

apps.name: How to Fly a Cannon
apps.short_description: Your cannon isn't just a weapon - it's also how you launch into the air!  Shoot towards the ground and fly skyward in this physics-based destruction game.

apps.name: HRSPWR
apps.short_description:
Get a license, buy a beater, customize it, then fully send it! 
Meet local racers, develop your driving style, dominate the ranks.

Grounded physics, unique boost mechanics, varied game modes, career progression, and online connectivity; HRSPWR is a fresh take on the best of arcade racers past.

apps.name: Hunt The Ducks
apps.short_description: Shoot ducks, grab the cash, upgrade, repeat. Hunt The Ducks is a fast, addictive incremental shooter where you grow stronger every round: turn a calm sky into a storm of feathers and cash with crits, exploding ducks and chain reactions. Grow your hunting map step by step.

apps.name: Hushwell
apps.short_description: An atmospheric 2D metroidvania that leads ever deeper, down through the floor of the world into a sky beneath it. Leap, dash, cling to walls and glide through deep, living scenes, push back creatures with pulses of echo, and face bosses that each fight in their own way.

apps.name: HushWood
apps.short_description:
You are the new ranger of a quiet forest reserve. Carry out your daily duties, explore the dense forest, and document any violations you encounter.
Of course, it's just an ordinary forest. Nothing unusual ever happens here 😉

apps.name: Hyper Tanks
apps.short_description: Choose your tank and fight in neon-lit arenas where shots ricochet off walls! Beat challenging campaigns solo or in co-op, or battle your friends and bots in explosive multiplayer modes. Use powerups, special weapons and tank abilities to survive the mayhem of Hyper Tanks!

apps.name: Idle Ascent
apps.short_description: An idle RPG that lives in a corner of your desktop. Build a party from six classes, shape their skills, and hunt for loot while you work, browse, or play something else. Climb the Eternal Tower and claim a wish that could send you home.

apps.name: Idle Game Dev Studio
apps.short_description: Run your own game studio in this idle management game. Develop and release games, automate the work, and turn your growing catalog into steady income. Give flops another chance, build sequels, then sell your studio for permanent bonuses and start again.

apps.name: Iliad
apps.short_description: Iliad is an adventure Metroidvania that borrows new powers and area unlocks from it's retro origins and weave classic map design mechanic in the gameplay. Travel through two worlds tightly linked together each growing as you discover new secrets and defeat bosses towards one of the two endings.

apps.name: Imoten
apps.short_description:
"Hey, wanna try becoming a god?" 
After saving an angel, introvert Yuki gets pulled into divine training, and the Archangel moves in as his “little sister” to guide him. A warm supernatural romance VN where your choices lead to 4 endings.

apps.name: Impermanence
apps.short_description: A father. A condemned theatre. A son’s voice from beyond. Step into a narrative horror game about grief, obsession, and refusing to let go as a force older than love pushes back.

apps.name: IMPUNES
apps.short_description: Open-world game set in Brazil: explore, steal, kill or simply work. Roleplay-sandbox infinitely expandable.

apps.name: In Search of the Ice Pop
apps.short_description: A short, nostalgic slice-of-life visual novel with a coming-of-age story about a forgotten ice pop and the girl who once felt like a big sister to you.

apps.name: In Us
apps.short_description: Uncover the source. Exorcise it—with friends.A 4-player co-op horror game set in a village overrun by demons disguised as humans. Collect traces, watch the villagers closely, and make use of every item at your disposal. Work together, find the source, and survive the night.

apps.name: Incremental Pain Profit
apps.short_description: Click, topple and profit! Knock over tiny wandering Humans, hire Animals to cause chaos, collect mountains of coins and grow your ridiculous empire. Unlock powerful Rebirth upgrades, defeat Bosses and turn a peaceful board into a glorious mess of falling people.

apps.name: Industry Keeper
apps.short_description:
Tower defense + Factory simulator. 

The rift has opened and its horde marches on your wall. Build towers to hold the line, and a factory settlement behind it to feed them: mine, haul and craft on conveyors, raise your Palace, cast spells and face the guardians of the rift.

apps.name: Infinipop
apps.short_description:
A game about popping bubble sheets with your brain switched off.

Except every rebirth gives you a new way to pop: drag, multi-pop, full-board shatter, one-hit crush. The faster you clear, the more the screen fills with effects.

Ten materials, ten sounds. Twenty board shapes. Endless stages.

apps.name: Ink Drop Brawl
apps.short_description: A 4v4 ink-painting turf shooter. Paint the streets in your team's color, dive into your own ink as a droplet, climb inked walls, and out-splat the other side. Fast matches, wild specials, local MOD support, and online private rooms.

apps.name: Inkfall
apps.short_description: Doodle anything, stamp it to Awaken it, and watch it come alive. Your scribbles take on other players’ drawings in chaotic ink brawls — the sillier the drawing, the funnier the fight. Collect them in your album and let them roam your cozy ink-wash studio.

apps.name: Inside your hole
apps.short_description: Chaotic multiplayer mini golf for up to 8 friends: tornadoes, black holes, falling TNT and a course editor to build your own holes. Plus a co-op story mode where you get reincarnated as a mini golf ball.

apps.name: IntoTheLibrary
apps.short_description: Into the Library is a roguevania where you explore shifting dungeon themes, seal demons, and turn their powers into skills. Combine each character's unique abilities with equipment and artifacts to build your own playstyle and take on the next stage.

apps.name: Invasion of the Number Vegetables
apps.short_description: Explore strange worlds, solve puzzles, and defend Earth from vegetable invaders — all while sharpening your multiplication skills. A single-player adventure from classroom to the stars.

apps.name: Iron Ledger
apps.short_description: A high-pressure management sim where you build a defense contractor from nothing, secure contracts, expand production, manage staff and supply chains, and fight to stay ahead of cash flow, compliance, and collapse.

apps.name: IRON RAIL GIRLS : 最終列車のドライジーネ
apps.short_description:
While converting the armored train (or is it a trolley?) “Draisine” into the “world's mightiest moving fortress,” they embark on a one-way journey (a breakthrough battle) back to their hometown.
A 2D side-scrolling, top-down train shooting game.

apps.name: IRON SOL
apps.short_description:
You do not unlock any abilities - you only learn the truth about what you have always been able to do.
Explore a ruined world, overcome unique platforming challenges, collect remnants of your kin, and discover what you are.

apps.name: Irregular Earnings
apps.short_description: Irregular Earnings is a multiplayer physics crime shooter. Three crews in suits fight over cash, briefcases and secret documents across one city. Trade, steal, cuff and shoot your way to the payout in a world where every body, bullet and car is simulated.

apps.name: IsekaIDLE
apps.short_description: A fantasy idle progression game inspired by deep skill-based systems. Train skills through use, conquer dungeons, manage your settlement, and optimize every system at your own pace, with no prestige resets and permanent progression.

apps.name: Island Shuffle
apps.short_description: Build little islands, your way. Combine buildings and upgrades, enjoy colorful scenery, and watch your score grow.

apps.name: Isotopia
apps.short_description: A fast-paced first-person action game where you explore, fight, and destruct in a fully destructible voxel world, developing skills and uncovering the secrets of forgotten civilizations.

apps.name: Italian Street Food Simulator
apps.short_description: Run your own street food stand in a lively Italian coastal town. Prepare Italian street food, serve walk-up and seated customers, manage supplies and equipment and grow your business day by day in this first-person cooking simulator.

apps.name: It’s Table Time
apps.short_description: It’s Table Time is a cozy tabletop collection featuring classic board games, card puzzles, dice games, and casual arcades—from Chess and Ludo to Texas Hold'em and Tank Battles. Challenge smart AI solo or gather 2–4 players for couch multiplayer fun anytime!

apps.name: IVAN (Iter Vehemens ad Necem)
apps.short_description: A roguelike classic. Gain items of great magic, attain powerful equipment made of mysterious materials, bathe in the blessings of mighty gods and recruit loyal allies of various shapes and sizes.

apps.name: Jackshot
apps.short_description: JACKSHOT is a 2-4 player FFA online first-person shooter featuring fast-paced arcade combat, weapon pickups, and a slot machine-inspired upgrade system. Build your character between rounds and use powerful bonuses to gain the upper hand. Just don't get cursed!

apps.name: Jaded Jade Jayden
apps.short_description: Help Jayden get rid of those pesky workers that entered princess Yunlong palace uninvited!

apps.name: Jba Fofi
apps.short_description:
"My husband and I came across a huge eight-legged creature on a jungle trail in the Congo. It's been an hour since he got out of the car and went looking for the spider to photograph it...

Should I go look for him?"

apps.name: Joe & Mac Retro Collection
apps.short_description: Fight huge dinosaurs and crafty cavemen while looking for the tribe's kidnapped damsels in this retro collection featuring the three Joe & Mac SNES games!

apps.name: Judicial Designer
apps.short_description: A management and tycoon game where you build and manage a courthouse. From a small-town traffic court to handling high-profile criminal cases. Build your courthouse, hire and manage staff, schedule cases and balance the pressures of efficiency and reputation.

apps.name: Just Beat It
apps.short_description: Weave through bullet patterns set to music. Use an invincible dash to break through danger, skim past bullets to score, and push for a better run in this single-player bullet hell action game.

apps.name: JUST PRESS SPACE
apps.short_description: JUST PRESS SPACE is a brutal pixel-art souls-like, roguelite where one button controls everything.

apps.name: Kamikaze Aliens
apps.short_description: Welcome to Kamikaze Aliens, a game with no big bosses or awe-inspiring enemies—just you, your ship, and an endless horde of aliens spawned from randomized spawners that will make you see stars at the slightest touch!

apps.name: Karting of Banban
apps.short_description: Grip your steering wheel and join your favorite Banban characters in the race of a lifetime! Drift around tight corners and zoom through locations both old and new. Use power-ups and boosts to dodge your opponents and claim first place!

apps.name: Keg & Crypt
apps.short_description: Build and run a fantasy tavern, solo or with up to three friends online. Brew ale and cider, cook hearty meals, and serve guests who remember you. Then venture into the Drowned Abbey for combat and loot.

apps.name: Kidnapped Simulator
apps.short_description: Kidnapped Simulator is a first-person psychological horror game where you write your own replies to the serial killer holding you captive. Your words shape the encounter as you search for a way out.

apps.name: KidYouNot!
apps.short_description: A 4-10 player improv party game about defending yourself against absurd accusations, deceiving your enemies, questioning other defendants on their turn, and strategically voting to exonerate allies and convict enemies at the final verdict reveal. Or you can be the judge and control the courtroom.

apps.name: Kill A Million Zombies
apps.short_description: One city. One million zombies. Clear the streets in this incremental first-person shooter. Buy upgrades, watch your kill count climb, and keep going until it hits 1,000,000.

apps.name: Kill the Thing
apps.short_description: Kill The Thing is a challenging turn-based tactical RPG. Keep the corruption under control while searching for its origin. Undertake missions across four distinct regions, targeting key resources, upgrading your base, and building your roster of heroes. For the final confrontation.

apps.name: Kingdom of Poland: 1410
apps.short_description: A realistic RPG set in Poland in 1410. Discover a world of history, survival, and struggle, leading to one of the greatest battles of the Middle Ages - the Battle of Grunwald.

apps.name: Kingdom Puzzles
apps.short_description: A BOSS RUSH of logic puzzles—a feast for the mind. Explore a castle, tackle puzzles, collect treasures, and defeat the King! The kingdom's puzzles always put you in the toughest possible situations. Careful reasoning is your key to success. Welcome to Kingdom Puzzles!

apps.name: Kingdomsweeper
apps.short_description: A kingdom-building minesweeper. Defeat monsters, free ruins and restore each part of the kingdom to its former glory in a logic based adventure where each map and puzzle brings new challenges and strategic choices.

apps.name: Kinmen Kill
apps.short_description: Kinmen Kill (金門殺) is an FPV combat drone simulator. Scout, strike, and battle PLA forces as you defend Taiwan with realistic flight controls and advanced physics built for true-to-life handling.

apps.name: Kisaragi
apps.short_description: A third-person shooter horror game inspired by the unsettling Japanese legend of the non-existent Kisaragi Station.

apps.name: Knights & Nonsense
apps.short_description: Knights of Nonsense is a social game with a mini RPG element to it. Run around with your friends using voice chat in a castle playing minigames, throwing tomatoes at who you hate most, role play, PVP and more.

apps.name: Konbini Shift
apps.short_description: A shop-sim puzzle game about running a Japanese convenience store. Drag runs of matching goods off the shelves to fill orders, then cook what you sell in the kitchen out back. VIPs and the panic clock force you to spend powerups wisely and clock out with the day banked and your manager's ask filled.

apps.name: La Bidouillerie
apps.short_description: A real electronics simulator: build robots, a 1970s pinball table and a 1980s dart machine from real parts (solenoids, gears, connecting rods, relays, transistors). Wire the circuit, switch on, find out why it won't run: every current is computed, every fault has a cause.

apps.name: Laica
apps.short_description: Live with Laica, a mysterious girl alone aboard a drifting space station, and explore the nightmare spreading beneath your quiet days together. A first-person sci-fi adventure that fuses survival horror with a slow-burn relationship. Is what waits ahead love, or despair?

apps.name: Lantern Hearth
apps.short_description: A cozy 2D MMORPG in the spirit of the classics. Build your hero stat by stat, party up against bosses, raise loyal pets, and keep your World's lantern burning when the shadows come.

apps.name: Last Couriers
apps.short_description: Dive into the post-apocalyptic Zone in this fun co-op extraction action! As fearless couriers, harvest anomalous hogweed, craft batteries, and power up teleports to proceed. But your loot attracts infected enemies you can't permanently kill... Сan you hold the line and escape in time?

apps.name: Last Stop in Valley Thierne
apps.short_description: Investigate, interrogate, and connect the pieces to uncover the truth behind the strange and unusual events of one unlikely summer morning.

apps.name: Launch Window
apps.short_description: Launch Window is a single player physics-based automation game where you establish supply chains across an entire solar system using orbital mechanics.

apps.name: Launched!
apps.short_description: Launched! is a small scale RTS about building and launching an arsenal of missiles at the other island in the distance.

apps.name: Leave It to the Ladies! ~ Sandwiched Between My Dorm Manager and My Boss~
apps.short_description:
You, a young salaryman, move to a company dorm alongside two older women: Kaho, the dorm manager, and Reina, your supervisor. As your relationship grows closer, things take an... interesting turn.
A rom-com visual novel where you're doted on, pursued, and fought over by two older women!

apps.name: Left for Clean
apps.short_description: Left for Clean is a cozy incremental game where you collect garbage, turn a trash-filled town into a tidy little place! Load your truck, and drive to the dump. Earn coins, unlock skill tree upgrades, and keep your tank fueled as you clean up the town.

apps.name: Left In The Forest
apps.short_description: An abandoned dog searches a mysterious forest for his owner. Follow scent trails, uncover memories, and discover the story of a bond that refuses to fade.

apps.name: Legacy of Legend
apps.short_description: Face-down bluffing and piercing strikes! 1v1 tactical turn-based card battle.

apps.name: Legend of Dick
apps.short_description: Legend of Dick is a third-person 3D martial arts action RPG. Rise from mocked rookie to martial hero, forge your own fighting style, battle mythical beasts, and find friendship and romance. Your choices determine who stands beside you against the Demon King.

apps.name: Legend of the Godslayer
apps.short_description: The world has fallen into an age of darkness. Creatures of the abyss emerge across the land, sent by the Gods to bring about humanity's destruction. But amidst the chaos of the battlefield, a legend rises—the Godslayer.

apps.name: Legends of Castile
apps.short_description: To fulfill her dream of becoming a nun, María de Salazar must outsmart the creatures of Castilian folklore using her wit and a mysterious bestiary in this comic fantasy point‑and‑click adventure set in 19th‑century Spain.

apps.name: Let 'Em Cast
apps.short_description: Let 'Em Cast is an action roguelike for 1–4 players where wizards battle hordes of everyday junk brought to life. Craft your own devastating spell combinations and blast your way across the fragments of a shattered magical world.

apps.name: Letter Dragon
apps.short_description: You're a bumblebee dragon with a delivery service. Explore an open world full of tropical islands while you deliver mail in this short adventure!

apps.name: LetterZ: The Paths of Letters
apps.short_description: LetterZ: The Paths of Letters - is an automation game where you extract, transport, and assemble letters to form words. Optimize your production lines, unlock new possibilities, and build your factory, one letter at a time.

apps.name: Liar's Poker
apps.short_description: A bluffing card game for four. Claim a hand that might be hiding in everyone's cards or call the last player a liar and turn the whole table over. Invite friends, practice against bots or an AI opponent, or climb the ranked ladder. About ten minutes a game.

apps.name: Liar’s Dice: Queens of Sin
apps.short_description: Bet, bluff and call it at a liar's dice table against three Queens of Sin. Use cheat cards and relics to tilt the game, and unlock the story with every win. A game of bluffing, seduction and mounting tension.

apps.name: Life Containment Unit
apps.short_description:
Life Containment Unit is a time and resource management survival horror game set in a post-apocalyptic bunker.

Struggle to survive against the creatures invading your L.C.U. and the rogue corporate AI that designed this accursed vault system.

apps.name: Lightly Played
apps.short_description: A card-collecting roguelite about opening packs and grading cards. Spend ten days at the night market buying packs, ripping them open and sending your best pulls to the graders, then watch every card you own pile damage up at the other collectors.

apps.name: Limes Must Burn
apps.short_description: The Roman Empire is crumbling. Caught between Rome and the Germanic tribes, forge your own path. Lead a band of warriors through brutal turn-based battles, forge alliances, and make difficult choices in a world torn apart by war and betrayal

apps.name: Liminal Depths
apps.short_description: Liminal pixel horror in an endless place. Wake with no memory, keep the safehouse powered, take jobs from the terminal, and avoid what's waiting past the light. Recover who you are and escape before the Depths take you. Solo or local co-op.

apps.name: LINKODE
apps.short_description: Guide a cute cat to organize cookies in this fun, logic-driven puzzle game! Connect nodes to solve challenges from basic levels to a free-play Sandbox. Enjoy a visual scripting system where you naturally pick up real coding concepts along the way—no prior knowledge needed!

apps.name: Little Cat Goes Fishing
apps.short_description:
This is a relaxing and cozy auto-fishing game.
Choose your character, prepare your fishing rod, cast your line, watch the fish bite, collect your catches, and build your own fishing journey step by step.

apps.name: Little Heart AI-2055
apps.short_description: Rapid advances in AI have sparked a wave of unemployment—and you are one of those left without a job. Your story begins at a black market, where you meet an outdated AI destined for destruction. Left behind by a changing world, humans and AIs find warmth in one another and slowly become a family.

apps.name: Little Supermarket
apps.short_description: A cheerful supermarket game for kids ages 3–6. Shop with animal friends, scan groceries, count coins and enjoy 12 playful mini-games. Collect stickers and decorate your little store, with picture shopping lists and friendly voice prompts.

apps.name: Logic Arrows
apps.short_description: Logic Arrows is a sandbox game where you design your own mechanisms: from logic gates to an entire computer. Use simple elements to build complex systems, solve engineering challenges and master computer logic.

apps.name: Lord of Kensai
apps.short_description: Command the seasons. Conquer rival factions. Build your legacy in the Katana-Ra universe. Lord of Kensai blends accessible city-building with deep, strategic mastery. Will your metropolis endure the shifting tides, or crumble under the weight of history? Ascend to power—your city awaits.

apps.name: LordRise
apps.short_description: A desktop idle RPG in a small window. While you work, your knight hunts swarming monsters, collects gear and spellbooks, and strives for higher noble titles in Title Challenge.

apps.name: Loreth
apps.short_description: A Roguelike strategy game set in the Loreth Academy, where you play as a student god researching civilizations, ecosystems, heroes, demons, and the laws of the world through powerful symbol-building simulations.

apps.name: Losers Club
apps.short_description: Losers Club is a multiplayer trivia game for you and your friends. Pick a question pack, test your knowledge, race to answer first, and compete for the top spot. Create your own quizzes, customize the rules, and turn any game night into a battle of brains.

apps.name: Lost in the Roots
apps.short_description: A 2D adventure with psychological thriller elements exploring guilt and fear. A young girl wakes in a stranger's attic, lost in the middle of nowhere. Who took her—and why? With no way out and something lurking in the shadows, escape may be just an illusion.

apps.name: LOST ZION
apps.short_description: Lost Zion is an atmospheric cyberpunk horror game. Awakened by a faint signal as a SERVICE BOT, explore the forsaken megacity of Lost Zion. Uncover the Emperor's horrific secrets. Obey your sole command: ACTIVATE THE GRAVITY CORE!

apps.name: LOVE COMPANY: A Romance Escape
apps.short_description: Love leaves clues. Join LOVE COMPANY, a company that delivers feelings of love. Inspect objects, follow emotional traces, and solve puzzles to uncover the truth behind those feelings in this first-person romantic mystery escape-room game.

apps.name: Low Level Hunters
apps.short_description: Low Level Hunters is a low-poly, cold war era helicopter combat flight simulator. Pilot Cobra attack helicopter, Huey II utility helicopter, or MD-500 Defender by directly interacting with switches and control devices using mouse, joysticks, and VR controllers to defeat ruthless rebels!

apps.name: Ludo Wala 3D & Action
apps.short_description: Play Ludo, Snakes & Ladders and Stairs in 3D with 2 to 4 players. Share a screen for local play or meet friends online across PC, mobile and browser. Throw toys, send reactions and choose your table's look

apps.name: Lumen Keeper
apps.short_description: The swarm carries your base’s fuel. In this action roguelite with tower defense, build turrets by day and fight at night as a small robot. Kill enemies and bring back their Lumen to fuel the light. When fuel runs out, the fog eats away at your buildings.

apps.name: Lumi: A Cat in the Mist
apps.short_description: Lumi returns to find her village lost in mist. Ghosts linger where the villagers once lived. Creep through bushes, scramble over rooftops and let your magic amulet lead you into trouble. Solve puzzles to help lost spirits find peace. Keep out of reach of the rest.

apps.name: Lumina Cube
apps.short_description: Arrange glowing cubes into a Lumina Circuit and watch Yura fight on her own. A dreamlike, bittersweet pixel-art hack-and-slash where every cube you find makes her a little smarter.

apps.name: Lust Mansion
apps.short_description: A storm strands you at Lust Mansion. Cassandra, the owner, offers you a bed. Elvira, her maid, offers you a bath (and a hand!). And Sophia, Cassandra's sister, plays the piano in the basement and dares you to tie her up. Find out why they were all expecting you.

apps.name: Magical Girl Otometia: Exposed on Live Stream!
apps.short_description: Following the instructions of her senior, Arcana, Otometia throws herself into the battle against the evil organization Nonotex.However, Arcana is in fact the true leader of that very evil organization.And their battle against Nonotex is being broadcast nationwide.

apps.name: MagicTower: Dreamweave
apps.short_description: A turn-based RPG reimagining the classic MagicTower formula. Explore a multi-floor tower, gather keys and coins, battle monsters in turn-based combat, and wield the "Dreamweave Stone" to reshape dreams and solve puzzles as you uncover the truth behind the Demon Lord and the princess.

apps.name: Managing Up
apps.short_description: A darkly funny office idle-management game. Play the boss's loyal "scab": recruit workers, pack the desks, arrange your teams, and squeeze your colleagues for every last drop of KPI. Play Managing Up, and claw your way up the corporate ladder!

apps.name: Marceline Magpie: Forgotten Culprit
apps.short_description: Discover a strange secret on forgotten abandonware and save a girl from a vanishing kidnapper in this unique puzzle box point and click adventure mystery.

apps.name: MARINES VS GOD
apps.short_description: One of you is God. Up to four friends are Marines on a mission. Finish the objective before time runs out while your friend summons monsters, drops meteors, and ruins your plans. Can the Marines outsmart God?

apps.name: MAT
apps.short_description: MAT is modern chess on a hex board: five asymmetric races, unit abilities, traps and not a single dice roll. A match takes 5–10 minutes.

apps.name: Materia
apps.short_description: Materia is a top-down sci-fi ARPG set in a vast, evolving galaxy. As a skilled Pilot, explore dangerous Rifts and Vaults, battle colossal World Bosses, and customize your character with the Cosmic Augmentation System. Team up or compete in PvP to shape the future of the Stellar Frontier.

apps.name: Math Combo Chain
apps.short_description: A tower defense where ammo is limited and math is your reload.

apps.name: MEATBALL the MITE
apps.short_description: MEATBALL THE MITE is a Metroid-inspired platforming game where you explore the colossal, labyrinthian remains of a decaying creature. Collect upgrades, go toe-to-toe with gnarly threats, and claim victory over the rot on your quest to grow stronger. Do you got the guts to survive in these guts?

apps.name: MEATRASH
apps.short_description: In this city, implant contracts outlive their owners. In an underground processing facility, dissolve the "waste" delivered each morning and recover the implants buried inside. A first-person work sim. Deliver them for pay, or borrow a few for yourself and others?

apps.name: Mega Beast!
apps.short_description: A epic action arcade reverse horror arcade compilation

apps.name: Memory Games Ants
apps.short_description: This game is a memory game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

apps.name: Memory Games Aquarium Fish
apps.short_description: This game is a memory game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

apps.name: Memory Games Dragonflies
apps.short_description: This game is a memory game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

apps.name: Memory Games Fairytale Birds
apps.short_description: This game is a memory game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

apps.name: Meowinks Tidy or Else
apps.short_description: Sort thousands of collectible toys during the night shift at a mysterious toy store. Complete collections, organize shelves, unlock upgrades, and enjoy the satisfaction of putting everything in its place. But be careful... something is watching you.

apps.name: Meowward
apps.short_description: Build a tower to rescue a cat stranded on the Moon! Chop trees, turn logs into wooden blocks and upgrade your equipment. Play solo or with friends, climb onto each other's shoulders and carve your own decorations. A cozy building sandbox with one very important cat.

apps.name: Mercenary Galactic
apps.short_description: Synergize your fleet and fight your way toward the notorious Blackstar! Mercenary Galactic is a starship autobattler featuring rogue-lite elements and powerful fleet customization. Upgrade, recruit, and optimize your way through Velle and beyond.

apps.name: MESA
apps.short_description: MESA is a 1-4 player co-op horror game. Play as a patient as you traverse and escape from the facility that you are being held at while avoiding or fighting enemies that may be real or an illusion.

apps.name: Metal Naval Combat
apps.short_description: The seas rose. One island still stands. Build a war factory from a single robot, automate your entire war economy, and hold the coast against saturation strikes of cruise missiles, drone swarms and ballistic warheads - then strike back across the sea with missiles, dropships and mechs.

apps.name: Mictla
apps.short_description: A challenging Puzzle Roguelike Deckbuilder inspired by Mesoamerican mythology where strategy is everything. Hard to master. Impossible to forget.

apps.name: Midnight Yakiniku | 深夜焼肉
apps.short_description: A psychological horror game set in a yakiniku restaurant in Japan. As the owner, you open the restaurant and welcome customers as usual. But that night, orders begin arriving from Table 7—a table that shouldn't exist...

apps.name: MimiCreate
apps.short_description: Even aliens have exams! In MimiCreate, Mimics must learn to hide among humans before earning a license to visit Earth. Build disguises, blend in, and dodge the Inspectors in chaotic multiplayer hide-and-seek.

apps.name: MineEngineer
apps.short_description: Build physics-driven ships and automated factories block by block in a 2D space survival sandbox. Mine planets and asteroids, program machines, explore a hostile universe and survive solo or with friends.

apps.name: Minesweeper FPS
apps.short_description: Minesweeper, in first person. Step onto the board deep in dark, ancient ruins, read the glowing numbers, and dig with your pickaxe. Just don't hit the wrong block.

apps.name: Minesweeper Survivors
apps.short_description: Minesweeper meets roguelite survival! Reveal tiles and flag mines while your weapons tear through enemy hordes. Collect artifacts, create powerful builds, defeat bosses, and upgrade your arsenal between runs.

apps.name: Minesweeper: Retiled
apps.short_description: Rediscover Minesweeper across 100+ geometric tilings, from familiar hexagons to extraordinary non-repeating patterns. Solve no-guess puzzles, team up or race friends over LAN, customise your boards, and share your best games as images, animated replays or videos.

apps.name: Mini Mart Survivors
apps.short_description: Survive 10 minutes on the night shift at SHIFT24, where cup noodles, snacks, and coffee turn the aisles into a bullet heaven. Fight off nightmare customers, pay off your debt, and uncover what SHIFT24 is hiding in this survivors-like roguelite.

apps.name: MINIKIN
apps.short_description: A hidden-object party game for 1 to 4 players. Find the right Minikins before everyone else, challenge your friends or team up with them, and unlock stickers, characters, and more rewards along the way.

apps.name: Ministry of Order
apps.short_description: Inspect the parents’ medical record and match the newborn who can only be theirs — that is the day’s work in this 1920s dystopian puzzle. A fire burned the birth records, and the Ministry put you in charge of giving the children back. Your choice goes into the report.

apps.name: Money Laundering Raccoon
apps.short_description: A gang of raccoons have decided to start a money laundering business. There's just one problem: they misunderstood what "money laundering" actually means. Now they've got a laundromat, a suspicious amount of cash, and absolutely no idea what they're doing.

apps.name: Moon-Oriented Autonomous Biological Model
apps.short_description: When I was sunken in a deep depression, I set off on a journey.

apps.name: Moonberry Hollow
apps.short_description: There’s a place for you at Mallow’s picnic. Search ten painted woodland scenes for little lost treasures, from the rainy bakehouse to the lantern-lit stream, in a hidden-object story read by a gentle British narrator.

apps.name: MoonBurn
apps.short_description: Hand drawn. Fire fueled. MoonBurn is a twin stick shooter where you carve through hostile creatures, shape your weapon to match your style, and push deeper into a strange alien world.

apps.name: Moonlit Journey:  Homestead
apps.short_description: Purchase your homestead, master unique skills, and uncover hidden secrets in a cozy top-down farming RPG where the world transforms through all four seasons.

apps.name: Mortal & Dao
apps.short_description: Wen Dao Fan Chen is a dynamic cultivation sandbox RPG where every choice shapes a living world. Begin as a mortal, build sects and kingdoms, master ancient arts, and fight with five-element tactics. Save the world, rule it, or embrace forbidden cultivation.

apps.name: Mosaique Neko Waifus 6
apps.short_description: Solve rotating puzzles with cute cat girls. Cozy, soft-incremental gameplay. Chat With Cat Girls. Somehow Get Better at Puzzles. Make Questionable Choices. Unlock Surprisingly Useful Stuff.

apps.name: Motive Power
apps.short_description: Run British Railways' locomotive fleet from 1955 to 1994. Order the classes history built — or take your own choices. Manage overhauls, depots, budgets and withdrawals across four decades, and answer for it in a graded annual report against the real record. Deterministic, deeply researched.

apps.name: Motorbike Dealer Simulator
apps.short_description: Run your own motorbike dealership in the heart of the city. Order bikes and riding gear, stock your showroom, set prices and haggle with buyers at the counter. Grow from a small garage into the city's top dealer with licenses, expansions and staff.

apps.name: Mr. Hangman
apps.short_description: You are Mr. Hangman's latest victim! In this dark and thrilling roguelike you must use a combination of your wits and life-saving powerups to defeat his twisted version of the classic word game, hangman. Can you make it out alive?

apps.name: Munchie Strikers
apps.short_description: A Group of ambitious jinn from antagonistic realms fight tooth and nail to snatch the ball, score against their opponents and determine who would become the ruler of the Earth.

apps.name: MUPO
apps.short_description: Grab your keyboard and jump into the rhythm in MUPO. This fast-paced rhythm game is driven by skill, creativity, and community. Build maps, climb leaderboards, and shape the game’s future. And there’s so much more to come, stay tuned. Be part of the MUPO journey!

apps.name: Murder Mystery Online
apps.short_description: A first-person 3D online murder mystery for you and your friends. Each player takes a role, walks the same crime scene, hunts for clues, and argues their way to the truth. Start with a free case. For paid episodes, one player buys and the whole group joins.

apps.name: Murmurs of Fear - A whisper of loneliness
apps.short_description: Murmurs of Fear is a psychological horror about those left alone with the unexplainable. It is a self-contained story about fear, isolation, and the struggle to stay sane as reality itself begins to fracture.

apps.name: Mushrooooooom
apps.short_description: A numerical incremental game about spreading spores. There are mushrooms aplenty here, giving you countless ways to take root and spread across procedurally generated planets. Cross the seas, burrow underground, climb into the clouds, and turn the entire map into your own color.

apps.name: Muv-Luv Girls Garden
apps.short_description: The latest Muv-Luv title, with over 800,000 copies sold worldwide! Become an amnesiac commander and lead girls piloting giant humanoid machines called "MGs" in this full-auto idle RPG. Explore the underground abyss known as the Maze and uncover the hidden truth behind the world.

apps.name: My roommate is a What ?!
apps.short_description: Luana, your futanari roommate, doesn't follow a script. In this uncensored adult life-sim, she evolves from your choices, day by day, into someone submissive, exhibitionist, or dominant. Who will she become?

apps.name: My Secret Lake
apps.short_description: Catch drifting seeds, click to watch them bloom, and grow a secret lake garden right on your desktop. My Secret Lake is a cozy idle game whose plants keep growing while you work, study, or unwind, floating over your own wallpaper or under a sky of its own.

apps.name: MyDear.exe
apps.short_description: Celebrate love with Ellie and Lucien in MyDear.exe. A short and cute game that takes place in the folders of an old PC. In the shoes of Ellie, play the game offered by Lucien after a long life together. Humor, memories and love are on the menu of this short ~2 hours experience.

apps.name: MYELORIFT
apps.short_description: A third-person action roguelite inside a cosmic creature. Become Lume: face waves of enemies, absorb random grafts and alter the monster’s organs. Reach the Core and sever the Black Signal transmitting Earth’s coordinates.

apps.name: MyGame
