apps.short_description:
这是一款第三人称俯视角动作射击游戏。你将扮演孤胆英雄，在无尽的敌人浪潮中浴血求生。
游戏核心循环简单爽快：击败敌人获取经验，升级即可从海量技能中随机解锁强力武器与天赋。通过不同的搭配，构建出独一无二的战斗流派，体验割草的快感。
除了局内的策略组合，你还可以通过局外养成系统永久提升角色属性，挑战更强大的关卡与 Boss。
游戏特色：
独特的第三人称镜头，战斗沉浸感十足
超 20 种技能与被动天赋，自由组合策略流派
丰富的局外养成，打造无敌角色
5不同难度的生存挑战
准备好在怪物中杀出一条血路了吗？

apps.name: Myriad: Radiant Frontlines
apps.short_description: Join Joan of Arc in a free desktop idle RPG. Collect heroines, build a team, farm gear and battle mythic bosses. Give gifts, grow closer and collect intimate artwork and private photos. Keep battles in a desktop corner, use a 25-minute focus timer, and play offline.

apps.name: Mystic Fog Maze
apps.short_description: A casual puzzle game where the player navigates through endless mazes surrounded by a mysterious fog.

apps.name: Mystical II: Forgotten Knowledge
apps.short_description: Forgotten knowledge sleeps in five mystical realms. Buy the falling objects for a gold coin each, gather trios and pairs in your bag, then reveal them with the magnifier before a column overflows. 50 stages, 216 painted objects: a medieval puzzle game.

apps.name: Mythalia
apps.short_description: Build your team and challenge the tower in this turn-based roguelite monster catching game. Unlock new beasts and upgrades as you play, discover mutations and champions in the 2v2 designed system.

apps.name: NAILONG BATTLE
apps.short_description: Nailong Battle is a lighthearted 2D survival shooter. Your round Nailong auto-fires at endless waves while you dodge, growing stronger with gold and XP. Pick two of five active skills, then take on bosses and Steam leaderboards.

apps.name: Necromarch
apps.short_description: A reverse-survivor where the army is the weapon. Raise skeletons, ghouls and wraiths from what the living drop, watch them lock into ever-widening rings around you, and hold the night.

apps.name: Necrosurge
apps.short_description: A roguelite reverse tower defense game. You are the necromancer, and for once the Inquisition has to defend. Before each raid you set up your horde on the battlefield. Then your undead march, and the fortress strikes back. Between raids, you cross the campaign map towards boons, events and bosses.

apps.name: Need for Seat
apps.short_description: Office chair racing at its most chaotic! Drift from office hallways to places no chair was ever meant to go, build up boost, and grab random power-ups from Lucky Boxes. Now with online multiplayer, so you can race your friends across new maps full of shortcuts and surprises.

apps.name: Nightclub Security
apps.short_description: In this absurd first-person bouncer game, you have 10 seconds to decide who gets into the club. Check IDs, catch drunks and hidden contraband, confiscate forbidden items, then let them in - or slap, shove, grab, and throw them out.

apps.name: Nimikins
apps.short_description: Nimikins is a cozy idle gacha game with zero microtransactions. Collect adorable Nimikins and discover rare, shimmering color variations as you reunite them with their goddess, Aerie. Craft accessories to grow their strength and express your unique personality.

apps.name: Ninja Kaeru
apps.short_description: Strike down relentless waves of enemies and test your reflexes! How long can you survive as the speed keeps rising in this fast-paced retro 8-bit arena?

apps.name: Nishin Difenda
apps.short_description: Defend the egg cell from ridiculous waves of sperm in a biological roguelite where antibodies, mucus, pH and chaotic upgrades become your weapons.

apps.name: Nitronic Rush
apps.short_description: Nitronic Rush is an experimental survival driving game. Using the car’s many abilities (including boost, wings, and jump), avoid obstacles that the city throws at you. In many ways the game is a tribute to racing games of the 1990s but with fresh graphics, audio, and gameplay.

apps.name: Noa and the Bandits' Den
apps.short_description: A base of the worst nightmares. Try to escape before your soul is destroyed...

apps.name: Noir Total : Deadly Party
apps.short_description: Noir Total is a 2D local multiplayer PvP shooter set in darkened arenas. Sneak through total darkness using your controller’s vibrations, track down your enemies, collect bonuses and set traps to stay one step ahead of your opponents in fast-paced, competitive matches for up to 4 players.

apps.name: Nori2
apps.short_description: Nori Game 2 blends third-person action and real-time strategy for 1–4 players. Build your army, siege rival castles, steal treasure and forge secret alliances — or betray your friends! Command your soldiers, outsmart your enemies and be the first to secure five treasure chests. Trust no one!

apps.name: North Relay
apps.short_description: Alone on the night shift at North Relay, watch six CCTV feeds and hold back an intruder with outside floodlights. Restore the office connection through a command terminal and request a pickup. Every moment spent typing is a moment you aren't watching.

apps.name: NOSTRA
apps.short_description: A dark fantasy RPG where side-view party battles turn on timing: build Boost, raise a Ward, parry on the frame and break the guard. Loot rolls with affixes, sets and runewords. Three kingdoms hold a fragile peace while something older stirs. Play the alpha demo now.

apps.name: Not a Duck
apps.short_description: Night shift, Line 3. Squeeze, float, stamp and weigh every rubber duck that rolls down the belt, then ship it or shred it. Shelve the good ones in a dark warehouse where the lights only come on when you move. Some units are not ducks. Don't look away.

apps.name: Nowhere to Land
apps.short_description: Survive a flooded world in this open-world survival adventure. Recruit a crew, build floating homes, dive for supplies, and battle pirate captains. Discover an island and confront the alien force behind the rising seas.

apps.name: Nozomu School Daze
apps.short_description: Your choices matter in Nozomu School Daze, a 90s shonen anime-meets-rom-com visual novel! As a college girl, Sari wants to attend school in peace. Too bad the martial artists in her life have other ideas! These 3 idiots get into a knock-down brawl, which YOU control! New genre: BATTLE ROMANCE

apps.name: Nurtale Nesche
apps.short_description:
Escape a dark 2D stealth-action dungeon ruled by reactive, lifelike monsters.
Hide, use sound to distract enemies, collect items, and survive intense capture events.
Features dynamic traps, 14+ monsters, and 36+ unique animated scenes.
Can you break her chains and escape?

apps.name: O EMPIRE! WARD OFF THY ROT
apps.short_description: A slow, meditative survival journey across a bleak continent. Carry an evil artifact, manage scarce resources, scavenge abandoned places and decide how far you’re willing to endure in a world that offers no reassurance.

apps.name: Oddballs Brawl
apps.short_description: Oddballs Brawl is a chaotic side-scrolling shooter for 2–4 players! Play as bizarre fighters, jumping, dodging, and blasting away across floating platforms and trap-filled arenas. Grab all kinds of weapons, send your friends flying, and fight for victory in the middle of the mayhem!

apps.name: Old Money
apps.short_description: You're 18 with €2,500. Work your way up, trade stocks and crypto, buy property, build companies, run for office. Then your life ends, and your heir gets what the taxman leaves. One life is short. How long can your dynasty last?

apps.name: OMEGA: The Dead Planet
apps.short_description: OMEGA: The Dead Planet is a third-person sci-fi survival horror game set on a hostile alien world. Explore semi-open regions, scavenge resources, upgrade your abandoned base, survive infected colonists and aberrant alien predators, and struggle to control Jessica’s dangerous mutation.

apps.name: One More Nugget
apps.short_description: Mine rocks, collect gold nuggets, and grow your workshop in this pixel-art incremental game. Unlock new rooms, put helpers to work, and invest in upgrades and permanent research. Every nugget brings you closer to your next upgrade.

apps.name: One More Rock!
apps.short_description:
A chill incremental game about satisfying mining and automated forging.

Mine. Gamble. Upgrade. Repeat.

Mine another rock while the lantern is burning.

apps.name: One More Wipe
apps.short_description: Lead a 25-player raid. Alone. Nobody's late, nobody's AFK, and you will still wipe. Recruit from 10 classes, draft a new build every run and call the shots through 8 dungeons and 16 bosses. Or hand the raid to your AI agent.

apps.name: One Night at Kevin's VR
apps.short_description: One Night at Kevin's VR is a VR game that includes 6 mainline nights, 2 challenge nights, original mechanics, a cast of unique characters, and an interesting story to uncover as you survive your shifts at Highes.

apps.name: One-Hour Hero
apps.short_description: A compact 2.5D pixel-art, turn-based JRPG designed to be completed in about an hour. Train as a hero, explore White Mountain, learn new skills, collect gear, and fight beside your companion on the road to the Dragon King.

apps.name: Oops… I Hooked Up with a Mermaid 🎣😳
apps.short_description: Well, nice catch! You caught a mermaid with a tempting smile and she isn’t going to let you go that easily. Reel her closer, uncover the secrets of the deep and chase six endings: from sweet romance to something much darker.

apps.name: OpSec Simulator
apps.short_description: Become the master of OpSec in town. Be careful, You may be caught! Balance your double life: do chores in the kitchen to keep her happy, sneak back to your room to run your PC ops, and manage your sleep before exhaustion blows your cover.

apps.name: ORBTRUDER
apps.short_description:
ORBTRUDER is a tactical roguelite action platformer about a killer robot ball that constantly ricochets.
Climb higher and higher up a mysterious skyscraper. Slow down time, aim, ricochet and try again.

apps.name: Ore Express
apps.short_description: Build chaotic, physics-powered factories. Chop trees and mine ore, then catch the avalanche with belts, ramps, fans, pistons and cranes, smelt and craft it into goods, and fill the trucks. Every item is a real physical object, so every contraption is gloriously unpredictable.

apps.name: Organize my Shop 3: Christmas Store
apps.short_description: Your favorite cozy organizing returns in a festive new format! Dive into a winter wonderland, brew some hot cocoa, and place fairy lights, nutcrackers, blankets, and mugs neatly on the shelves at your own pace while enjoying your favorite holiday movie ☕✨

apps.name: Originaryah
apps.short_description: Originaryah is a turn-based roguelite card battler where you roll dice, collect loot, forge powerful equipment, and climb a 30-floor tower filled with dangerous enemies and formidable bosses. Unlock forgotten powers, overcome each challenge, and recover the lost memories that reveal the truth.

apps.name: OTG
apps.short_description: OTG is a 30-player multiplayer sandbox set in a strange, isolated Vermont town where almost everything is physical, everyone has something to hide, and there's no telling what you'll do next.

apps.name: Our Life: Now & Forever
apps.short_description: A paper airplane, two new neighbors, four autumns, and a one of a kind life. Create an experience that’s all your own in this near-fully customizable, choice-heavy story where you grow from childhood to adulthood.

apps.name: Overleveled
apps.short_description: A fast paced rogue-lite RPG where you create overpowered builds while exploring an expansive dungeon filled with dangerous monsters and powerful artifacts. Play solo or with up to three friends. Every run earns permanent gear upgrades. You'll need everything you have to beat... Doug

apps.name: Panic Point
apps.short_description: Panic Point is a cooperative first-person psychological horror game where players explore hostile environments, manage limited resources, and work together under constant pressure. Survival depends on communication, teamwork, and staying calm when everything starts to go wrong.

apps.name: Paper Physics
apps.short_description: Arrange and combine objects on paper to get the ball to the finish.

apps.name: Paragra: Paragliding Adventure
apps.short_description: Paragra is a 2D arcade paragliding game. Climb in thermals, become an XC league hero and win competitions. Read the sky and don't land in a field too early.

apps.name: Parcel Inspector Simulator
apps.short_description: Run a parcel inspection desk. Weigh, X-ray and look up every shipment, compare it with the declaration and the latest regulations, then stamp and route it: approve, return, hold, confiscate or dispose. Earn cash, upgrade your workplace and keep up with a growing quota.

apps.name: Pastel Squad
apps.short_description: Hold back the enemy horde swarming the city with a squad of cute girls! Build your team from 30+ unique members and fight with terrain and skills in real-time squad tactics. Includes three modes: Story, Missions and Roguelite.

apps.name: Path to Goldhorn
apps.short_description: Path to Goldhorn is a short adventure game with a focus on exploration. Explore, find new abilities and upgrade them. Fight bosses and mini-bosses.

apps.name: Peggy Catch!
apps.short_description: Peggy Catch! is a colorful, physics-based peg-bouncing puzzle game! Aim, shoot, and clear pegs through handcrafted and randomized courses. Master trick shots, unlock cosmetics, create custom levels, and challenge friends in competitive duels.

apps.name: Pemkie Island
apps.short_description:
Pemkie Island is a monster taming RPG adventure, in a roguelite format.
Travel across the 5 different regions while discovering and taming unique creatures called Pemkies.
Master their traits, choose the right skills and build the best team possible to restore balance!

apps.name: PENTO
apps.short_description: Five blocks instead of four change everything. Rotate and place pentominoes, clear lines, and learn to read the board in a whole new way. Chase high scores, take on different challenges, or unwind with music in your own neon lounge.

apps.name: Perceptum
apps.short_description: A psychological horror game where you play as a medium investigating the disappearance of a family. Explore a house with an oppressive atmosphere, close your eyes to hear the beyond, use your mirror to see what should not exist and uncover the truth hidden within its walls.

apps.name: Perennial
apps.short_description: Perennial is a fast paced platformer with layered difficulty.  Survive the hazards, collect everything, find the hidden challenge and puzzle rooms, slide boost and speed run for coin combos, complete your hat collection, rescue a babe.

apps.name: Petri: Microbe Swarm
apps.short_description: You are a brand-new microbe. Grow a living swarm: send cells between colonies, upgrade them, and out-spread rival strains across five animal hosts, from fish to whale. Roguelike runs: pick a strain, mutate after every win or skip for a one-battle boost. Mouse, keyboard or controller.

apps.name: Phasewright
apps.short_description: A pulse crosses one cell per tick — the longer way arrives later. From that one rule you build machines out of light: lay conduits, split colours, hit the beat. Quiet, untimed, free.

apps.name: Phineas and Ferb: New Inventions
apps.short_description: This time Phineas and Ferb decide not to fritter away their energy. They are going to build the coolest rollercoaster in their backyard! But to assemble such an enormous construction they need a good drawing and a lot of different parts which are not so easy to find.

apps.name: Pie Paw
apps.short_description: Pie Paw is a cozy bag-building roguelite where you draw, upgrade, and combine dice to outscore animal rivals. Shape every roll with special dice, items, and companions as you travel a branching road in search of pies.

apps.name: Pitborn
apps.short_description: Run a struggling gladiator school in ancient Rome. Buy recruits, train them, plan their tactics, then watch them fight for their lives. Climb from a backstreet pit to the Colosseum, one brutal week at a time.

apps.name: Pixel Frenzy
apps.short_description: Pixel Frenzy is a fast-paced first-person shooter game where you create your own combat style in fully destructible environments. Defeat the pixel monsters invading the real world. Grab your weapon and save the world by destroying everything in your path!

apps.name: PixelCube8
apps.short_description: Race, dash, hide and brawl through 30+ procedural cube mini-games, or take on the Party Board with your friends for a card-driven ruleset or classic dice. Play online with up to 8 players, or practice offline against bots.

apps.name: PLANETOON
apps.short_description: Grab planets, place them into orbit, and grow a galaxy in this space puzzle game. Watch life and civilizations emerge, encounter UFOs and black holes, and discover over 60 endings across 12 billion years of cosmic surprises.

apps.name: Planets in a Box
apps.short_description: Smash planets together in a real-time physics simulator. Watch a Mars-sized world hit the young Earth, debris spread into a disk and a new moon form, and tides stretch and spin up worlds. Up to 4 million particles on your GPU. Record the raw simulation data and replay from any angle at any speed.

apps.name: PlanetSmith
apps.short_description: A sandbox survival RPG set on fully spherical hex worlds. Crash-land on an uncharted planet, craft and build to survive, uncover what infected the solar system, then build a ship and fly seamlessly to other planets. No loading screens. No edges.

apps.name: Plastic Front
apps.short_description: Two brothers, one toy box, a war on the playroom floor. Set out your green plastic army, give the orders, then watch the fight play out: toy houses fall in splinters, tanks crush blocks, and a child's hand drops the book on whoever bunched up. Six tables, six wars.

apps.name: Play Pocket Manager
apps.short_description: A pocket-sized six-a-side football management game. Open packs, collect 260 players, pick your best six, and manage chemistry and formation across a full career of league seasons, cup runs and promotions. No adverts, no paid packs, no in-game purchases, and it plays entirely offline.

apps.name: Plinko Squad
apps.short_description: Drop balls down a plinko board to recruit your squad, arrange them on a hex grid, and send them auto-battling up a 25-floor tower. Stack augments into explosive synergies, but every unit that falls is gone for good.

apps.name: Pocket Beasts
apps.short_description: Collect 100+ mythical beasts from Chinese mythical legends and Shanhaijing lore, build your dream team, and let them battle automatically — even offline. A strategic idle RPG with async PvP and deep cultivation.

apps.name: Pocket Orbit
apps.short_description: Explore strange planets as a space cat. Choose a place to settle, deploy a habitat, gather resources and build your home by hand. Pilot your own ship, discover a Moon community, and make a life between adventures, alone or with a friend in co-op.

apps.name: PocoDoro
apps.short_description: PocoDoro is a tiny virtual pet that lives on your desktop. Hatch a squishy slime, then poke it, stretch it and toss it around. Feed it, play with it, put it to bed and clean up after it. It lives in real time, and how you raise it shapes who it becomes.

apps.name: POINT CLOUD
apps.short_description: A fast-paced, vector-inspired arcade shooter, set in a dark & minimalist galaxy. Blast through hoards of enemies, rack up high-scores, and collect new ships with unique abilities. Climb through the ranks and reclaim your identity.

apps.name: POP OUT!
apps.short_description: A simple and addictive real time strategy game.

apps.name: Portrise Idle
apps.short_description: Build a quiet fishing harbor in an atmospheric idle strategy game. Send your fleet to sea, sell the catch, expand warehouses and buildings, collect captain and ship cards, and sail from a peaceful bay toward dangerous depths.

apps.name: PowerCorp
apps.short_description: A space sim survival where each decision costs power. Every system drains your dying reactor. Pilot a crippled spacecraft across a real-scale solar system using true orbital mechanics, manage critical systems, scavenge for resources, while you try to uncover why humanity seems to have disappeared.

apps.name: PRAVDA(concept25)
apps.short_description: Pravda is a detective game about journalism under a totalitarian regime. You play Saga, a state-branded “Liar” working for the Resistance to bring down the Party. Your task is clear: Collect information. Craft the truth. Change the world. But in Abil-Gudit, every truth has a cost.

apps.name: PRINCESS VANGUARD
apps.short_description: Control five elemental princesses, unleash spectacular Special Skills, and battle massive enemy hordes in this fast-paced 15-minute 2D top-down action RPG. Upgrade your weapons, defeat powerful bosses, and save the world!

apps.name: PrintMarket
apps.short_description: Build and manage your own 3D printing shop. Buy printers, load colorful filaments, produce and sell models, and reinvest in your workshop. Organize your space, manage electricity and materials, and grow from your first machine to an automated production line.

apps.name: Privateer 2: The Darkening: 30th Anniversary Edition
apps.short_description: Privateer 2: The Darkening is a definitive example of PC gaming expression during the mid-1990s. Now celebrated in this special 30th Anniversary Edition, the game has been restored in collaboration with the dedicated community.

apps.name: Project 2025 Text Based Story Board
apps.short_description: An AI-powered story board that runs on your own machine. Pick a world, a genre and a character, then watch every scene, branch and ending being written live as you play. Includes a built-in offline model: no account, no API key, no setup.

apps.name: Project Beat Stands
apps.short_description: "Project Beat Stands" is a 3D retro-styled Rhythm Hack'n'Slash adventure set in the fictional VR-MMORPG Shenanghia.

apps.name: Project Nebula
apps.short_description: An explosive arcade arena shooter inspired by the golden age of Amiga classics. Blast through asteroid fields, destroy alien forces, upgrade your ship, and unleash devastating weapons in a modern reimagining of a timeless genre.

apps.name: Project North
apps.short_description: A first-person exploration game where you manage and master a complex submarine, navigating beneath the north pole to uncover a worldchanging mystery

apps.name: Project Warlock: Lost Chapters
apps.short_description: Jungle rot. Space horror. Pirate nightmares. Rip through three warped worlds of monsters, mutants and mayhem with an arsenal of spells and dozens of guns - from anchor launchers to chain spears to akimbo M60’s - in this new, standalone game featuring Warlock.

apps.name: PROMOTER: The Fight Game
apps.short_description: The Football Manager of boxing. Build your promotional empire from nothing, scout fighters, negotiate contracts, sell the fights, and outmanoeuvre rival promoters in a fully simulated world. You're not the fighter. You're the power behind them

apps.name: Protocol: Genesis
apps.short_description: A deadly infection has turned a medical crisis into a nightmare. Explore abandoned environments, scavenge for resources, battle the infected, and uncover the truth behind the outbreak in Protocol: Genesis, a story-driven survival horror experience.

apps.name: Punch to Defend
apps.short_description:
An incremental tower defense game made with love, bad decisions, beatbox, and questionable amounts of punching.
Upgrade your units, survive increasingly stupid waves, and fuse literally everything with literally everything.

apps.name: Purrfectly Sorted
apps.short_description: Sort over 4,000 adorable kitty plushies by patterns and colors onto shelves. In this relaxing first-person experience, earn money with every completed shelf and unlock handy upgrades to help with your task. Zero stress, just pure order and satisfaction.

apps.name: Quest for the Golden Nail
apps.short_description: One impossible pile. One Golden Nail. Pick, throw, sort and upgrade your way through a minimalist physics sandbox, cheered on by a boundlessly enthusiastic narrator. Find meaning among far too many ordinary things. No fuss, no fluff, no friends. Just you and way too many nails. How hard could it be?

apps.name: Quiet Sky
apps.short_description: Play God as an advanced intelligence observing a living Earth across deep time. Discover minds in unexpected forms, shape evolving civilizations, and watch your interventions become miracles, myths, mysteries—or reasons to resist you.

apps.name: Radstorm
apps.short_description: Post-apocalyptic, isometric, turn-based RPG in Europe, 2130, a century after bombs fell. Explore, survive, fight, steal, trade, scavenge, recruit, craft, create and destroy factions.

apps.name: Rage Pit
apps.short_description:
You're construction workers. Your buddy hit a nail way too hard, the floor caved in, and now you're all stuck at the bottom of a pit. Build your way up before the water gets you. 
A co-op rage game with a twist: you build the path yourselves!

apps.name: Raid of Lust: Match & Magic
apps.short_description: Immerse yourself in a world of magic, SEXY HEROINES, and epic battles in Raid of Lust: Match & Magic! ✨ Assemble your team of hot anime babes and set off on a quest in a match-3 fantasy RPG! Then BATTLE OTHER ADVENTURERS in multiplayer with PvP and co-op! Will you be able to climb to the top?

apps.name: Raku
apps.short_description: Set out on a pilgrimage for your ailing sibling in a gentle pixel-art adventure through Kyoto’s four seasons. Visit temples and shrines, enjoy traditional arts and cooking, and discover a dream world inhabited by yokai.

apps.name: Ram Fights
apps.short_description: Get ready to headbutt your way to glory in this hilarious physics-based brawler! Customize your ultimate animal gladiator, master the art of the perfect charge, and send your rivals flying with epic ragdoll physics.

apps.name: Rare on the Line
apps.short_description: Cast your line into calm waters and reel in something rare. Open recovered cases, discover collectible rods, reels, lures and gloves, and build a collection shaped by distinctive finishes, patterns and wear. Fish at your own pace and share case openings with friends.

apps.name: Rattlecrew
apps.short_description: A top-down action roguelite for 1 to 4 players. Lead a crew of discarded robots through a vast machine world. Turn industrial tools into weapons, combine powerful upgrades, and fight your way through the machines that replaced you.

apps.name: raythm
apps.short_description: raythm is a keyboard rhythm game where you press, hold, and release keys in time with notes across four or six lanes. Play solo, compete online, climb the rankings, download official and community songs and charts, or create your own.

apps.name: Re:act
apps.short_description: Every stone, every pane of ice, every turn lands on the beat, so the music tells you what’s coming. Crash, rewind, try again, until it clicks and you know it by heart. Every mode is a different way to answer the music. No note highway. The level is the song.

apps.name: Re:Connect
apps.short_description: Re:Connect is a programming puzzle adventure set in a digital world, where you connect code to change the rules! Become a Debug AI, solve electronic circuit puzzles, and set off on a grand adventure to repair the “Heart Bugs” of the AIs!

apps.name: Reborn a Zombie 2: Entwined Hearts
apps.short_description: In this sequel of the LGBT visual novel Reborn a Zombie, Dawn, a trans girl turned zombie, now has to confront her past. However, the Demon King is approaching and his presence will change everything.

apps.name: Recursive Nightmare
apps.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game where you can't fight back. Hide, run and listen as creatures hunt you through flooded, dreamlike nightmares that never let you catch your breath. Someone is turning your fear into power.

apps.name: Rehab Friday
apps.short_description: Happiness is a choice.

apps.name: REM-KILL
apps.short_description: Trapped in an ever-shifting nightmare, fight your way through hordes of surreal monsters in this fast-paced 3D Action Roguelite FPS. Master retro shooter mechanics, dodge bullet-hell chaos, and purge the realm to awaken from an intense hour-long survival loop.

apps.name: Restitched
apps.short_description: Join Stuffy on a charming platforming adventure as they "restitch" unraveled communities. Unleash your creativity with a robust 2.5D level editor, play dress up with a powerful mix-and-match Wardrobe, and share your creations via Steam Workshop!

apps.name: Revenge of the Firstborn
apps.short_description: Lead a party of heroes in this story-rich, tactical turn-based RPG based on the classic 3.5 SRD ruleset. Uncover the origin of the Firstborn and decide if their power will bring the world its salvation, or annihilation.

apps.name: Rhythm of the Backwaters
apps.short_description: A short cozy building and management sim set in the sleepy waterways of Kerala, India. A once-mighty village boat club is being revived decades later. Design and build a race-worthy boat, manage the club and its funds through its comeback season.

apps.name: Riders Of The Nine Planes
apps.short_description: A mounted cavalier rogue-like across the Multiverse.  Charge at enemies with your stored potential energy from galloping in a straight line, but beware; you are vulnerable once stationary after charging! Later develops into a strategy game in the late stages as you rise in power and control areas.

apps.name: Ringfall TD
apps.short_description: Maze tower defense for up to eight players. Hold one lane of a ring round a castle: build the longest maze you can, catch what leaks from your teammates and see how many endless waves your team can hold. Or go PvP: two teams, mercenary sends, and ranked ladders from 1v1 to 4v4.

apps.name: RIVERBLOOM
apps.short_description: Carve rivers across a dead valley and watch it come back. Drag a channel from a spring and the water follows your hand. Grass, forest, birds and beavers return wherever it reaches. A calm incremental with nine watersheds, a real ending and a river that grows to meet the sea.

apps.name: Robo Race
apps.short_description: Build your own robot from blocks, let AI teach it to walk, and race it. Giraffe, snake, or a shape no one has seen before: the AI finds its own way to run. Take on 8 courses with obstacles, waves, and moving floors in local races or online with up to 4 players.

apps.name: Roborumble: Noodle's Adventure
apps.short_description: Join Noodle, a curious cat riding a robot vacuum, on a playful backyard adventure. Roll around walls, leap between planters and collect yarn. Master two simple controls, find each level’s golden yarn and chase your best time.

apps.name: Rock Paper Viking
apps.short_description: You are the sole defender of the Cardboard Castle! Pick up new weapons and magic abilities as you progress. Level up your loot to gain the strength of the Norse Gods, and defeat your foes to claim victory for your kin.

apps.name: Rocky Up
apps.short_description:
A challenging 2D platformer with mouse-only controls and only natural sounds.
Jump, jump, and jump all the way to reaching the mountains top.

apps.name: Rogue AI
apps.short_description:
RogueAI is a roguelike deckbuilder where you don't just play the cards — you make them.
Dream up mechanics from scratch, forge cards that shouldn't exist, and assemble archetypes no one's ever seen. All while facing AI enemies that adapt and cook up their own mechanics to tear yours apart.

apps.name: Rogue Carrier
apps.short_description: Lead a perilous expedition to study the mysteries of a sentient world in this roguelite colony management game. Build and manage a city atop an ocean-faring ship, and try to survive as the planet fights back!

apps.name: Rogue Wheels
apps.short_description: Rogue Wheels is a turn based roguelike deckbuilder where your car is your character and timing driven combat defines every run. Build fun and crazy decks!

apps.name: Roomcopter
apps.short_description: Roomcopter is a sandbox room-building game about creating your dream space. Shape your room however you like and furnish it with thousands of props, from furniture and lights to plants and decor. Find your favorite angle and capture the moment with realistic graphics.

apps.name: ROOT: Node City
apps.short_description: Learn the real Linux terminal by living in Node City, 2061. Solve quests with real commands like ls, grep, find and pipes, drill them until your hands know them, then take night jobs in the Dark, where CivOS is hunting you and every command burns your cover.

apps.name: Round One, Fight!
apps.short_description: A laid-back incremental auto battler straight off a '90s video-store shelf. Build your fighter, let him throw the punches, and come back stronger after a beating. 25 opponents, 5 acts, a skill tree, and a little romance.

apps.name: Rule of Iron: Dark Age
apps.short_description: Build your realm in a turn-based campaign. Command your armies in real-time battles.

apps.name: Rune Rally
apps.short_description: Build your hero squad, place them wisely, and battle through fantasy roguelike runs to find Princess Elara.

apps.name: Rune Runners
apps.short_description: Rune Runners is a colorful 3D platformer for one or two players on one couch. Choose two of four young mages, combine water, fire, thunder and wind, and light the rune torches of eight worlds, past cute monsters and eight bosses.

apps.name: Rust, Dust & Droids
apps.short_description: Recover an industrial robot mining operation buried deep in a collapsed off-world complex. Build power, production and fluid networks through underground levels. Order the bots to search, dig and explore, discovering lost recipes and artifacts and finally completing the mission.

apps.name: Rustlot
apps.short_description: Drop junked cars onto belts. Watch the shredder chew them into scrap, the magnet pull iron from copper, the smelter pour glowing ingots, and the press stamp hubcaps for cash. A cozy, tactile 2D junkyard factory game with an honest finish line — sell the lot or keep optimizing.

apps.name: S.T.A.R.V.E.
apps.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder about farming alien planets for a corporation that only cares about quotas. Grow mutant crops on a tactical grid while aliens and nature do their best to kill your harvest. Miss quota and you get "outsourced".

apps.name: Sail Onward! Scion of the Sward
apps.short_description: A small green voyage with a long shadow. Sunlit, unhurried, and not remotely safe.

apps.name: Sails of Steel
apps.short_description: Become a modern privateer in a single-player naval action game set in the contested waters of near-future Southeast Asia. Work for states, syndicates or private forces, build your ship around its crew and command real-time battles where preparation and skill decide the outcome.

apps.name: Salary-Mon | Hiro Versus His Demons
apps.short_description: Help Japanese Salaryman Hiro overcome his inner demons by facing his fears head on, battling his worst traits, and becoming more powerful with each victory to ultimately take down his oppressive boss in this Poke-like JRPG adventure.

apps.name: Same Day Tycoon
apps.short_description: Someone just ordered a giant rubber duck, and you promised it today. Build the delivery machine behind an online store: stock the shelves, staff the floor, set the delivery promise, and send vans, trucks and trains to every doorstep across North America. Every order is a real parcel you can follow.

apps.name: Samsara Hallway
apps.short_description: Find the anomalies by day. Survive the night. Trapped in an endless school hallway, you must notice what has changed to move forward. But when night falls, a killer begins to hunt. Hide, run, and find three keys to escape.

apps.name: SCRAPFLUX
apps.short_description: Turn scrap into ammo in a sci-fi top-down shooter. Pull metal in with your magnet, hurl it at enemies or deposit it for credits to upgrade your robot. Fight through 12 maps with bosses and face endless waves in Survival mode.

apps.name: SCROLLS: Tidy up the Library of Olympus!
apps.short_description: Restore order to a divine library by sorting 3,048 scattered scrolls, reuniting ancient collections, and unlocking powers worthy of Olympus. Read the markings, gather the volumes, and give the wisdom of the gods its rightful place in solo or with up to 8 players!

apps.name: Sea of Tranquility
apps.short_description: Escape your doomed mission from the Moon. Explore a vast open-world landscape and evade its dangers. Land shuttles, solve puzzles, control cameras, hack systems, uncover mysteries, and roam tranquil plains in your Rover. Survive the mission. Make your escape.

apps.name: Second Genesis
apps.short_description: In a post-apocalyptic world ravaged by pollution, explore, survive, and restore life by cleaning contaminated lands, building machines, and recreating extinct species through genetics.

apps.name: Secret Agent - The 5 Keys
apps.short_description: The fan-favourite indie hit that left players craving a sequel returns, beautifully remastered and enhanced! Immerse yourself in a stunningly upgraded, code-breaking, riddle-filled point-and-click adventure that requires you to get inside the mind of a clever but eccentric criminal mastermind.

apps.name: Sender Unknown
apps.short_description: Work the night shift in an underground sorting facility. Weigh packages, compare their contents, and meet your quota by 6 AM. But beware, some packages hide dark secrets. Identify bad batches, earn cash, and survive the night in this tense PSX-style horror job simulator.

apps.name: SGS Ashes of Dawn
apps.short_description:
Ashes of Dawn 2040: a unique hybrid of turn-based post-apocalyptic wargame and board game. Total war in a irradiated Europe. 
NARDO (heir to NATO) against VARPAC (heir to the Warsaw Pact) with the choice of civilization or chaos.

Simple to play but complex to master.

apps.name: SHAFT HAPPENS
apps.short_description: Your shift goes down. Your quota goes up. Scavenge haunted workplaces, throw loot into the elevator and escape before the doors close. Co-op horror for 1–4 players, with upgrades, suspicious colleagues and a company that values its equipment more than you.

apps.name: Shape Shards
apps.short_description: Shape Shards is a casual incremental game where you shoot bullets to destroy geometric enemies, collect shards to upgrade, and every upgrade brings a whole new experience!

apps.name: Shardana
apps.short_description: 🌊 SHARDANA is a survival horror game set in Nuragic Sardinia. Shipwrecked on a mysterious island, you must survive, explore, and find a cure for a terrifying infestation. But beware of the night: that’s when the monsters emerge. 🌙🗿

apps.name: Shards of Veyara
apps.short_description: Shards of Veyara is an adventure game that blends farming with 3D platformer action. Explore the sky islands of Veyara—a world warped across space and time—gather seeds and resources, cultivate crops in your hub to grow stronger, and reclaim the shattered Dimensional Shards!

apps.name: Shattered Divide
apps.short_description: What was once myth is now reality. Traverse world rifts into a corrupted mirror of a broken world, where gravity twists and nightmares stalk the ruins. Scavenge, craft and fight to survive alone or with friends in open-world co-op. The Fracture changed the world. It changed you too.

apps.name: Sheep Go!
apps.short_description: Ram, punch or fire cannons! Sheep Go! is a plush-style action roguelite. Mix wool-ball throws, static charge from rubbing, Sheep Shadows and summoned flocks of sheep into your own build. Become a little sheep on a journey from farm to town to rescue Mom, with surprises along the way.

apps.name: Sheeping In
apps.short_description: The alarm went off. You hit snooze. Now you have five more minutes, a meadow full of sheep, and a shepherd's crook — count them over the fence, earn sleep, and buy your way to one more snooze. A cozy idle game about refusing to get up.

apps.name: Shelves Full of Figures
apps.short_description: A room full of empty shelves and a floor full of little figures. Pick up each one, find the shelf where it belongs and put it back on! Earn ability points as you go and unlock new ways to move and sort in this relaxing first-person organizing game.

apps.name: ShieldMan
apps.short_description: An arena-based arcade action game where your shield is for more than defense. It’s not much of a weapon, so get creative: PUSH enemies into obstacles and off ledges, clear the arena, and move on to the next.

apps.name: Shipolis
apps.short_description: Shipolis is a cozy naval city builder and resource management game. Explore archipelagos with your ship. Build cities and expand in several regions. Manage production lines and automate with trading routes. Play at your own pace to build great wonders and uncover all the mysteries of the world.

apps.name: Shmandala
apps.short_description: Shmandala is a delirious arcade-style shoot'em up choreographed to a banging soundtrack!

apps.name: ShotMachine
apps.short_description: A turn-based western roguelite where your revolver is a slot machine. Load it round by round, fuse bullets into jackpot rounds, let your winnings ride at THE COUNT and take the rails all the way to The House, the casino at the end of the line.

apps.name: Shovel That Snow
apps.short_description: Hey neighbour! You arrived just in time. A blizzard has buried our neighborhood under some seriously thick powder, and we are all completely snowed-in our cabins. Just a typical Tuesday here in Scandinavia, right? Heh. Could you help us out?

apps.name: Show: No Mercy
apps.short_description: Steer your bullets, outplay your friends, and steal the show! Show: No Mercy is a competitive FPS party game for 2–8 players. Battle across varied game modes, grab wild power-ups, and race to collect five trophies.

apps.name: Sift & Shine
apps.short_description: A cozy life and job simulator where a dwarf leaves the mountain to build a new life by the river. Pan for gold, gems, and ores, collect cards, upgrade gear, pay bills, and raise a family.

apps.name: Sightline: Logic Puzzle
apps.short_description: What if Minesweeper stopped looking next door and started looking across the whole board? Every clue tells you how many bombs it can see. Follow the sightlines, deduce the board, and clear every safe tile. No guessing. No luck. Just one more level.

apps.name: Signal From The Stars
apps.short_description: A modern pixel art point-and-click adventure inspired by the classics. Explore real places, investigate real mysteries, solve puzzles, and help Martin, Diana, and Nikki uncover the truth while discovering something new about the world.

apps.name: SIGNOS: AI Robot Builder
apps.short_description:
It moves the way you built it. It wins the way you built it.

Assemble the 18cm-tall autonomous hobby robot “SIGNOS” and program its behavior logic with flowchart-style “Thought Tiles.” No controls during battle — SIGNOS fights on its own, guided solely by the logic you designed.

apps.name: Silent Spirits
apps.short_description: Operate a speakeasy in 1920s Prohibition-era America in this business simulation. Craft illicit alcohol, serve demanding customers, and outmaneuver police patrols during high-stakes deliveries. Smuggle shipments to the mob and expand your underground empire across 15 years of escalating danger.

apps.name: Silicone Heart
apps.short_description: Build a self-sustaining cyber farm on a planet-sized junkyard. Grow biomechanical crops, automate production, repair discarded robots, and secretly reshape a mechanical society from the inside in this cozy farming and automation adventure.

apps.name: Sinalau Bakas
apps.short_description: After years overseas, you return to your rural hometown to sell vacuum-packed smoked wild boar meat. Business is good—until you realize the meat might not be wild boar at all. A rural horror story about survival, secrets, and what you’re willing to sell.

apps.name: Sinful Hearts
apps.short_description: As the priest of Santa Cecilia, save a village’s souls or exploit their sins. Sinful Hearts is a dark fantasy RPG visual novel with point & click investigation, branching choices, and consequences that can redeem, corrupt, or destroy.

apps.name: SinsKiller
apps.short_description:
SinsKiller is an isometric action arcade shooter set in a Dante-inspired Hell.
Play as a fallen battle-mage wielding arcane power to obliterate demonic hordes and face brutal bosses.
Face your sins. Kill them. Earn your redemption.

apps.name: SkateFPS
apps.short_description:
When the system hates you, hate the system!
Experimental FPS about shooting magic from your hands with a skateboard + text adventure with multiple endings about being cursed in your own land.

apps.name: Ski Lodge: Tidy Up Together
apps.short_description: A blizzard closed the slopes and every guest dumped their gear in one giant heap in the middle of the ski shop. Climb a mountain of 2,000+ skis, boots, helmets and gloves and sort it all back onto the right racks – solo or with up to 5 friends.

apps.name: SkyAceBlitz
apps.short_description: Top-down dogfights with weight in throttle and turns. Cannon fires at the cursor and can shoot down missiles. Laser hits hard. Missiles lock on and explode on planes and rocks. Fight interceptors, drone swarms, and a mothership that lays mines. Blast asteroids into chips, splits, and craters.

apps.name: Slimetopia
apps.short_description: Click, build, craft, and defend! Lead a colony of cute slimes in this cozy city-builder clicker.  Arm your slimes with munitions to stop the Overlord's thief goblins from plundering your vaults!

apps.name: Slitcher.io
apps.short_description: Collect food, grow longer, and trade length for speed. Easy to learn, tricky to master. Go for fast-paced action, unwind in slower modes, or challenge friends in online multiplayer matches. Play on PC or take your Steam Deck along for a twenty-minute bus ride.

apps.name: Slum Soccer
apps.short_description: 16-bit favela football. Pick five from a squad of twenty, choose your referee, and take on the CPU in STREET, RIOT or WAR, or go 1v1 online against a friend over Steam. Pass into space. Pick a bat off the terraces if it turns ugly.

apps.name: Snake Path
apps.short_description: Snake Path will drag you into a cycle of adventures in the spirit of classic arcade games. Collect fruits, avoid obstacles and enemies, grow to a huge size, compete with other players and learn all the secrets of the island!

apps.name: SNATCH & BETRAY
apps.short_description: SNATCH & BETRAY is a living tabletop treasure hunt. Explore the jungle, find gold, deal with traps, and decide when to cooperate with other adventurers — and when to take the treasure for yourself.

apps.name: Snooker
apps.short_description: Enjoy two classic cue sports in one game! Play Snooker solo or challenge a friend, master over a dozen speed challenges, and enjoy classic 8-Ball Pool. 🔴🎱

apps.name: Snow Panic
apps.short_description: An online ski race for up to 8 players armed to the teeth. Blast your friends into the trees with bazookas, call in airstrikes, unleash exploding goats and beat them all to the bottom.

apps.name: Solitarium
apps.short_description: Solitarium is a tactical solitaire game set in a hand-drawn steampunk noir world. Utilize a variety of gadgets to clear the board before the enemy cog defeats you. Choose from four different characters and three game modes to customize play. Unlock Augments for permanent stat increases.

apps.name: Somewhere Else
apps.short_description: A cozy 2-player co-op puzzle platformer. Play as Chimp and Chip on one couch or online with Remote Play Together, explore six strange and beautiful worlds, solve puzzles that need both of you, beat bosses and find your way back home.

apps.name: Sons of Soria
apps.short_description: Leave the snowbound village of Northfjell and journey toward Soria Moria in a Nordic fantasy adventure, where you fight by casting rune-spells in a rhythm deckbuilder.

apps.name: Sorry, My King
apps.short_description: You have seven days to repay the king. Explore Valenford, fight brutal card battles, and gamble for gold in this dark fantasy roguelite. Every step costs time. Settle your debt or discover who profits from it.

apps.name: Sorry, That Notice Guarantees Nothing
apps.short_description: Escape a facility of real and false safety rules in this 2–8 player online co-op horror game. Read documents, gather clues, and share what you learn. Check what your approaching teammate is holding. Enable optional Infested Mode to hunt the hidden saboteurs.

apps.name: Sort Them Fish
apps.short_description: Sort Them Fish is a cozy organizing simulator where you return 2538 fish to their proper aquariums in a cluttered aquatics store. Fill the tanks, learn abilities and turn the chaos into a beautifully organized fish collection.

apps.name: Sortman
apps.short_description: A Swiss sorting hall buried under a million letters and parcels. Sort by hand, weigh, throw, load the vans, answer furious customers, then build a chain of belts and machines that fills the vans by itself. Solo or up to four players, no timer.

apps.name: Spaceworm Blaster
apps.short_description: A roguelite incremental game. Smash asteroids. Collect ore. Fight aliens. Buy upgrades. Come back stronger!

apps.name: Spellk
apps.short_description: Spell a word. Smash an enemy. Turn random letters into attacks and stack strange items into ridiculous builds. Make rare letters hit harder or long words pay off in this turn-based word-combat roguelite, solo or with up to three friends in online co-op.

apps.name: Spellraid
apps.short_description: Command a modern army against monsters in turn-based battles across Europe. Recover the wounded, study enemies to reveal their health and damage, and decide which front to hold as the invasion spreads.

apps.name: Spy Carnival
apps.short_description: Spy Carnival is a 2–10 player social deception game set in a chaotic funfair. Spies blend into a reactive crowd, sabotage rides and eliminate visitors. Security must read the crowd, follow witness tips and catch them before the carnival falls apart.

apps.name: Squadruped
apps.short_description: SQUADRUPED is a chaotic physics platformer where 2 to 4 players share control of a single four-legged robot. Coordinate your limbs, blast through physics obstacles, and try not to fall into the water on your way to the finish line.

apps.name: Squishy Drop
apps.short_description: Drop, stick and bounce through a dangerous neon claw machine. SQUISHY DROP is a tactile pixel-art arcade game about timing your release, reading each rebound and finding a better route. Soft collectibles. Sharp timing. One more try.

apps.name: Stadt Land Fluss with friends
apps.short_description: Stadt, Land, Fluss für euren nächsten Online-Spieleabend: Ob Stadt, Land, Serienfigur oder Fund im WG-Kühlschrank, wählt klassische Kategorien oder denkt euch eigene aus. Stell dein Wissen auch allein auf die Probe und finde immer neue Begriffe in abwechslungsreichen Spielmodi.

apps.name: STARHOME
apps.short_description: Lead the last survivors of your civilization through a hostile galaxy aboard a fleet that has become your new home. Manage every inch of space, balance living quarters, production, defenses, and weapons, and search for refuge before an overwhelming threat finds you.

apps.name: StateOS: The Political Sandbox
apps.short_description: The political sandbox game where you build a career from state rep to the presidency. Authentic electoral systems, government departments, pass legislation, and a unique news landscape. Create custom scenarios, parties, and politicians in this data-driven democracy simulator.

apps.name: Station 12
apps.short_description: Station 12 is a chaotic sci-fi horror party game for 4–6 players, with larger lobbies up to 12. Find keycards and race to escape a doomed station while a friend hunts you as the Monster. Land the shot that saves your crew, or give away your hiding spot over proximity chat.

apps.name: Steel Platoon
apps.short_description: Lead your forces through the Battle of Moscow in a realistic WWII real-time tactics game featuring persistent squads, deep army customization, and a branching campaign with a global map where every decision carries lasting consequences.

apps.name: SteelBlade Shop Simulator
apps.short_description: SteelBlade Shop Simulator lets you run your own SteelBlade shop in the streets of Japan. Open SteelBlade boxes, collect parts with different tiers, build powerful SteelBlades, sell them for profit, or take them into the arena and compete to prove your skill.

apps.name: Stellar Courier
apps.short_description: Arcade space shooter. You are a courier with one package to deliver across a broken galaxy. Plane-like flight, fights with pirates, the old army and aliens in a 20+ mission story campaign. Pick your ship and mods between missions. No grind, no filler.

apps.name: StellarDrive
apps.short_description: Mine resources, build your spaceship, and soar through the skies in this immersive space sandbox. Wire complex machinery to survive the elements, and craft the StellarDrive: a powerful engine that lets you travel faster than light.

apps.name: Sticky Note Battles
apps.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you battle your coworkers with sticky notes. Collect notes and rearrange your board against the clock to outsmart your opponents. Fight your way to the top and overthrow your corporate overlords.

apps.name: STOP THE VAN!
apps.short_description: A cozy-but-chaotic co-op road trip for 1–4 friends. Drive a big orange camper to Lakeside Camp before sunset: chop fallen trees, honk at ducks, push it out of the mud and ride on the roof (then fly off it). Then cook, roast marshmallows and sleep under the stars.

apps.name: Storm Grill
apps.short_description: A short incremental game where you play as a grill and fight against the storm! Evaporate raindrops, earn coins, unlock new upgrades and skills, grow stronger until you can outlast the downpour.

apps.name: Strip Club Empire
apps.short_description: Build and manage the strip club of your dreams in this adults only business simulation. Hire dancers and staff, set prices, keep patrons spending, handle bad behavior, and turn a struggling club into a nightlife empire where every night brings profit, problems, and surprises.

apps.name: SUBLIMEAL: Cooking with My Little Brother
apps.short_description: A wordplay deckbuilder roguelite where you cook your little brother into steak or meat buns. Rewrite his lines with magic cards and slurp up the magic. Syringes, knives, pickling stones... he may end up as just a head, or a cow. Slurp up a dirty joke, though, and your tools... explode!!

apps.name: Subsomnia
apps.short_description: Explore an ever-changing dream universe in this 2.5D action roguelite. Wield your slingshot, solve physics-based ricochet puzzles, and traverse procedural worlds. Every magical object is a gateway to a new dream: will you reach the source?

apps.name: SUFA: Strike Fighter
apps.short_description: Fly a modern strike fighter over a real map of Israel built from satellite imagery and elevation data. Intercept drones over Eilat, lead the Independence Day flypast, fly historic strike missions, take on the Daily challenge, or simply take off and explore.

apps.name: Sugar OVERDRIVE
apps.short_description:
Slash and combo your way through hordes of sugar monsters in this first person melee game set in a candy city! 
Inspired by fast-paced FPS and Character Action games, swap weapons on the fly to extend your combos and heal from those combos.
in Sugar OVERDRIVE, you combo or you DIE.

apps.name: Sugar Sling Showdown
apps.short_description: Sling candies and fling sugar bombs at your friends in this tongue-based, chaotic, physics party game. Play against each other or join forces against enemies. Win rewards and use them to build your own ToffeeTown in a candy-coated world.

apps.name: Suikoden STAR LEAP
apps.short_description:
New 108 Stars, A New Tale of Runes –

Suikoden STAR LEAP is an entirely new addition to KONAMI's most popular RPG series.
A new story with 108 new stars, unfolding in the same world and history as the series, can be enjoyed with beautiful graphics and powerful sound.

apps.name: Supinaa: Rogue Sapling
apps.short_description: You are a small sapling and hear voices that guide your every step. Defeat enemies, collect powers and grow over time. Will you carve your own path or become a champion of the Risu?

apps.name: Surfin' Landes
apps.short_description: Welcome to Contis, a little beach in the Landes, southwest France. In this 100% co-op pixel art game, become lifeguards: one surfs, the other flies a parachute. On the menu: beer, rescues, giant fish, piranhas, dolphins, pelicans, bazookas, a dog… and ever more beer.

apps.name: Survivors Under Siege
apps.short_description: Survivors Under Siege blends action RTS and tower defense into a minimalist tactical experience. Position your units wisely and strike at the perfect moment to stand against waves of zombies and mutants.

apps.name: Swarm Queen: Reincarnated as Mankind's Doom
apps.short_description: Once an apothecary whose potions saved thousands, Elyse was branded a heretic and cast into slavery by a desperate Church. Falsely accused, she returns not as a savior, but as a ruthless conqueror. Now it's your turn! Evolve the swarm, command the horde, and crush humanity in this macro-free RTS!

apps.name: Swarmslam
apps.short_description: Watch a swarm of tiny slammers hurl themselves at a planet and mine it till it breaks, then feed that ore to THE VOID to make your swarm bigger and faster. SLAM, CRACK, REPEAT

apps.name: Sword of the Last Second
apps.short_description: You have been bestowed a special sword and the authority to sever the bonds of soul and flesh. Make haste for your appointed time has arrived. Defeat your foes, collect their souls, and manifest your authority, until the myriads fall before you in a single moment.

apps.name: Tactical Commanders R
apps.short_description: Tactical Commanders R revives the classic large-scale sci-fi strategy warfare of the original Tactical Commanders. Command your forces, control the battlefield, and experience intense real-time strategic combat once again.

apps.name: Tactics Arena
apps.short_description: Tactics Arena is a free-to-play turn-based strategy game where every move matters. Build your squad, master positioning and facing, challenge players or unique AI opponents, climb the ratings, solve tactical puzzles, and replay battles to refine your strategy.

apps.name: Tails & Talons
apps.short_description: The tower gets stronger. So does your hand. Every card is an attack, a spell, or both. Chain the right combo and turn a scratch into a killing blow. Play as one of a crew of furry adventurers who descend into an eldritch tower, each with their own reasons, one shared goal: reach the bottom.

apps.name: Take Profit
apps.short_description: Step into the role of elite Spec Ops agent Lucy “Talent” Lawson as she dismantles a global crime syndicate to rescue her kidnapped sister. Hunt down The Trust, eliminate its leaders, and seize their profits in this intense, story-driven third-person shooter.

apps.name: Tandm
apps.short_description: You're #31 on the Blacklist: unknown, with zero street rep. Drift and race your way through Sunset City at night, from neon downtown streets to the Kurokami mountain pass. Build your car, earn your name, and take the #1 spot.

apps.name: Taskbar Fishing & Aquarium
apps.short_description: An idle fishing and aquarium game for the corner of your desktop. While you work, a small window quietly fishes for you. Collect 35 species across 10 rarity tiers, then decorate your tank with castles, rocks and coral to build the aquarium you want.

apps.name: TBS: TASK BAR SURVIVOR
apps.short_description: A relaxing pixel-art desktop survivor where a lone samurai grows stronger while you work or chill. Stack and merge weapon boxes into a growing arsenal, unlock upgrades, shape your build, and face powerful bosses to calm Japanese-inspired music.

apps.name: Team Frontress
apps.short_description: A Team Fortress 2-based multiplayer shooter where every match belongs to one persistent RED vs BLU war. Choose a side, deploy to a live front, and move the global map with every victory.

apps.name: TEKUTEKU: Discovery Notebook
apps.short_description: From a corner of your screen, TEKUTEKU wanders Tokyo, finding small sparkling things for its notebook. Pack its lunchbox and the journey shifts. It scribbles along as you type, and may leave a letter if you stay a while. A hand-drawn, cozy desktop game of discovery and collection.

apps.name: Tempered Hull
apps.short_description: Top-down tank shooter for 1–4 players. The Dominion took the valley; your brigade takes it back. Six upgradeable tanks, twelve voiced commanders, airstrikes and gunships, and six Dominion lieutenants between you and High Marshal Draeg.

apps.name: Ten Years of Rain
apps.short_description: Ten Years of Rain is a fantasy adventure Zelda-like with a unique Central Asian inspired setting. Pick up your blade, call your hawk, and prepare to travel the cursed lands. Battle the forces of the Great Khan, explore the secret places of the world, and discover the cause of the long rain...

apps.name: Thawline
apps.short_description: Thawline is a cozy co-op incremental game for up to 4 friends. Scrape and plow the ice off a frozen arctic valley, sell every kilo, and reinvest in snowmobiles, mining vehicles, robots, conveyor belts and cargo trains until your automated factory clears the whole glacier.

apps.name: The Adventures Of Bryan Scott
apps.short_description: "The Adventures of Bryan Scott" is a classic 2D point-and-click adventure game, inspired by masterpieces like "Broken Sword" and "Deponia".

apps.name: The Bastion Protocol
apps.short_description: The Bastion Protocol is an idle tower defense game where a lone tower faces relentless enemy waves. Earn Entropy from kills, strengthen your build, and survive until your tower falls. Turn each run’s rewards into lasting upgrades and return stronger.

apps.name: The Birdwatcher's Journal
apps.short_description: Photograph and identify birds on a mysterious island. Each bird you discover brings you one step closer to uncovering what happened to the researcher before you, and the secrets of the island.

apps.name: The Caffeine Chronicles
apps.short_description: A philosophical interactive visual novel about everyday interactions

apps.name: The Cartoon Adventures
apps.short_description: A comic-book-themed 2D action-platformer roguelite. Erase enemies and obstacles, draw paths and allies, explore randomized Panels, and combine Collectibles to reshape every run.

apps.name: The Clone Cycle
apps.short_description: “The Clone Cycle” is a third-person sci-fi roguelite shooter. Awaken in a collapsed cloning facility, battle aberrant clone lifeforms, collect weapons, abilities and chip modules to break through blockades and reveal the cruel truth behind endless replication cycles.

apps.name: The Coven
apps.short_description: Choose from five elemental witches in a single-player action roguelite. Explore a candlelit, 16-floor tower, shape your build with talents, gear and rune sets, and face familiar people turned into bosses. Time rewinds when you fall, but some growth and treasures endure.

apps.name: The Department of Traffic Safety Simulator
apps.short_description: A 1-4 player physics-based traffic enforcement simulator. The city is broke and the council has a plan: tickets. Lots of tickets. Hand them out with spike strips, grappling hooks and orbital lasers, take down the bosses running each part of town, and keep the city one fine away from anarchy.

apps.name: The Evernight Kingdom
apps.short_description: You are the last daughter of the Marquis house, and the prophesied "Savior". Though nightmares engulf the kingdom, lies and obsessions are deadlier than monsters. Every path exacts a toll. Between love and desire, order and chaos: will you bow to fate, or tear it to pieces?

apps.name: The Exorcist's Apprentice
apps.short_description: A first-person short psychological horror about exorcism. A victim is bound to a bed. A demon lurks inside her. Explore a confined apartment, rely on your mentor's guidance, and discover the precise ritual needed to drive it out.

apps.name: The Fallen Merman
apps.short_description: An officially licensed visual novel based on Lin Qian's The Fallen Merman. A distress call from an abandoned aquarium reunites Bai Chunian and Lanbo. In a world of genetic modification and supernatural powers, relive their journey from wary encounters to a love that defies species and death.

apps.name: The Far Off Up
apps.short_description: One balloon. A little curiosity. A long way up. Guide Ruby and Volly from a lively garden into the solar system in a playful climbing adventure. Collect curious stones, weather cosmic hazards, tackle relay challenges, and explore alone or together.

apps.name: The Fate of Onexora
apps.short_description: The Fate of Onexora is a turn-based, story rich fantasy RPG with a wide array of skills and equipment, allowing you to play in the style that suits you best. Follow the adventures of four heroes who have been unwittingly drawn into an impending catastrophe for which they are held responsible.

apps.name: The Further
apps.short_description: A co-op ghost-hunting horror game for 1 to 4 players, set in the 1970s. Drive your van to haunted houses, gather evidence with period gear, learn the entity's name over the radio and decide: drive it out or set the soul free. Every house, every entity is different.

apps.name: The Game Beneath
apps.short_description: Escape a collapsing dungeon in this fantasy solitaire card puzzle. Arrange cards in numerical order, overcome monsters and traps, and meet each row’s requirements. Choose from four classes, turn wildcards into tools or spells, and carry as much treasure as you can into the light.

apps.name: The Ghost Of Black Forest
apps.short_description: 27 September 2040. Duty officer Remus wakes to a siren and a stranger's warning, and follows a trail of clues into the Black Forest. Sneak past guards, uncover a hidden facility and rescue Rachel in this story-driven third-person stealth game. Some truths stay buried

apps.name: The Golfing Hour
apps.short_description: A realistic-that-turns-goofy Golf incremental game! Earn cash as you golf to buy powerful upgrades. Golf enough and you can turn pro, one step closer to becoming OVERPOWERED! Play with friends, launch your golf ball across different worlds, and see how far one swing can go!

apps.name: The Grand Praetor
apps.short_description: As the seventh heir to the Empress, you have been appointed Grand Praetor to investigate a string of serial murders.Will you seek the truth and expose the conspiracy—or indulge in pleasure and power, doing as you please?

apps.name: The Great Himalayan Noodle Descent
apps.short_description: Build a slide from the summit of Everest, all 29,031 feet of it, and send a pile of flailing noodles hurtling to the bottom. Bend, loop, and launch your way past cliffs and crevasses using real physics. How many noodles will survive the trip?

apps.name: THE HALLWAY
apps.short_description: THE HALLWAY is a chilling text-based, command-line psychological horror experience where every loop changes, your choices matter, and hidden secrets, puzzles, stats, multiple endings, and 20 Steam achievements await.

apps.name: The History of Everything
apps.short_description: A historical TCG in the tradition of Hearthstone and Magic: The Gathering. Craft a deck from unlikely combinations of your favourite figures from across history. No grind, no microtransactions; everyone has all the cards. Play with friends: chat freely, share your decks, and compete to be the best!

apps.name: The Last Wish
apps.short_description: A dead graphics card. An AI genie. Three wishes with a hidden cost. Find five differences in each of 17 illustrated scenes as Theo’s wish to escape work transforms the world around him. A relaxing puzzle game with a dark fantasy story. no timer, no penalty, just a closer look.

apps.name: The Lifeline
apps.short_description:
To escape this terrifying hospital, you must leave your fears behind. Can you do it?

Explore, face zombies, use weapons, avoid traps, and react fast to survive.

apps.name: The Little Aquarist
apps.short_description: Take over a dusty little fish shop and make it the coziest corner in town. Build tiny underwater worlds, keep the water happy and find every customer their perfect fish.

apps.name: The NAKI Files
apps.short_description: The NAKI Files is a first-person cooperative horror game where you awaken humanity and survive attacks from a deep state controlled by the alien Anunnaki, using knowledge, improvisation, and plenty of ammunition.

apps.name: The Nine Oaths
apps.short_description: Eight strangers. Nine ancient pillars. One oath that will cost them everything. Gather a band of travelers across a hand-built diorama world, bring foes low in deep turn-based battles, and live the tragedy that came before Echoes of Creation.

apps.name: THE OCCULT PROTOCOL
apps.short_description: THE OCCULT PROTOCOL is a paranormal investigation horror game for solo or online co-op. Gather evidence, identify the entity, survive its hunts, and prepare the right ritual to banish it.

apps.name: The Rule of Adult
apps.short_description: Unable to find work, you unwittingly join ruthless HarborTech. A strange contract traps your soul. Manage time and resources, meet KPIs and fight turn-based battles to reclaim your soul and quit within 10 weeks. Uncover its secrets in this workplace psychological horror RPG.

apps.name: The Short Hero's Honey Trap Dungeon
The Tale of Mara & Moa
apps.short_description: Mara and Moa have made a terrible mistake and now they need to find the Spirits of the Forest to save their village. Explore a world full of secrets with dynamic and fast-paced combat, alternating between the two characters and channeling the powers of the Sun and the Moon.

apps.name: The Waking Ashes
apps.short_description: A momentum driven sci-fi action shooter. Dash, teleport, slow time and fly in six degrees of freedom to survive relentless combat. Customize and upgrade your weapon and ability load-out to push through escalating enemy encounters in a strange zero gravity open world.

apps.name: Theme Hospital™
apps.short_description: Design, maintain and manage a hi-tech hospital facility, making the most of limited resources and turning cures into cash. Can you balance the books and the bedpans?

apps.name: THEMOSTPOWERFULFIREWALL
apps.short_description: Not a Bug is a relaxing incremental idle defense game. You can’t lose, since every bug dies the moment it reaches the glitch. Install apps, feed the bugs and watch the chaos. Remember: it’s not a bug, it’s a feature.

apps.name: Theriothron Spire
apps.short_description: A young boy ventures into the twisted Tower of the Beast God to save his sister from sacrificial ritual. This adventure RPG blends deep storytelling with classic tactical combat – your choices will forge the final outcome.

apps.name: They Were Here First
apps.short_description: Face a tide of creatures in this incremental horde survivor FPS. You are a robot sent to strip a planet. Power the Extractor, upgrade your chassis, and expand your arsenal.

apps.name: This Game Sucks: A Party Board Game
apps.short_description: A 4–6 player online party board game. Contents: 1 crime city at night, 2 dice, 1 tic-tac-toe grid (3×3), 6 seats, 1 wheel for settling disputes. Warning: contains small parts and big arguments. Friends not included.

apps.name: Thornroad
apps.short_description: Build on a map that grows as you play. Thornroad is a roguelike tower defence with branching paths, card drafts, 17 upgradeable towers, boss battles and a final boss waiting at the end of the road.

apps.name: Thrift & Grift
apps.short_description: Thrifting roguelike. Flip finds from stores and auctions. Patch & style old clothes, spot fake designers (or sell them as real), stack perks and sell for a profit. The landlord is knocking. How long can you keep up?

apps.name: Throne Digger
apps.short_description: An Incremental Dungeon Crawler. Dig out a buried castle room by room in this turn-based pixel art roguelite. Every action costs energy: when it runs out you're back at camp, but everything you dug stays dug. Upgrade your tools, unearth monsters and beat bosses that each play by their own rules.

apps.name: Throw A Life!
apps.short_description:
"Throw A Life!" is a chaotic party survival game for up to four players!
Work together to mine, craft, build, and hunt on a dangerous island.
Divide roles to survive efficiently—or embrace the chaos and have fun with friends!

apps.name: Thveit
apps.short_description: Thveit is a cozy Norse settlement builder where changing seasons, ancient beliefs, and folklore creatures shape the fate of your settlements. Guide your settlers, manage resources, and grow a thriving community as humans and mythical beings learn to live side by side.

apps.name: Tidy Solve
apps.short_description: Tidy Solve is a cozy puzzle game about tidying piles of books, candles and more. Use the power of math to bring order to the mess. Easy to learn, with 1500+ puzzles to solve.

apps.name: Tileland
apps.short_description: Tileland is a turn-based roguelike where every dice roll shapes your fate. Traverse enchanted tiles, upgrade your arsenal, wield powerful runes and potions, and outmaneuver deadly enemies in a world where strategy meets chance.

apps.name: Tilemancer
apps.short_description: Build a deck of the dead, solve battles disguised as tactical board puzzles, and defeat an even more evil version of yourself, again and again.

apps.name: Time Champions
apps.short_description: Recruit units from different historical periods and defend the timeline against alien invaders in this action-roguelike. Mix and match units to discover game-breaking synergies and use hero powers to survive enemy hordes. Unlock new units and evolve them to wreak absolute chaos on the battlefield!

apps.name: Time Distortionists
apps.short_description: Manage time itself from a base outside causality in this turn-based strategy game. Scan and deploy agents across 13 billion years to stabilize collapsing eras. Build infrastructure to extract resources and defend the timeline. Every mission ripples through time. You can't save everything.

apps.name: Tinsel versus the Naughty List
apps.short_description: Tinsel the elf has landed on the NAUGHTY LIST, and she's come to Santa's office to appeal. She swears she's innocent, but every snow globe of evidence tells a much NAUGHTIER story. A comedic, real-time 3D Interactive Erotic Story where you play Santa and decide her fate: Naughty or Nice?

apps.name: Tiny Forge
apps.short_description: Run a tiny fantasy forge where your handiwork faces real battles. Smelt, hammer, sharpen and assemble weapons by hand, fulfill warrior orders, and equip your defenders for daily monster raids. Small forge. Big battles.

apps.name: Tiny Fortress
apps.short_description: [Previously called "Tiny Towers"] A short incremental game about defending your tiny fortress from hordes of tiny mobs. Place towers, gain resources by defeating enemies, and unlock new upgrades in the skill tree to strengthen your goblin stronghold.

apps.name: Tiny Planets: Dream Defender
apps.short_description: OkToy was a Japanese toy made to free children from nightmares, but after successful tests the project was shut down. Years later, a surviving copy ends up in a boy’s hands. Now his things come to life in the dream: build a base on a tiny spinning planet and upgrade it to survive the night.

apps.name: TOKUGI ARENA
apps.short_description: Generate energy by typing, solving Tsume Shogi and completing other challenges, then spend it on projectiles, blades and barriers. A team-based action game with CPU practice, solo challenges, Score Attack and compatible VRM avatars.

apps.name: TOO EZ!
apps.short_description:
An illustrated music video, and this time you play it! Aim with your mouse and click to the beat. That's it. New to rhythm games? Start with TOO EZ!
You can do it. TOO EZ!

apps.name: Too Many Animals !
apps.short_description: A cozy first-person sorting game: catch, identify and throw over 6,000 cube animals from 300+ species onto the right shelves. Turn a giant pile of chaos into a perfect collection.

apps.name: Too. Many. Socks.
apps.short_description: 4,000 socks. One giant mess. Find matching pairs, fill shelves, and complete orders in a cozy first-person sorting game. Then unlock a second workshop and build your own sorting lines with conveyors, robotic arms, and delivery robots.

apps.name: Torvane
apps.short_description: Torvane is a skill-based online melee team game for PC. Take a role as tank, DPS or healer, read your opponent and win the duel with timing and spacing. Server-authoritative netcode, no pay-to-win. Your first fighter is the Khaedr, a warrior from an original sci-fi honor culture.

apps.name: Tower Maintenance Simulator
apps.short_description: Climb hundreds of meters above the ground to maintain and repair communication towers. Choose your tools, secure your harness, diagnose faults and complete dangerous maintenance jobs where one mistake can send you — or your tools — falling.

apps.name: Transfer
apps.short_description: Transfer supplies with a Train in a post apocalyptic world filled with creatures that you need to fend off to survive and do your goal

apps.name: Trap Testers
apps.short_description: Sometimes you just want to kill your friends. Well, here's your chance! Trap Testers is a chaotic multiplayer deathrun where everyone places traps before racing to the finish. Sabotage your friends, dodge their traps, and try not to die to your own.

apps.name: TRAUMATA
apps.short_description: TRAUMATA is pure, concentrated adrenaline! Dive into the underbelly of psychological horror where every secret brings you closer to ascension... or drags you into the abyss of madness. Fight off endless waves, master the ultimate action, and dominate the global leaderboards!

apps.name: Trench League
apps.short_description: Punch your way to the spiked steel ball and smash it into the enemy cage. The side with the most breaches wins. Knock rivals out and the Reclaim drags them off. Face opponents from different planets of the Solar System and fight your way to the Solar Final! Test your skills against real opponents!

apps.name: Trenite Engineer
apps.short_description: You don't pilot the ship-you run it. Manage power, fuel, gravity, life support and other systems, repair failures and engineer your way through a hostile solar system.

apps.name: Tube Man Terry
apps.short_description: Survive being hunted by a 40-foot inflatable tube man and his brothers in a shut-down theme park for seven nights. Earn upgrades from the carnival crew, bolt weapons onto an old park tram, and begin your own hunt.

apps.name: TURBOCARDS
