apps.short_description: Klondike, Spider and FreeCell for your computer and your handheld. Play with mouse, keyboard or controller — however you like, on whatever you like. Four skin sets, modifiers and a Daily Challenge with verified deals. Windows, macOS, Linux and SteamOS.

apps.name: Turn&Boost
apps.short_description: An arcade racer about drifting and boosting. Slide through banked bends, fill your gauge with drifts, slipstreams and close passes, then fire your booster. In the cups you race three courses in a row against eleven rivals for points.

apps.name: Twin Study
apps.short_description:
A point-and-click puzzle game about twins, genetics, and something hidden in the choice of words.

A suspected murder recounted by the suspected murderer. Delve into the mind of an unreliable narrator. Pay attention to what each puzzle reveals.

apps.name: Twinblocks
apps.short_description: Master an addictive arcade falling-block puzzle game with roguelite progression. Unlock powerful card-based upgrades, unleash spectacular combos, conquer handcrafted worlds, and create your own levels.

apps.name: TySina
apps.short_description: Bring your own character to your desktop. Every time you type or move your mouse, your character moves diligently with you.

apps.name: Ultima™ IX: Ascension
apps.short_description: Featuring the legendary Ultima System of Virtues where moral fiber is more powerful than physical might. Find out if you have what it takes to be the ultimate hero.

apps.name: Umbral Coterie
apps.short_description: A dark medieval city simulation with procedural generation and emergent storytelling. Play as a vampire and observe, befriend, manipulate, and betray hundreds of fully simulated citizens as they live, work, scheme, and die around you. Shape bloodlines and uncover the forces moving beneath the city.

apps.name: Unboxed: Idle Case Tycoon
apps.short_description: Open cases, collect rare weapon skins, and build a fully automated skin business. Upgrade your auto-openers, fill your Vault, and outbid the bots in the Auction House. One more case. Always one more.

apps.name: Unearther
apps.short_description: Explore a handcrafted-procedural world where discoveries and challenging adventures await. Gather resources, craft equipment, build your home, survive dangerous creatures, and uncover the mysteries hidden within.

apps.name: UNFIT
apps.short_description: UNFIT is a brutal party game for 2–6 clones: you've been assembled, now you'll be inspected. Friends are rivals here — shove first before you get shoved. QC will test you with a press, a crane, gas, a bullet and more. The defect quota must be met. Slip up — DEFECT. Only one will be FIT.

apps.name: Universe Sandbox Legacy
apps.short_description: Create and destroy on a scale you’ve never imagined!

apps.name: Unmetaverse
apps.short_description: Have you ever tried VRSNS but quit because you couldn't get used to the community? Unmetaverse is a VRSNS for people who have no friends. No voice chat, open world MMO space with content that you can enjoy alone.

apps.name: Vault Raiders
apps.short_description: Every room is a puzzle. Every action is a card. Read enemy intentions and fight for position in this roguelite tactical deckbuilder.

apps.name: Vectorline: Air Traffic Control Simulator
apps.short_description: Vectorline is a realistic air traffic control simulator. Sequence departures and arrivals, keep aircraft separated, and clear them to land at real-world airports. Type commands, click and drag aircrafts, or speak clearances out loud. Find out if you can become a controller!

apps.name: Veiled Whispers
apps.short_description: A school at night. A girl missing for 23 days. Seven children you can still hear singing. Veiled Whispers is first-person psychological horror with two stories set in the same school, choices that matter, and a building that knows exactly what you did.

apps.name: Vein Defense
apps.short_description: A lighthearted mining tower defense game: swing your hook to haul gold, gems and chests, invest the profits in turrets, drones and upgrade cards, and hold your vein through an expedition of escalating waves and bosses.

apps.name: Vinculum
apps.short_description: Do the math and survive the aftermath. An easy-to-learn card battler: pull off math combos, get stuck in a fraction, stack functions until the numbers go absurd, break the enemy lines, try not to divide by zero. Real, modern, correct math. But when math isn't enough, resort to more arcane means...

apps.name: Vinland: 1000
apps.short_description: Lead a Norse colony in Vinland across 50 years of survival, politics, relationships, and faith. Make difficult choices to manage food, shelter, defense, popularity, and the colony’s shifting allegiance between the old gods, Rome, and Constantinople.

apps.name: Violence of Action
apps.short_description: Command squads in real time, pause to coordinate complex assaults, or instantly take direct control of any soldier or vehicle. Fight across destructible battlefields in a procedurally generated World War II-inspired tactical campaign.

apps.name: VOID CLICKER: Infinite Prestige
apps.short_description: Void Clicker: Infinite Prestige is a Free to Play cosmic idle clicker Game. Click the Black Hole, use Taskbar Mode, trade hundreds of Steam items, collect pets, meet random NPCs, master endless Prestige and create your ultimate build.

apps.name: Voxel Gambit
apps.short_description: Classic chess reborn as a 3D tactical RPG. Command unique pieces based on RPG classes across procedurally generated battlefields. Manage your action points, test your units' 'effort' and survive an adaptive AI on dynamic maps. The board has evolved.

apps.name: VoxWish
apps.short_description: Survive the Stone Age at a campfire with Orin at your side. Keep the fire burning and settlers come. Then watch that same spot grow into a village, a castle town, a harbour, a city and the neon city of 2077. A voxel survival sandbox where the world behaves like a world.

apps.name: Wargasbord: Battle Simulator
apps.short_description: Pit armies from across history against each other in massive, ridiculous battles. Fight Romans Legionaries vs. Union Soldiers vs. Tiger Tanks all on the same battlefield.

apps.name: Warlords
apps.short_description: Command a war unfolding at your feet. Warlords is a diorama sized FP-RTS where you build, expand and conquer as a godlike commander. Rally your armies & dragons, wield powerful abilities, forge alliances, betray rivals and fight for control. Build a reputation and play minigames in the social lobby.

apps.name: Warstation
apps.short_description: Exciting games in Virtual Reality! Created to make guests come to the arena again and again and find something new for themselves every time.

apps.name: Watch Party: Watch the Web Together
apps.short_description: Watch Party is a 1–16 player online social hangout where you can watch videos and browse the web with friends or strangers. Join public rooms or create a private space. Stay synchronized or watch at your own pace. Play classic board games while you hang out together.

apps.name: Wave & Sort: The Magic Wand Shop
apps.short_description: A cozy first-person sorting game in a wrecked magic wand shop. Find a home for 2,400 wands, tidy up the elemental halls and unlock handy upgrades. Play at your own pace, with no timers and no fail state.

apps.name: Waxpack
apps.short_description: A baseball roguelite where the lineup is the build. Nine players, twenty games, one spin an at-bat, and a run total that should not be possible. The cards are the collection. Something will go wrong.

apps.name: Wayward Wind
apps.short_description:
A trading simulation traveling between cities to buy, sell, and profit from commodities in an ever-changing market, inspired by real-world commodity movements.
Turn market knowledge, timing, and a little luck into profit as you grow from an ordinary trader into a master of commerce.

apps.name: We Have a Gnome Problem
apps.short_description: Your toy shop has a gnome problem. In this cozy first-person tidying game, catch a whole shopful of runaway gnomes, toss the troublemakers and put every single one back on its proper shelf.

apps.name: Welcome, [Employee Name]
apps.short_description:
Welcome, [Employee Name]! You are our new space station controller. We trust you to make all the right decisions and keep the people of the HonkyTonk space station safe. Process as many trucks as possible but be careful, mistakes have consequences.
Welcome to the Honky Tonk Family!

apps.name: What a Shift!
apps.short_description: What a Shift! is a chaotic top-down restaurant management roguelite. Serve burgers, fries and drinks, survive growing queues and disasters, choose upgrades each run, then spend your earnings on permanent improvements before jumping back into another shift.

apps.name: What Have I Become?
apps.short_description: Live an entire life through the personality you build. Every choice strengthens, weakens or transforms cards in your deck and that changes which choices become possible. Replay different lives, endings and identities, see what you became in your final Life Report. No correct answer has been filed.

apps.name: What Lies Within
apps.short_description: What Lies Within is a co-op first person psychological horror. You and your team must work together to complete objectives within abandoned facilities owned by your employer, 'M-E-L'. A bioengineering company conducting top secret biological experimentation on aliens, humans and more...

apps.name: When DEI won the world
apps.short_description:
Every hentai game on Earth has been banned—and YOU'RE the one responsible!!!!!
As punishment, the God of Hentai has trapped you inside this bizarre quiz game! Answer questions and come face-to-face with characters from other hentai games that were canceled because of you!!

apps.name: When the Stars Threw Down Their Spears
apps.short_description: When the Stars Threw Down Their Spears is a story-rich, retro space shooter inspired by DOS-era space games. Blast your way through fast-paced arcade combat, build out modular, upgradable ships, and explore a galaxy torn by war.

apps.name: Whenever We Rise
apps.short_description: Gravity is your greatest weapon as you launch enemies into the air and spike them back down in this tactical roguelite with a unique perspective.

apps.name: Who's NULL?
apps.short_description:
A killer named NULL lurks in a beautiful, silent liminal space.

Who's NULL? is a 4–8 player online social deduction game. Players appear as flickering silhouettes, identifiable only by footsteps.

VISITORS complete shapes to escape. NULL kills to stop them. Compare footsteps and vote out suspects.

apps.name: Wild Ones Evolution
apps.short_description: Wild Ones is a free-to-play turn-based multiplayer artillery game where customizable pets battle across destructible arenas with wild weapons, physics, and tactical positioning. Outsmart your opponents, reshape the battlefield, and master every shot.

apps.name: WILD SEX
apps.short_description: WILD SEX - is a simple 2D game for adults in which you have to uncover hot images of beautiful ladies.

apps.name: Wild Spirits Era
apps.short_description: Wild Spirits Era is a multiplayer PvPvE battle royale with roguelite progression. Up to 50 Spirits enter a new world for each 28-minute Era. Gather Vital Energy, build, fight and form alliances. Your actions shape your class. Only Spirits protected by a Relic endure when the world ends.

apps.name: Wilderings: The Lost Spring
apps.short_description: Restore a world consumed by corruption in this roguelite creature collector. Battle enemies alongside mystical Hântu, and combine their powers to unleash devastating attacks. Unlock permanent upgrades aboard your Skyship and grow stronger with every run. From the BAFTA-winning creators of Endling.

apps.name: Wing Commander™ III: Heart of the Tiger™
apps.short_description: Wing Commander III: Heart of the Tiger is one of the most iconic games of the 1990s. Now celebrated in this special 30th Anniversary Edition, the game has been restored in collaboration with the dedicated Wing Commander community.

apps.name: Wing Commander™ IV: The Price of Freedom
apps.short_description: Wing Commander IV: The Price of Freedom is one of the most iconic games of the 1990s. Now celebrated in this special 30th Anniversary Edition, the game has been restored in collaboration with the dedicated Wing Commander community.

apps.name: Wing Commander™ Prophecy: 30th Anniversary Edition
apps.short_description: Wing Commander: Prophecy includes the base game plus the amazing Secret Ops episodes. Now celebrated in this special 30th Anniversary Edition, the game has been restored in collaboration with the dedicated Wing Commander community.

apps.name: Wing Commander™: 35th Anniversary Edition
apps.short_description: Wing Commander defined the space combat genre upon its release in 1990. Now celebrated in this special 35th Anniversary Edition, the game has been restored in collaboration with the dedicated Wing Commander community.

apps.name: Wing Commander™: Privateer
apps.short_description: In the far reaches of space, you live by no man’s rules but your own. Choose the life of a pirate, merchant or mercenary. It takes more than a pilot to win this game - it takes a Privateer!

apps.name: Wings And Torrent
apps.short_description:
More than a story, more than a game. Explore a handcrafted 3D world alongside unique characters in an action-packed RPG where your choices reshape the fate of the world.

THE RPG where nobody has to be the villain.

apps.name: Winx Club - Moonlight Quest
apps.short_description: Fly into a brand-new Winx Club adventure! Play as Bloom, transform, take flight, and freely explore an open world inspired by the series. Unravel the mystery of the Festival of the 100 Moons.

apps.name: Wireframe
apps.short_description: Stem the tide of endless hordes of enemies in a new, retro styled, and fast paced arcade shooter game. Buy upgrades, and earn the highest score you can through mastery of movement, precision, and endurance.

apps.name: Witnesses
apps.short_description: Witnesses is a detective visual novel in a grim noir style. You are a private detective assigned two strange cases.

apps.name: Wizard School Dropout
apps.short_description: You left wizard school in disgrace, and now have only one option to pay off your student loans: crime. Wizard School Dropout is a magic-focused, turn-based RPG and wizard simulator featuring heavy environmental interactions and spell combinations for a wide variety of playstyles. Be Mage Do Crime!

apps.name: Wolfsbanner: Medieval Kingdom RPG
apps.short_description: Fight with a longsword in brutal third-person melee: block, shove, stun and finish armored foes in bloody executions. Then rule as king of a living 1403 Central European town you build stone by stone, in the same world, with no loading screen.

apps.name: Woodshire Foragers
apps.short_description: Gather resources, craft powerful gear, and build a thriving village where villagers automate production. Explore colorful lands, battle enemies and bosses, solve puzzles, and conquer dungeons alone or with friends in online co-op.

apps.name: World Tree Keeper
apps.short_description: Regrow the World Tree from a single seed to the stars in this relaxing pixel-art idle game. Gather Life, summon Spirits and give them work, build their homes, unlock research, and Rebirth to grow stronger, then defend your tree from withered Spirits pouring out of the night sky.

apps.name: Worldsmith by Charles A. Debczak
apps.short_description: Write books that open rifts into procedurally generated dimensions in this 2D open-world survival adventure. Build, craft, mine, fight, create custom spells, choose your bloodline, and explore strange worlds alone or with friends.

apps.name: Wrong Address
apps.short_description: A new courier takes over a missing man's route in this atmospheric horror mystery. Drive through rain and fog, deliver packages to strange locals, and find out who is lying about Walt Hale's disappearance before the blame falls on you.

apps.name: X Marks the Orc
apps.short_description: An auto-battler roguelite. Call a play, mark who dies first, give each hero a job, then watch the fight unfold. Between fights, buy and merge units to grow your party.

apps.name: XDefense LF
apps.short_description: Your castle is under attack! Defend your walls with pets and magical creatures at your side across 200+ levels and unlock unique weapons and skills. Take on Challenge, Epic and Legendary modes, enjoy minigames, and face Peusk, the god of thunder, and Morttuks in two brutal final battles.

apps.name: XtreaM Zombies
apps.short_description: Survive escalating zombie waves in a top-down shooter, solo or with a friend in online co-op. Earn cash, collect loot and blueprints, and turn each purchase into a better chance of survival. Complete achievements to unlock cosmetics and rescue cats along the way.

apps.name: Yes Chef!
apps.short_description: A first-person co-op restaurant game for 1 to 6 players, played in runs. Cook, serve, earn money and buy new equipment at the end of each day. Reach the final day to win, but let your customers down and the run is over.

apps.name: You're a dad
apps.short_description: A sleep-deprived text adventure about new parenthood, daydreaming, and the things left unsaid. Be a responsible adult, make dinner and take care of your child. You must do this. Nothing else.

apps.name: Your Reimu
apps.short_description: Hakurei Reimu comes to your desktop. Poke her or pick her up and she reacts just like Reimu would, and she'll keep an eye on your to-dos and alarms too. Blunt, but the type who quietly sticks by your side.

apps.name: Yuha's Nightmares. Episode One: Catastrophe
apps.short_description: Dive into Yuha's nightmares. Bear witness to a glitch apocalypse. Explore the hidden layers of a 3D-dreamscape. Piece together her memories and fears. Experience a true haunting with vanishing staircases, lost voices and time that keeps running out.

apps.name: Zandbox Survival
apps.short_description: Survive a zombie outbreak in the real streets of Paris. Every street and building is rebuilt from real map data, and every place can become your own. Scavenge, fight off the dead, and build your colony to take the city back.

apps.name: Zen House: Zed Zero Simulator
apps.short_description: Stare at a house. Question your life choices. This is Zen House: Zed Zero Simulator, the ultimate digital do-nothing simulator designed to waste your time and amplify your existential dread.

apps.name: Zero Colour
apps.short_description: Crazy Eights reimagined as a roguelike deckbuilder. Chain cards by color and number, build huge combos and take down bosses with unique abilities. Five distinct decks, the Corruption Zone and quick runs that never play the same.

apps.name: ZOMBIE DESTROYER
apps.short_description: Just dodge. Your guns do the shooting. Quick, punchy runs, then toss your cells into the incinerator and watch the coins pour out.

apps.name: Zombie Incremental: The Last Outpost
apps.short_description: Fight zombies. Earn gold. Upgrade your arsenal. Push deeper into a fallen world in this action-packed incremental shooter. Aim, dodge, and turn hard-earned upgrades into the firepower you need to survive the next wave.

apps.name: ⋆｡°✩ Y2K Meter ✩°｡⋆
apps.short_description: Y2Kmeter is a free, open-source desktop audio analyzer with a retro pixel look. Explore loudness, levels, phase, dynamics and spectrum, plus audio-reactive visuals, a desktop virtual pet, fuse-bead pixel art and an analog VU meter. Poke every module in Toybox mode.

apps.name: みんなで間違い探しスタジアム
apps.short_description: Find the one that doesn't belong. A board packed with near-identical characters hides a single odd one out — spot it fast, alone or against up to 8 players online.

apps.name: 世界傳記
apps.short_description: Fantasy RPG that features AP turn-based combat and various RPG nurturing elements, while also offering rich and diverse character storylines that grip the heart.

apps.name: 世界防衛少女!!-DEFENDER MAIDEN-
apps.short_description: This is an action game featuring a mysterious girl who takes on hordes of monsters with her sword and bombs.

apps.name: 亲吻那片花瓣：米迦勒的少女们
apps.short_description: 承接著名的《亲吻那片花瓣》系列作品，《米迦勒的少女们》在原有剧情基础上拓展了各位少女们的故事——这些情节跨越了数月时光，描绘了她们生活中的种种磨难。在少女们不断成长并相互扶持的过程中，百合终将绽放。

apps.name: 仙帝神兵
apps.short_description: 《仙帝神兵》是一款国风神话题材的史诗级3D动作游戏。游戏以中国古代神话为背景，打造恢弘壮阔 的六界战场，采用高品质3D画面，呈现震撼唯美的仙侠世界。上古神兵现世，六界风云再起，群雄争 霸，强者为尊！你将化身天命修行者，从凡尘崛起，历经重重试炼，收神兵、斩妖魔、破苍穹，一路 杀上巅峰，成就属于你的不朽传说！

apps.name: 仙武三国
apps.short_description: 《仙武三国》是一款三国×修仙题材的买断制单机放置游戏。收名将、排兵布阵、攻城略地，在百世轮回中积累龙气，从乱世小卒一步步登临真龙天子。无内购、无强制联网，100 章完整主线。

apps.name: 修仙除魔传
apps.short_description: Start as a Qi Refining loose cultivator and forge your path to immortality. Fight with real-time movement, farm monsters on idle auto-hunt, jump in whenever you want.

apps.name: 勇者の輪迴之旅
apps.short_description: In this roguelike adventure game, your heroic journey begins at 11. Experience unique story interactions, battles, puzzles and character development. Your past, personality and fate are shaped by random yearly events. Story packs provide multiple dramatic main story paths.

apps.name: 命运地牢
apps.short_description: A boldly designed dark pixel roguelite: pinned to the execution stage, spend souls born from pain to spin the Fate Wheel, build self-firing Marks, and execute the Host before it awakens.

apps.name: 夜航船
apps.short_description: 深夜的小巷，她从电台里走到了你面前，从那一刻起声音不再只是声音，它染上了温度，也变得更加沉重。你开始重新审视自己，他人，以及这座县城里被遗忘的烟火与孤独。这是一个关于倾听与理解的漫长航行，在无边的黑暗中，你与她一同探索，寻找那道或许并不存在的光。

apps.name: 夢見草の夜、君と
apps.short_description: 夢の中で"花祈姫"と呼ばれる、前世の自分――。前世と現世が交差する、和風幻想恋愛アドベンチャー(乙女ゲーム)。5人の男性と紡ぐ、想いを繋ぐ恋の物語。

apps.name: 夢遊邊境 Dream of Limbo
apps.short_description: Dive into a bullet-hell world where nightmares and fairytales meet. Play as Psyche, a highly mobile heroine who fights with three distinct partners. Enter the corrupted Kingdom of Oz, weave through deadly bullet patterns, and challenge bosses with overwhelming power.

apps.name: 大羿仙族 Dayi Immortal Clan
apps.short_description: Da Yi Immortal Clan is a clan cultivation RPG mixing clan management with 2D side-scrolling shooting. 🏹🌞👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 You are no lone cultivator but a clan head. As a Da Yi descendant, lead the clan and fulfill its mission of Guarding the Golden Crow in the primordial twilight.

apps.name: 太一剑歌
apps.short_description: 《太一剑歌》是一款独特的东方幻想开放世界MMORPG！游戏拥有超过6万平方公里的超大无缝地图，你将在这个充满剑与魔法的世界中展开一场惊险刺激的自由冒险之旅！你的每一个行为将影响周围的世界，并决定这个世界的未来！

apps.name: 太平战纪：穿越成上帝次子，就要拿出真本事！
apps.short_description: A turn-based card strategy game set in the Taiping Rebellion. Guided by Heaven, you become Hong Xiuquan, God's second son. Unlock characters, build a team, and exploit Five Elements matchups and formation bonuses. Complete six story chapters; unlock roguelike challenges after Chapter 2.

apps.name: 太空超市大整理
apps.short_description: Gravity clocked out. You didn't. Tidy a zero-gravity supermarket in this first-person organizing game. Catch floating goods, sort them onto shelves, and unlock and upgrade sci-fi tools. Turn drifting clutter into satisfying order, one item at a time.

apps.name: 孤狼之春
apps.short_description: This is a true-harem galgame set in a Western fantasy world.

apps.name: 少女的百鬼屋
apps.short_description: Ghostarium blends haunted house management, ghost catching, and otherworldly exploration. Venture into another world and capture ghosts to work in your haunted house! Build your ghost collection, expand your attraction, and turn visitors’ screams into cash!

apps.name: 少年：浴火重生
apps.short_description: A 24-year-old out-of-work young man scraping by in an urban village. Run a street-food cart, deliver takeout, fish by the river, play Go and xiangqi in the park — try every hustle to pay off that debt. Every choice rewrites the ending of this street.

apps.name: 废土小饭馆
apps.short_description: Little Wasteland Diner is a cozy post-apocalyptic life and management game. Restore a forgotten diner, grow and gather ingredients, cook comforting meals, explore the surrounding ruins, befriend the townsfolk, and slowly bring warmth and life back to the town—one bowl of soup at a time.

apps.name: 忒修斯之女
apps.short_description: You saved your daughter Xiaohe with an illegal operation. Now another girl's memories surface in her words and expressions. In this full-motion video adventure, trace the other side of the surgery and face a choice: bring back the girl you remember, or hold on to the one she is now?

apps.name: 性无能者的空庭
apps.short_description: Dry Spring Monologue is a chapter-based visual novel game that follows Lu Zimo. The story includes adult themes such as overtime work, insomnia, and performance reviews, as well as terrifying elements like living spaghetti.

apps.name: 恋爱，我就借走咯
apps.short_description: 为了筹集妹妹高昂的学费，守财奴男主新海幸意外踏入了名为「人才租赁」的奇妙行当。在扮演男友、密友乃至情夫的虚假契约掩护下，少女们不为人知的隐秘欲望与真实心声悄然绽放。以金钱维系的脆弱羁绊终将遭遇现实的考验，当这层层伪装剥落时，究竟会是财尽缘散，还是假戏真做呢？一场充满谎言与心跳的青春恋爱喜剧就此上演。

apps.name: 懒得起名字
apps.short_description: Animal shape survivor game.

apps.name: 挖哦 WOoOW
apps.short_description:
A digging and exploration game about “Emergence.” 
Game Jam’s here, but you’re out of ideas? Dig into your mind! Explore, find treasures, and see what emerges!

apps.name: 摩登迷城
apps.short_description: GAZE IN SHADOWS is a narrative detective adventure. In Prohibition-era Ashford, PI Zack Brennan solves five deadly cases shrouded in greed and lies. Search crime scenes, interrogate suspects, and confront corruption with hard evidence. A murder can be closed... but who will put this city on trial?

apps.name: 方寸海洋物语
apps.short_description: 《方寸海洋物语》是一款极致追求画面观赏质感，力求还原真实海缸生态的模拟养鱼游戏。工作时它安静地待在屏幕一角，陪你敲代码、写文档；学习累了，抬头看看游动的小鱼，为自己换一口气；你也可以坐在客厅沙发上欣赏这仅属于你的海洋。点点鼠标即可轻松养护，看小丑鱼钻进海葵，繁育各种珍奇鱼种，你的薄荷仙在等你。

apps.name: 无基之谈2D
apps.short_description: Eggy, an otaku, wakes up one day to find himself transformed into a cute girl?! Ballshit 2D reimagines the original live-action story as a 2D visual novel. Follow Eggy through campus life, friendships, awkward romance, and absurd surprises, with new 2D art, CGs, and the original voice acting.

apps.name: 明末：甲申年
apps.short_description: Set during the fall of the Ming dynasty in 1644, this historical grand-strategy narrative game lets you rule as the Chongzhen Emperor, fight for the Shun regime, lead another faction, or survive as a commoner. Govern, wage war, manage resources, and reshape history through AI-assisted court debates.

apps.name: 暗黑深井
apps.short_description: Dark Well is a platformer deck-building roguelike. Every weapon brings its own skill cards — adjust your loadout to shape your deck. Craft gems with wild affixes to empower your cards. Use cards to move, take the angle, dodge the killing blow. Keep going down and explore the sunless depths!

apps.name: 月落对谈
apps.short_description: The moon is falling, and the world nears its end. You play as Hill, a museum curator who chooses to stay on Earth. There, you meet 12, a mysterious red-haired woman who keeps you company as the world fades. Through your final conversations, you uncover her secret—and perhaps, the reason you stayed.

apps.name: 桌面仙途：人在工位坐，仙在桌上修
apps.short_description:
Immortal Ascension: Battle of Heaven
A cultivation-world idle RPG mobile game—gain offline experience, transcend tribulations to boost realm. It has a fantasy storyline (dual heroines), auto-explore mazes, sect play, marketplace, cave resources, and events.

apps.name: 極上人妻-盛夏派對
apps.short_description: You've planned a beach getaway with married women and radiant ladies you've met through your work. Play a simple falling-object merge game to unlock steamy encounters with each character! Your secret romances with these married women will all be laid bare under the sun!!!

apps.name: 榜上无名
apps.short_description: 挂机修仙：一个资质平平、没有靠山的散修，和众生榜上 400 位有名有姓的修士过同一段日子，从榜上无名起步，一步一步修到飞升。

apps.name: 沦为萌犬-被姐姐们温柔偏爱
沫引 Moyin
apps.short_description: A free, fully Mandarin-voiced visual novel about one spring in your second year of university. Zhang Yuanying, your classmate from the dance club, or Li Yanying, the graduate TA of your Data Structures class: two romance routes, eight endings. Text and voice are in Chinese only.

apps.name: 流転のジェミニ
apps.short_description: The other half of your soul—never let go. Walk the Afterworld with a same-sex partner in this turn-based dark fantasy RPG. Joy, anger, sadness: every emotion the story stirs becomes power in battle. Your smallest choices shape your bond and lead to one of four endings. Hope, or sweet, cruel ruin?

apps.name: 涂鸦学院
apps.short_description: A fantasy school auto-battler where you collect and fuse cards, combine hero, race, and class synergies, and build teams for battle.

apps.name: 灯守
apps.short_description: When the lamps go out, the world turns to ash. Follow Hina, an apprentice Lampkeeper, as she searches for her vanished master. A dark-fantasy adventure RPG of command-based exploration, escape-room puzzles, and tactical turn-based battles — 10 chapters, 5 to 8 hours.

apps.name: 王のレガシー
apps.short_description: "Kings Legacy" is a third-person action RPG where you control a beautiful heroine, enjoying simple action mechanics and a deep progression system to forge your own combat style. By transforming into a griffin, the protagonist can fly, allowing you to freely explore and enjoy your adventure.

apps.name: 琳琅商传
apps.short_description:
Linlang's Ledger is an idle RPG game with an ancient Chinese trading theme.
Starting as a penniless merchant, you will travel across vast countries, learn professional skills, and build connections with all sorts of people, writing a colorful business legend in a relaxed and enjoyable atmosphere.

apps.name: 疯狂德州
apps.short_description: Play always-online no-limit Texas Hold'em at a first-person 3D table. Join public games, create rooms for friends, or start instantly while AI fills empty seats. Build a persistent virtual-chip balance, watch matches, and reconnect after brief interruptions.

apps.name: 白之树：月泪少女
apps.short_description: 《白之树：月泪少女》在没有陆地的世界里，人类仍在航行。世界被海洋吞没，文明碎裂成漂浮的船团。而在这片无尽之海中，唯一稳定的光源，是一种名为“白之树”的神秘存在。它结出的果实——“月之泪”，维系着整个世界的运转。但没有人知道，它究竟是什么。

apps.name: 百鬼盤
apps.short_description: Collect yokai, capture pieces, and drain HP. Shogi-like moves plus damage and combos; matches last 5–10 minutes. Build a 50+ yokai roster and guard your general. Solo streaks in Night Parade, or online random match and room codes. Cross-play with the browser version. Free, no ads, no paid gacha.

apps.name: 絕頂特務Ｘ
apps.short_description: As the Harmonizer, lead elite female agents in Agent X, an adult idle tactical RPG. Enjoy cold espionage by day, intimate dynamic H-Play by night, and build your lethal sci-fi harem!

apps.name: 终点防线
apps.short_description: This is a solo strategy game blending deckbuilding, real-time grid defense, and roguelike progression. Escort piggy passengers through danger! Inspired by Slay the Spire. We’ve moved beyond traditional turn-based combat, combining card strategy with survival pressure for a fresh experience!

apps.name: 花散る社のハナビメ
apps.short_description: Hanachiru Shrine no Hanabime is a Japanese-inspired sorting and idle game where you gather faith by discerning people's wishes and restore a once-abandoned sacred shrine. Enjoy a unique blend of peaceful, relaxing moments and fast-paced shrine duties as you rebuild the divine sanctuary.
developers: ハナビメプロジェクト
publishers: ハナビメプロジェクト

apps.name: 諾提里森：於黎明之前－珍藏版
apps.short_description: An original, fantasy-themed BL adult card RPG adventure game. Centered around a suspenseful storyline and complemented by beautiful, moving music, it offers an immersive gaming experience.

apps.name: 走走小日
apps.short_description: Moments is a point to go adventure game where you can explore the land with two besties,  Mai and Shiro. There are tasks and puzzles that help Mai with solving her way through the adventure. She captures the cute creatures, Hibimon, which helps unlock important mysteries in the diary.

apps.name: 超自然事件
apps.short_description: A 4‑player online co‑op paranormal horror game.Play as paranormal investigators, travel to haunted sites, use ghost‑hunting devices to collect clues, identify ghost types, and dial the correct frequency number to perform exorcism. Cooperate with teammates to finish investigations amid lurking terror

apps.name: 迷雾象棋
apps.short_description: This is a Chinese chess variant with a fog of war mechanic added. the difference is that fog of war has been added to the board. The vision range is: 1. the four positions directly above, below, left, and right of each piece; 2. each piece's interactable positions.

apps.name: 醜イ
apps.short_description:
A Japanese survival horror game inspired by family values. “Ugliness”—is it a person, a supernatural entity, or something else?
The protagonist, Shu, teams up with Reiko to confront supernatural entities using limited resources and means of defense, as they attempt to escape from a confined space.

apps.name: 野生机
apps.short_description: Step into BIO: Wild Machine—a hand-drawn biopunk world created by the author, and explore the perilous "New Tower of Babel," a city once a milestone in human life technology, now in decline. You must reinvent yourself, battling powerful enemies and unknown fears in harsh turn-based combat.

apps.name: 魔塔合集：新新魔塔、新新魔塔2、混沌幻想、纳可物语
apps.short_description: Explore 14 Mota dungeon adventures across 1,952 maps, including Xinxin, Xinxin 2, Chaos Fantasy and Neko. Plan routes, manage keys and gems, and compare battle costs. Play offline with separate saves, character choices and dungeon themes. Game content is primarily in Simplified Chinese.

apps.name: 黑色基因
apps.short_description:
The man known as the ""Argent Wolf of Syssalus.""
His veins carry a ""special gene"" potent enough to drive any woman into a heady frenzy.

Now, he boards a flight back to Tobia from Syssalus,
bearing unhealed wounds from his past,
and the memory of the tragedy that changed everything.

apps.name: 鼠鼠的桌面环游
apps.short_description:
Welcome to the world of Chichi the little mouse!
Chichi is a tiny traveler with big dreams, and their only piece of luggage is a little ball. Keep Chichi company while you work or study, and help make their journey more colorful, cozy, and full of surprises.

apps.short_description: The After the Wane Original Soundtrack features about 3 hours and 30 minutes of music created exclusively for the game.

apps.short_description: Listen to the music of Billionth Soul, from Main Menu and First Thaw to Galactic Empire and Danger. Includes all 12 game music tracks as tagged MP3s, totaling approximately 22 minutes 45 seconds. Included with purchase of Billionth Soul at no additional cost.

apps.name: Blasphemous 2 - Mea Culpa - OST
apps.short_description: Return to the land of Cvstodia with the Blasphemous 2: Mea Culpa original soundtrack.

apps.name: BOB LOGISTICS Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Enjoy all 7 tracks from the in-game BOB Pad in BOB LOGISTICS! From relaxing melodies to groovy workday beats, take your favorite warehouse tunes with you wherever you go.

apps.name: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 – Verso's Drafts (Original Soundtrack)
apps.short_description:
Rejoin the Expedition on another journey through the whimsical hideout of a young Verso. 
In a land crafted through joy and innocence, sometimes darkness is uncovered when imagination gets carried away.

apps.short_description: 121 tracks of “Lies of P” and "Lies of P: Overture" OST.

apps.short_description: The OST to your favorite game, MEWGENICS!  Written by Ridiculon.  (Binding of Isaac, Super Meat Boy, End Is Nigh, etc).

apps.short_description: The soundtrack to Shadow Gangs Zero brings its arcade atmosphere to your music library. Featuring chiptune arrangements by Crisps, with original compositions by Soufiane Naim, Clayton Tapp, and Crisps.

apps.short_description: This is additional content for Sorry, My King and does not include the base game.

apps.short_description: The official soundtrack of Stitchlings, composed by Tan Onwimon, Victor Xue, Han Yu, and Daniel Yu.

apps.short_description: The official soundtrack of Tape to Tape, the hockey roguelite. 28 tracks composed by Mathieu Fortin, from team anthems and the Golfers boss fight to trailer themes and 16-bit versions. Includes MP3 and lossless 24-bit FLAC.

apps.name: You Are Empty Original Soundtrack
apps.short_description: The dark ambient/electronic score for You Are Empty composed by Dmitry Dyachenko.

apps.name: Red vs Blue 360
apps.short_description: Life in Blood Gulch is just as boring as you'd imagine. There's nothing to do aside from stand around and talk. I mean, I suppose you could also look around... but you'd need some sort of fancy, three hundred and sixty degree viewing capabilities.

apps.name: Behind The Schemes: Reigns (Nerial)
apps.short_description: Creator of Reigns Francois Alliot (Nerial) takes us on a tour of medieval hot spots in his adopted home town of London. Cheese, trumpets, Tinder, procedural French billiards, and bad jokes at the expense of England's Queen - it's all here. Plus an exclusive insight into life after Reigns.

apps.name: Behind The Schemes: Ruiner (Reikon)
apps.short_description: Hang out with Reikon the developers of Ruiner in Warsaw, hear the real story behind the game, and check out some hot new gameplay footage. What inspired Ruiner? How did the devs hook up? Why did they choose Devolver? What has rally driving got to do with it? And who is the Polish Eric Cartman?

apps.name: Behind The Schemes: Shadow Warrior 2 (Flying Wild Hog)
apps.short_description:
Poland's top Hogs show their love for Lo Wang, ramen, Jean-Michel Jarre, and dangerous cocktails.
And don't miss the rabbit mo-cap session!
He said "flocking system" in case you were wondering.
